name: Aaron
description: High Priest living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel
short: Aaron was Moses' older brother and served as the first high priest of Israel.

name: Abagtha
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: One of King Ahasuerus' seven eunuchs
short: Abagtha was one of the seven eunuchs who served King Ahasuerus.

name: Abda
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Father of Adoram, who was over forced labor
short: Abda was the father of Adoram (or 'Adoniram'), who was in charge of forced labor during Solomon's reign.

name: Abdeel
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Father of Shelemiah, an official under King Jehoiakim
short: Abdeel was the father of Shelemiah, an official sent by King Jehoiakim to arrest Baruch and Jeremiah.

name: Abdi
description: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A Levite, ancestor of Ethan the musician
short: Abdi, a Levite, was an ancestor of Ethan, one of the musicians appointed by David to serve in the temple.

name: Abdi
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A Levite during Hezekiah's reign
short: Abdi, a Levite, was the father of Kish and served during the reign of King Hezekiah.

name: Abdi
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: An Israelite who married a foreign wife
short: Abdi, one of the descendants of Elam, was among those who agreed to put away their foreign wives during Ezra's time.

name: Abdiel
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A Gadite leader
short: Abdiel, son of Guni, was a chief of a Gadite family during the time of Jotham, king of Judah.

name: Abdon
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A Benjamite, son of Shashak
short: Abdon was a son of Shashak and a member of the tribe of Benjamin.

name: Abdon
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Son of Abiel (or 'Jeiel') from Gibeon
short: Abdon, the son of Abiel (or 'Jeiel') and brother of Ner, was a member of the Israelite community in Gibeon.

name: Abdon
description: Judge living before Israel's Monarchy
brief: A minor judge of Israel from Ephraim
short: Abdon, the son of Hillel the Pirathonite, was a minor Judge of Israel who led for eight years.

name: Abel
description: Man living at the time before the Flood
brief: Adam and Eve's second son, killed by Cain
short: Abel, the second son of Adam and Eve, was a shepherd who was killed by his brother Cain.

name: Abi
description: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Mother of King Hezekiah of Judah
short: Abi, also known as Abijah, was the mother of King Hezekiah and the daughter of Zechariah.

name: Abiah
description: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Wife of Hezron, who gave birth after he died
short: Abiah was the wife of Hezron who bore Ashhur after her husband's death.

name: Abi-albon
description: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: One of David's mighty men, an Arbathite
short: Abi-albon, also known as Abiel, was one of David's mighty men, an Arbathite.

name: Abiathar
description: High Priest living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: High priest during the reigns of David and Solomon
short: Abiathar, son of Ahimelech, was a high priest who served during the reigns of David and Solomon.

name: Abida
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Midian, grandson of Abraham
short: Abida was a son of Midian and a grandson of Abraham through his concubine Keturah.

name: Abidan
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Leader of the tribe of Benjamin during the Exodus
short: Abidan, son of Gideoni, was the leader of the tribe of Benjamin during the Israelites' journey through the wilderness.

name: Abiel
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Father of Kish and grandfather of King Saul
short: Abiel, also known as Jeiel, Ner, or Abigibeon (or '[re]-founder of Gibeon'), was the father of Kish and grandfather of King Saul.

name: Abiezer
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Hammolecheth, from the tribe of Manasseh
short: Abiezer, son of Hammolecheth, was a descendant of Manasseh and is mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe.

name: Abiezer
description: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: One of David's mighty men, from Anathoth
short: Abiezer the Anathothite was one of David's mighty men and served as a commander in his army.

name: Abiezer
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Clan of Manasseh, home of Gideon
short: Abiezer, also known as Iezer, was a clan of the tribe of Manasseh and the home of Gideon, one of Israel's judges.

name: Abigail
description: David's wife living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Wife of Nabal, later married David
short: Abigail, initially the wife of Nabal, became one of David's wives after Nabal's death and bore him a son named Chileab.

name: Abigail
description: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Sister of David; mother of Amasa
short: Abigail, David's sister, was the mother of Amasa, who became the commander of Absalom's army.

name: Abihail
description: Woman of living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Wife of Abishur; mother of Ahban and Molid
short: Abihail was the wife of Abishur and the mother of Ahban and Molid, as mentioned in the genealogy of Judah.

name: Abihail
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A Gadite leader from Gilead
short: Abihail, a descendant of Guni, was a leader of the tribe of Gad who lived in Gilead.

name: Abihail
description: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Mother of Rehoboam's wife Mahalath
short: Abihail was the mother of Mahalath, who was one of King Rehoboam's wives and the daughter of David's son Jerimoth.

name: Abihail
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Father of Esther (Hadassah)
short: Abihail was the father of Esther (also known as Hadassah), who became Queen of Persia and saved the Jewish people from Haman's plot.

name: Abihail
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Father of Zuriel, a Levite leader
short: Abihail was the father of Zuriel, who was the leader of the Merarite clan of the Levites during the wilderness wanderings.

name: Abihu
description: Priest living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Aaron
short: Abihu was a son of Aaron who served as a priest. (<ref="Exo.6.23">Exo.6.23</ref>)

name: Abihud
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Bela, a Benjaminite
short: Abihud was a son of Bela and a descendant of Benjamin mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe.

name: Abijah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Head of a priestly division during David's reign
short: Abijah was the head of the eighth priestly division established during King David's reign, and Zechariah, the father of John the Baptist, belonged to this division.

name: Abijah
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Becher, a Benjaminite
short: Abijah was a son of Becher and a descendant of Benjamin mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe.

name: Abijah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Jeroboam I, died in childhood
short: Abijah, the son of King Jeroboam I, fell ill and died in childhood, as prophesied by Ahijah the prophet.

name: Abijah
description: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: King of Judah, son of Rehoboam
short: Abijah, the son of Rehoboam, reigned as king of Judah for three years and continued in the sins of his father.

name: Abijah
description: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Son of Samuel, a corrupt judge
short: Abijah was one of Samuel's sons who served as a judge in Israel but did not follow his father's righteous ways.

name: Abijah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Priest who sealed Nehemiah's covenant
short: Abijah was one of the priests who sealed the covenant during Nehemiah's time and was also listed among the priests who returned from the Babylonian exile.

name: Abimael
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Descendant of Shem, son of Joktan
short: Abimael was a descendant of Shem and one of the sons of Joktan, as mentioned in the genealogies of Genesis and 1 Chronicles.

name: Abimelech
description: King living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Philistine king who interacted with Abraham and Isaac
short: Abimelech was a Philistine king who had dealings with both Abraham and Isaac, involving incidents where the patriarchs claimed their wives were their sisters.

name: Abimelech
description: Judge living before Israel's Monarchy
brief: Son of Gideon, self-proclaimed king of Shechem
short: Abimelech, a son of Gideon, declared himself king of Shechem but was eventually killed when a millstone was dropped on his head during the siege of Thebez.

name: Abinadab
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Solomon's son-in-law, an official in his government
short: Abinadab, the son of Iddo, was married to Solomon's daughter Taphath and served as an official in Solomon's government, overseeing the region of Dor.

name: Abinadab
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Son of King Saul, killed in battle
short: Abinadab, also known as Ishvi, was one of the sons of King Saul who died alongside his father and brothers in battle against the Philistines at Mount Gilboa.

name: Abinadab
description: David's brother living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Son of Jesse, brother of David
short: Abinadab was one of the sons of Jesse and an older brother of King David, but he was not chosen to be anointed as king by Samuel.

name: Abinadab
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Kept the ark of God in his house
short: Abinadab, in whose house the ark of God was kept for 20 years.

name: Abinoam
description: Man living before Israel's Monarchy
brief: Father of Barak, the Israelite commander
short: Abinoam was the father of Barak, the Israelite commander who, along with the prophetess Deborah, led the Israelites to victory against the Canaanite army led by Sisera.

name: Abiram
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Firstborn son of Hiel the Bethelite
short: Abiram, the firstborn son of Hiel the Bethelite, died when his father laid the foundation of Jericho.

name: Abiram
description: Aaron's adversary living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Reubenite who rebelled against Moses and Aaron
short: Abiram, along with Korah and Dathan, led a rebellion against Moses and Aaron and was swallowed up by the earth.

name: Abishag
description: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Beautiful Shunammite who served King David
short: Abishag, the beautiful Shunammite who served King David in his old age and was later sought as a wife by Adonijah.

name: Abishai
description: David's warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: David's nephew, one of his mighty men and commanders
short: Abishai, the son of Zeruiah and nephew of David, was a loyal commander and one of David's mighty men, known for his bravery and military prowess.

name: Abishua
description: Priest living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Phinehas, grandson of Eleazar the high priest
short: Abishua was the son of Phinehas and grandson of Eleazar, who served as high priests in the line of Aaron.

name: Abishua
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Descendant of Benjamin, son of Bela
short: Abishua was a descendant of Benjamin and one of the sons of Bela mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin.

name: Abishur
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Shammai, from the tribe of Judah
short: Abishur, the son of Shammai, was a descendant of Judah; he married Abihail, and they had two sons, Ahban and Molid.

name: Abital
description: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: One of David's wives; mother of Shephatiah
short: Abital was one of King David's wives and the mother of his son Shephatiah.

name: Abitub
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Shaharaim, a Benjaminite
short: Abitub was a son of Shaharaim, a Benjaminite, and is mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin.

name: Abiud
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Son of Zerubbabel, ancestor of Jesus
short: Abiud was the son of Zerubbabel and is mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus Christ in the Gospel of Matthew.

name: Abner
description: David's compatriot living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Saul's cousin and commander of his army
short: Abner, the son of Ner, was King Saul's cousin and the commander of his army; he later supported Saul's son Ish-bosheth as king before defecting to David.

name: Abraham
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people
short: Abraham, originally named Abram, was the patriarch whom God called to leave his homeland and blessed to become the father of many nations, establishing His covenant with him and his descendants.

name: Absalom
description: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: David's rebellious son who tried to usurp the throne.
short: Absalom was David's third son who led a revolt against his father's reign.

name: Achaicus
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: A Corinthian Christian who visited Paul.
short: Achaicus, along with Stephanas and Fortunatus, visited Paul from Corinth.

name: Achan
description: Man living before Israel's Monarchy
brief: An Israelite who stole devoted things, causing Israel's defeat.
short: Achan took devoted things, leading to Israel's defeat at Ai.

name: Achbor
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Official during the reign of King Josiah
short: Achbor, also known as Abdon, was an official during the reign of King Josiah of Judah and was involved in the discovery of the Book of the Law and the subsequent religious reforms.

name: Achbor
description: King living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Edomite king, son of Baal-hanan
short: Achbor was an Edomite king, the son of Baal-hanan, who reigned before the establishment of the Israelite monarchy.

name: Achim
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Ancestor of Jesus, son of Zadok (or 'Sadoc')
short: Achim was an ancestor of Jesus Christ, mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus in the Gospel of Matthew.

name: Achish
description: King living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Philistine king of Gath, gave refuge to David
short: Achish, also referred to as Abimelech, was the Philistine king of Gath who granted refuge to David when he fled from King Saul, but later dismissed him due to the suspicion of his servants.

name: Achsah
description: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Daughter of Caleb, the son of Hur
short: Achsah is mentioned as the daughter of Caleb, the son of Hur, in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah.

name: Achsah
description: Woman living before Israel's Monarchy
brief: Daughter of Caleb; wife of Othniel
short: Achsah was the daughter of Caleb, given in marriage to Othniel as a reward for capturing Kiriath-sepher, and she requested springs of water from her father as a blessing.

name: Adah
description: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Hittite wife of Esau; mother of Eliphaz
short: Adah, also known as Basemath, was one of Esau's Hittite wives and the mother of Eliphaz, who became a chief in the land of Edom.

name: Adah
description: Woman living at the time before the Flood
brief: Wife of Lamech; mother of Jabal and Jubal
short: Adah was one of the two wives of Lamech, a descendant of Cain, and the mother of Jabal, the first to live in tents and raise livestock, and Jubal, the first to play the lyre and pipe.

name: Adaiah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A descendant of Benjamin
short: Adaiah, a descendant of Benjamin, is mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin.

name: Adaiah
description: Priest living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Priest, descendant of Malchijah, during the post-exilic period
short: Adaiah, a priest and descendant of Malchijah, served in the house of God during the post-exilic period in Jerusalem.

name: Adaiah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Father of Maaseiah, during the reign of Joash
short: Adaiah was the father of Maaseiah, one of the captains who supported Jehoiada the priest in overthrowing Athaliah and installing Joash as king of Judah.

name: Adaiah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Father of Jedidah who was mother of King Josiah of Judah
short: Adaiah of Bozkath's daughter Jedidah was the mother of King Josiah, who reigned over Judah and initiated significant religious reforms.

name: Adaiah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A leader who married a foreign wife
short: Adaiah, one of the descendants of Bani, was among the men who had married foreign women during the time of Ezra.

name: Adaiah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A priest who married a foreign wife
short: Adaiah, one of the descendants of Harim, was a priest who had married a foreign woman during the time of Ezra.

name: Adaiah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: An ancestor of Maaseiah, a resident of Jerusalem
short: Adaiah was an ancestor of Maaseiah, a leader who resided in Jerusalem during the time of Nehemiah.

name: Adalia
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Son of Haman, enemy of the Jews
short: Adalia was one of the ten sons of Haman, the enemy of the Jews, who was killed along with his brothers.

name: Adam
description: Man living at the time before the Flood
brief: The first man, created by God
short: Adam, the first man created by God, sinned and brought death into the world, but through Christ, the last Adam, came life and resurrection.

name: Adbeel
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Ishmael, grandson of Abraham
short: Adbeel was a son of Ishmael and a grandson of Abraham, likely representing an Arab tribe or clan.

name: Addar
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Bela, a Benjaminite
short: Addar, also known as Ard, was a son of Bela and a grandson of Benjamin.

name: Addi
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: An ancestor of Jesus Christ
short: Addi was an ancestor of Jesus Christ, mentioned in the genealogy in the Gospel of Luke.

name: Adiel
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Overseer of King David's treasuries
short: Adiel, the son of Azmaveth, was one of the officials in charge of King David's treasuries.

name: Adiel
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Simeonite leader during the reign of Hezekiah
short: Adiel was one of the Simeonite leaders who, during the reign of King Hezekiah, attacked the Hamites and Meunites in the valley of Gedor and settled in their lands.

name: Adiel
description: Priest living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A priest in Jerusalem during Nehemiah's time
short: Adiel (also called Azarel) was a priest who served in Jerusalem during the time of Nehemiah.

name: Adin
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Jewish exile who returned to Jerusalem with Zerubbabel
short: Adin was one of the Jewish exiles who returned to Jerusalem with Zerubbabel after the Babylonian captivity, as recorded in the lists of returnees in Ezra and Nehemiah.

name: Adin
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Jewish leader who signed Nehemiah's covenant
short: Adin was one of the leaders of the people who signed the covenant of faithfulness to God during the time of Nehemiah.

name: Adina
description: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: One of David's mighty men, a Reubenite leader
short: Adina, the son of Shiza the Reubenite, was one of David's mighty men and a leader among the Reubenites.

name: Adino
description: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Alternate name or description of Josheb-Basshebeth
short: Adino the Eznite is mentioned in some translations of <ref="2Sa.23.8">2Sa.23.8</ref>) as one of David's mighty men, but the Hebrew text is unclear, and it may be a description of Josheb-Basshebeth's actions rather than a separate person.

name: Adlai
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Overseer of King David's herds in the valleys
short: Adlai was responsible for overseeing King David's herds that were pastured in the valleys.

name: Admatha
description: Prince living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: One of the seven princes of Persia and Media
short: Admatha was one of the seven princes of Persia and Media who had access to King Ahasuerus's presence and held the highest positions in the kingdom.

name: Adna
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Israelite who married a foreign woman during the exile
short: Adna was one of the Israelites who had married foreign women during the Babylonian exile and pledged to put away his foreign wife as part of Ezra's reforms.

name: Adna
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Priest during the high priesthood of Joiakim
short: Adna was a priest who served during the time of Joiakim, the son of Jeshua, the high priest who returned from the Babylonian exile.

name: Adnah
description: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Manassite leader who joined David at Ziklag
short: Adnah was one of the Manassite leaders who defected to David at Ziklag while he was hiding from Saul.

name: Adnah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Commander of 300,000 troops under King Jehoshaphat
short: Adnah was a commander from Judah who led 300,000 mighty men of valor in King Jehoshaphat's army.

name: Adoni-bezek
description: King living before Israel's Monarchy
brief: Canaanite king captured and mutilated by Judah
short: Adoni-bezek was a Canaanite king who was defeated by the men of Judah, and had his thumbs and big toes cut off as he had done to seventy other kings.

name: Adonijah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Levite sent by Jehoshaphat to teach the Law
short: Adonijah was one of the Levites King Jehoshaphat sent to teach the Book of the Law in the cities of Judah.

name: Adonijah
description: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Son of David who attempted to seize the throne
short: Adonijah, the fourth son of David, declared himself king when David was old, but Solomon was chosen to succeed David instead, and Adonijah was later put to death for his rebellious actions.

name: Adonijah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Levite who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah
short: Adonijah was one of the Levites who sealed the covenant led by Nehemiah to follow the Law of God.

name: Adonikam
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Jewish exile whose descendants returned to Jerusalem
short: Adonikam was one of the Jewish exiles whose descendants returned to Jerusalem from Babylon, as recorded in the lists in Ezra and Nehemiah.

name: Adoni-zedek
description: King living before Israel's Monarchy
brief: King of Jerusalem who fought against Joshua
short: Adoni-zedek, the king of Jerusalem, formed an alliance with other Amorite kings to fight against Joshua and the Israelites but was defeated and killed.

name: Adoram
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Official in charge of forced labor under David and Solomon
short: Adoram, also known as Adoniram or Hadoram, was an official in charge of forced labor during the reigns of David, Solomon, and Rehoboam.

name: Adrammelech
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Assyrian god worshipped by Sepharvites in Samaria
short: Adrammelech was an Assyrian deity worshipped by the Sepharvite people.

name: Adrammelech
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Sennacherib who murdered his father
short: Adrammelech, son of Assyrian king Sennacherib, assassinated his father.

name: Adriel
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Saul's son-in-law; husband of Merab
short: Adriel married Saul's daughter Merab and had five sons.

name: Aeneas
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Paralyzed man in Lydda healed by Peter
short: Aeneas, paralyzed for eight years, was healed by Peter in Lydda.

name: Agabus
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Prophet who predicted famine and Paul's arrest
short: Agabus, a prophet, foretold a famine and Paul's arrest in Jerusalem.

name: Agag
description: King living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Amalekite king captured and killed by Samuel
short: Agag, king of the Amalekites, was spared by Saul but killed by Samuel.

name: Agag
description: King living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: King mentioned in Balaam's oracle about Israel
short: Agag, a king, is mentioned in Balaam's prophetic oracle about Israel's future.

name: Agee
description: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Father of Shammah, one of David's mighty men
short: Agee the Hararite was the father of Shammah, one of David's mighty men.

name: Agrippa
description: Tetrarch living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Tetrarch who heard Paul's defense in Caesarea
short: Tetrarch Agrippa heard Paul's defense and found no grounds for his imprisonment.

name: Agur
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Author of Proverbs 30, son of Jakeh
short: Agur, son of Jakeh, is credited as the author of Proverbs 30.

name: Ahab
description: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Wicked king of Israel; husband of Jezebel
short: Ahab, son of Omri, reigned as king of Israel and did evil in the sight of the Lord.

name: Ahab
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: False prophet during the Babylonian exile
short: Ahab, son of Kolaiah, was a false prophet among the exiles in Babylon.

name: Aharhel
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Harum, from the tribe of Judah
short: Aharhel was a son of Harum, a descendant of Judah.

name: Ahasbai
description: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Father of Eliphelet, one of David's mighty men
short: Ahasbai the Maachathite was the father of Eliphelet, one of David's mighty men.

name: Ahasuerus
description: Emperor Xerxes I, living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Persian Emperor (probably Xerxes I); husband of Esther
short: Ahasuerus, Emperor of Persia (probably Xerxes I), chose Esther as his queen and issued decrees impacting the Jews.

name: Ahaz
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Descendant of Saul and Jonathan
short: Ahaz was a descendant of Saul and Jonathan, from the tribe of Benjamin.

name: Ahaz
description: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: King of Judah, son of Jotham
short: Ahaz, son of Jotham, reigned as king of Judah for 16 years.

name: Ahaziah
description: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: King of Israel, son of Ahab
short: Ahaziah, son of Ahab, reigned as king of Israel for two years.

name: Ahaziah
description: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: King of Judah, son of Jehoram and Athaliah
short: Ahaziah (also called Jehoahaz), son of Jehoram, reigned as king of Judah for one year.

name: Ahban
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Abishur, from the tribe of Judah
short: Ahban was the son of Abishur, a descendant of Judah.

name: Aher
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Shemer, from the tribe of Asher
short: Aher was a son of Shemer, a descendant of Asher.

name: Ahi
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Abdiel, a Gadite chief
short: Ahi, son of Abdiel, was a chief of the Gadites.

name: Ahi
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Shomer, from the tribe of Asher
short: Ahi (or "brother") was a son of Shomer (or 'Shamer'), a descendant of Asher.

name: Ahiah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Priest who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah
short: Ahiah was a priest who sealed the covenant during Nehemiah's time.

name: Ahiam
description: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: One of David's mighty men, son of Sharar
short: Ahiam, son of Sharar the Hararite, was one of David's mighty men.

name: Ahian
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Shemidah, from the tribe of Manasseh
short: Ahian was a son of Shemidah, a descendant of Manasseh.

name: Ahiezer
description: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Benjamite warrior who joined David at Ziklag
short: Ahiezer was a Benjamite warrior who joined David at Ziklag.

name: Ahiezer
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Leader from the tribe of Dan during the Exodus
short: Ahiezer, son of Ammishaddai, was a leader of the tribe of Dan during the Exodus.

name: Ahihud
description: Man living before Israel's Monarchy
brief: Son of Ehud, from the tribe of Benjamin
short: Ahihud was a son of Ehud, a descendant of Benjamin.

name: Ahihud
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Leader from the tribe of Asher for land allocation
short: Ahihud, son of Shelomi, was a leader from the tribe of Asher appointed to help allocate the Promised Land.

name: Ahijah
description: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: One of David's mighty men, the Pelonite
short: Ahijah the Pelonite was one of David's mighty men.

name: Ahijah
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Son of Jerahmeel, from the tribe of Judah
short: Ahijah was a son of Jerahmeel, a descendant of Judah.

name: Ahijah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Levite in charge of the treasuries of the temple
short: Ahijah, a Levite, was in charge of the treasuries of the house of God.

name: Ahijah
description: Man living before Israel's Monarchy
brief: Son of Ehud, from the tribe of Benjamin
short: Ahijah was a son of Ehud, a descendant of Benjamin.

name: Ahijah
description: Prophet living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Prophet from Shiloh who prophesied to Jeroboam
short: Ahijah the Shilonite was a prophet who foretold Jeroboam's rise to power and the division of the kingdom.

name: Ahijah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Father of Baasha, king of Israel
short: Ahijah was the father of Baasha, who became king of Israel and ruled for 24 years.

name: Ahijah
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Son of Seraiah (or 'Shisha'), a scribe during Solomon's reign
short: Ahijah, son of Seraiah (or 'Shisha'), served as a scribe during King Solomon's reign.

name: Ahikam
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Shaphan, protected Jeremiah from death
short: Ahikam, son of Shaphan, was an official during the reigns of Josiah and Jehoiakim, and he protected Jeremiah from death.

name: Ahilud
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Father of Jehoshaphat and Baana, officials under David and Solomon
short: Ahilud was the father of Jehoshaphat, David's recorder, and Baana, one of Solomon's twelve district governors.

name: Ahimaaz
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Solomon's son-in-law, governor of Naphtali
short: Ahimaaz, who was married to Solomon's daughter Basemath, served as the governor of Naphtali during Solomon's reign.

name: Ahimaaz
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Father of Saul's wife Ahinoam
short: Ahimaaz was the father of Ahinoam, who was the wife of King Saul.

name: Ahimaaz
description: Priest living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Son of Zadok the priest, a messenger for David
short: Ahimaaz, the son of Zadok, was a messenger who helped David during Absalom's rebellion and brought news of Absalom's death.

name: Ahiman
description: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Levite gatekeeper during David's reign
short: Ahiman was a Levite who served as a gatekeeper during the reign of David.

name: Ahiman
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: One of the giant descendants of Anak in Hebron
short: Ahiman was one of the three giant descendants of Anak who lived in Hebron and were driven out by Caleb.

name: Ahimelech
description: High Priest living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: High Priest at Nob who helped David, killed by Saul
short: Ahimelech, the High Priest at Nob, gave David consecrated bread and Goliath's sword but was later killed by Saul for aiding David.

name: Ahimelech
description: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Son of Ahitub, a Hittite warrior who joined David
short: Ahimelech the Hittite was one of David's warriors who accompanied him to Saul's camp while Saul was pursuing David.

name: Ahimelech
description: Priest living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Son of Abiathar, a priest during David's reign
short: Ahimelech, son of Abiathar, served as a priest during the reign of King David.

name: Ahimoth
description: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Levite descendant of Kohath, son of Elkanah
short: Ahimoth, also known as Mahath, was a Levite descended from Kohath, the son of Elkanah.

name: Ahinadab
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Son of Iddo, a governor under Solomon
short: Ahinadab, the son of Iddo, was one of Solomon's twelve governors, responsible for providing provisions for the king's household.

name: Ahinoam
description: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Wife of King Saul, daughter of Ahimaaz
short: Ahinoam, the daughter of Ahimaaz, was one of King Saul's wives.

name: Ahinoam
description: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Wife of David, from Jezreel; mother of Amnon
short: Ahinoam of Jezreel was one of David's wives and the mother of his firstborn son, Amnon.

name: Ahio
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Beriah, a Benjamite
short: Ahio was a son of Elpaal and a descendant of Benjamin.

name: Ahio
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Son of Abiel (or 'Jeiel'), a Benjamite
short: Ahio was a son of Abiel (or 'Jeiel'), a Benjamite who was the re-founder of Gibeon.

name: Ahio
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Son of Abinadab, accompanied the ark from Kiriath-jearim
short: Ahio, along with his brother Uzzah, drove the cart carrying the ark of God from Kiriath-jearim.

name: Ahira
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Leader of the tribe of Naphtali during the Exodus
short: Ahira, son of Enan, was the leader of the tribe of Naphtali during the Israelites' journey through the wilderness.

name: Ahiram
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Benjamin, founder of the Ahiramite clan
short: Ahiram, also known as Aharah or Ehi, was a son of Benjamin and the founder of the Ahiramite clan.

name: Ahisamach
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Father of Oholiab, a skilled artisan for the tabernacle
short: Ahisamach, from the tribe of Dan, was the father of Oholiab, a skilled artisan who helped construct the tabernacle.

name: Ahishahar
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Bilhan, a Benjamite
short: Ahishahar was a son of Bilhan and a descendant of Benjamin.

name: Ahishar
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: In charge of Solomon's palace
short: Ahishar was in charge of King Solomon's palace.

name: Ahithophel
description: David's compatriot living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: David's counselor who joined Absalom's rebellion, later committed suicide
short: Ahithophel was a wise counselor to David who defected to Absalom's side during Absalom's rebellion, but later committed suicide when his advice was not followed.

name: Ahitub
description: Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Ancestor of Ezra the scribe, in the priestly line
short: Ahitub, son of Amariah and father of Zadok, was an ancestor of Ezra the scribe in the priestly line.

name: Ahitub
description: High Priest living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Father of Ahimelech, High Priest at Nob killed by Saul
short: Ahitub was the father of Ahimelech, the High Priest at Nob who was killed by Saul for aiding David.

name: Ahitub
description: Priest living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Father of Zadok the priest during David's reign
short: Ahitub was the father of Zadok, who served as a priest alongside Abiathar during the reign of King David.

name: Ahlai
description: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Father of Zabad, one of David's mighty men
short: Ahlai was the father of Zabad, who was one of David's mighty men.

name: Ahlai
description: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Daughter of Sheshan, a Jerahmeelite
short: Ahlai was the daughter of Sheshan, a descendant of Jerahmeel, from the tribe of Judah.

name: Ahoah
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Descendant of Benjamin, clan of David's mighty men
short: The Ahohites, descendants of Ahoah of Benjamin, were a clan that included some of David's mighty men, such as Eleazar and Zalmon.

name: Ahumai
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Descendant of Judah through Reaiah
short: Ahumai was a descendant of Judah through his grandson Reaiah.

name: Ahuzzam
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Ashhur and Naarah, a Judahite
short: Ahuzzam was the son of Ashhur and his wife Naarah, from the tribe of Judah.

name: Ahuzzath
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Friend and advisor of Abimelech, Philistine king of Gerar
short: Ahuzzath was a friend and advisor of Abimelech, the Philistine king of Gerar, who accompanied him when making a treaty with Isaac.

name: Aiah
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Father of Rizpah, Saul's concubine
short: Aiah was the father of Rizpah, who was a concubine of King Saul.

name: Aiah
description: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Zibeon the Hivite, brother of Anah
short: Aiah was the son of Zibeon the Hivite and the brother of Anah, who was a descendant of Esau.

name: Akan
description: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Ezer, a Horite chief in Seir
short: Akan was the son of Ezer, a Horite chief who lived in the land of Seir.

name: Akkub
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Descendant of King Jehoiachin of Judah
short: Akkub was a descendant of King Jehoiachin of Judah, listed in the genealogy of the royal line.

name: Akkub
description: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Levite gatekeeper during the post-exilic period
short: Akkub was a Levite who served as a gatekeeper in the Temple during the post-exilic period.

name: Akkub
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Family head of Temple servants who returned from exile
short: Akkub was a family head of the Temple servants (Nethinim) who returned to Jerusalem from the Babylonian exile.

name: Akkub
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Levite who helped explain the Law to the people
short: Akkub was a Levite who assisted Ezra in explaining the Law to the people during the public reading.

name: Alemeth
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Becher, a Benjamite
short: Alemeth was a son of Becher and a descendant of Benjamin.

name: Alemeth
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Jehoaddah, a Benjamite from Gibeon
short: Alemeth was a son of Jehoaddah (or 'Jehoadah'), a Benjamite from Gibeon, and is listed in the genealogies of Saul's family.

name: Alexander
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Opponent of Paul, along with Hymenaeus
short: Alexander, along with Hymenaeus, was an opponent of Paul's teaching and was handed over to Satan by Paul.

name: Alexander
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Jew put forward by the crowd in Ephesus
short: Alexander was a Jew whom the crowd put forward during the riot in Ephesus, but they shouted him down when they realized he was a Jew.

name: Alexander
description: Priest living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Member of the high-priestly family in Jerusalem
short: Alexander was a member of the high-priestly family in Jerusalem who was present during Peter and John's interrogation before the Sanhedrin.

name: Alexander
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Son of Simon who carried the cross
short: Alexander was the son of Simon of Cyrene, who was compelled to carry Jesus' cross.

name: Allon
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Jedaiah, a Simeonite
short: Allon was the son of Jedaiah, a descendant of Simeon.

name: Almodad
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Joktan, descendant of Shem
short: Almodad was a son of Joktan and a descendant of Shem, listed in the genealogies of the nations.

name: Alphaeus
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Father of apostles James and Matthew (Levi)
short: Alphaeus was the father of two of Jesus' apostles, James and Matthew (also known as Levi).

name: Alvah
description: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Edomite chief, descendant of Esau
short: Alvah was an Edomite chief, a descendant of Esau through his son Eliphaz.

name: Alvan
description: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Horite chief, descendant of Seir
short: Alvan was a Horite chief, a descendant of Seir, who lived in the land of Edom before Esau's descendants.

name: Amal
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Helem, an Asherite
short: Amal was a son of Helem, a descendant of Asher, and is listed in the genealogy of the tribe of Asher.

name: Amalek
description: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Grandson of Esau, ancestor of the Amalekites
short: Amalek was the son of Eliphaz and grandson of Esau, and he became the ancestor of the Amalekite people.

name: Amariah
description: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Levite, descendant of Hebron, during David's reign
short: Amariah was a Levite, a descendant of Hebron, who served during the reign of King David.

name: Amariah
description: Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: High priest, ancestor of Ezra the scribe
short: Amariah was a high priest during the reign of Jehoshaphat and an ancestor of Ezra the scribe.

name: Amariah
description: Priest living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Ancestor of Zadok the priest, in Aaron's line
short: Amariah, son of Meraioth, was an ancestor of Zadok the priest and a descendant of Aaron through his son Eleazar.

name: Amariah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Chief priest under King Jehoshaphat of Judah
short: Amariah was the chief priest who assisted King Jehoshaphat in his judicial reforms in Judah.

name: Amariah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Levite during the reign of King Hezekiah
short: Amariah was a Levite who served during the reign of King Hezekiah and assisted in distributing offerings to his fellow Levites.

name: Amariah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Israelite who agreed to put away his foreign wife
short: Amariah was one of the Israelites who had married a foreign woman and agreed to put her away during Ezra's reforms.

name: Amariah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Priest who sealed Nehemiah's covenant and served as chief priest
short: Amariah was a priest who sealed Nehemiah's covenant and later served as a chief priest during the high priesthood of Joiakim.

name: Amariah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Judahite who resettled in Jerusalem
short: Amariah, a descendant of Judah through Perez, was among those chosen to resettle in Jerusalem during Nehemiah's time.

name: Amariah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Ancestor of Zephaniah the prophet
short: Amariah was an ancestor of Zephaniah the prophet, who prophesied during the reign of King Josiah of Judah.

name: Amasa
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Ephraimite leader who opposed enslaving Judahite captives
short: Amasa, along with other leaders of Ephraim, opposed the Israelite army's attempt to bring Judahite captives as slaves to Samaria.

name: Amasa
description: Ishmaelite living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Military commander, son of Abigail (David's sister), killed by Joab
short: Amasa, the son of Jether and Abigail (David's sister), was a military commander who served under Absalom and later David, but was killed by Joab.

name: Amasai
description: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Chief of thirty who joined David
short: Amasai, a chief of thirty mighty men, joined David at Ziklag while he was fleeing from Saul.

name: Amasai
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Priest who blew the trumpet
short: Amasai, a priest, was among those who blew the trumpet when the Ark of the Covenant was brought to Jerusalem.

name: Amasai
description: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Levite descendant of Kohath
short: Amasai, a Levite descended from Kohath, was an ancestor of the prophet Samuel.

name: Amasai
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Levite who helped purify the temple
short: Amasai, a Levite of the sons of Merari, helped purify the temple during the reign of King Hezekiah.

name: Amasiah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Commander who volunteered for God's service
short: Amasiah, the son of Zichri, was a commander who willingly offered himself for the service of the Lord during the reign of King Jehoshaphat.

name: Amaziah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Simeonite, son of Joshah
short: Amaziah, the son of Joshah, was a descendant of Simeon.

name: Amaziah
description: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Levite, son of Hilkiah
short: Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah, was a Levite of the family of Merari during the time of David.

name: Amaziah
description: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: King of Judah, son of Joash
short: Amaziah, son of Joash, was the ninth king of Judah who reigned for 29 years.

name: Amaziah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Priest of Bethel during Amos' ministry
short: Amaziah, the priest of Bethel, opposed the prophet Amos and told him to leave the kingdom of Israel.

name: Ami
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Family of Solomon's servants
short: The descendants of Ami (or Amon) were among the returned exiles who were servants of Solomon.

name: Amittai
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Father of the prophet Jonah
short: Amittai was the father of Jonah, the prophet from Gath-hepher.

name: Ammiel
description: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Levite gatekeeper during David's reign
short: Ammiel was a Levite gatekeeper during the reign of King David.

name: Ammiel
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Father of Machir, David's ally
short: Ammiel was the father of Machir, who provided assistance to David during his flight from Absalom.

name: Ammiel
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Spy from the tribe of Dan
short: Ammiel, the son of Gemalli, was the representative from the tribe of Dan among the twelve spies sent by Moses to explore Canaan.

name: Ammihud
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Descendant of Judah living in Jerusalem
short: Ammihud, a descendant of Judah, was among those who lived in Jerusalem after the exile.

name: Ammihud
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Father of Talmai, king of Geshur
short: Ammihud (or Ammihur) was the father of Talmai, the king of Geshur, to whom Absalom fled after killing his brother Amnon.

name: Ammihud
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Father of Elishama, leader of Ephraim
short: Ammihud was the father of Elishama, the leader of the tribe of Ephraim during the wilderness journey.

name: Ammihud
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Father of Shemuel, leader from Simeon
short: Ammihud was the father of Shemuel, the leader from the tribe of Simeon appointed to help divide the land of Canaan.

name: Ammihud
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Father of Pedahel, leader from Naphtali
short: Ammihud was the father of Pedahel, the leader from the tribe of Naphtali appointed to help divide the land of Canaan.

name: Amminadab
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Levite leader during the Ark's transfer
short: Amminadab was a Levite leader from the Uzzielite clan who participated in the transfer of the Ark of the Covenant to Jerusalem.

name: Amminadab
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Father-in-law of Aaron, ancestor of David
short: Amminadab was the father of Elisheba, who married Aaron, and an ancestor of King David and Jesus Christ.

name: Amminadib
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Noble mentioned in a love song
short: Amminadib is mentioned in a poetic passage in the Song of Solomon, possibly referring to a noble or prince.

name: Ammishaddai
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Father of Ahiezer, leader of Dan
short: Ammishaddai was the father of Ahiezer, the leader of the tribe of Dan during the wilderness journey.

name: Ammizabad
description: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Son of Benaiah, one of David's mighty men
short: Ammizabad was the son of Benaiah, one of David's mighty men, and served as his father's second-in-command.

name: Amnon
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Shimon, descendant of Judah
short: Amnon was a son of Shimon and a descendant of Judah.

name: Amnon
description: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: David's firstborn son, killed by Absalom
short: Amnon, David's firstborn son, raped his half-sister Tamar and was later killed by her brother Absalom.

name: Amok
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Priest who returned from Babylonian exile
short: Amok was a priest who returned from the Babylonian exile and signed the covenant under Nehemiah.

name: Amon
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Governor of Samaria during Ahab's reign
short: Amon was the governor of Samaria during the reign of King Ahab of Israel.

name: Amon
description: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: King of Judah, son of Manasseh
short: Amon, the son of Manasseh, was the 15th king of Judah who reigned for two years before being assassinated by his servants.

name: Amos
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Prophet from Tekoa who prophesied to Israel
short: Amos, a shepherd from Tekoa, called by God as a prophet to Israel.

name: Amos
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Son of Naum in Jesus' genealogy
short: Amos, an ancestor of Jesus, son of Naum.

name: Amoz
description: Isaiah's father living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Father of the prophet Isaiah
short: Amoz, the father of the prophet Isaiah.

name: Ampliatus
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Believer greeted by Paul in Rome
short: Ampliatus, a beloved fellow believer greeted by Paul in his letter to the Romans.

name: Amram
description: Moses' father living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Father of Moses, Aaron, and Miriam
short: Amram was the father of Moses, Aaron, and Miriam, and a member of the tribe of Levi.

name: Amram
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Israelite who married a foreign wife
short: Amram was one of the Israelites who had married a foreign woman during the Exile and agreed to put her away.

name: Amraphel
description: King living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: King of Shinar, ally of Chedorlaomer
short: Amraphel, king of Shinar, was one of the four kings who joined forces with Chedorlaomer in the battle against the five kings of the Plain.

name: Amzi
description: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Levite musician, descendant of Merari
short: Amzi, a descendant of Merari, was a Levite who served as a musician in the temple.

name: Amzi
description: Priest living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Priest in Jerusalem after the Exile
short: Amzi was a priest who lived in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

name: Anah
description: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Horite, father of Oholibamah, Esau's wife
short: Anah was a Horite, the father of Oholibamah, one of Esau's wives, and the discoverer of hot springs in the wilderness.

name: Anaiah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Priest who sealed the covenant
short: Anaiah was a priest who signed the covenant of faithfulness to God during Nehemiah's time.

name: Anaiah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Stood beside Ezra during the reading of the Law
short: Anaiah was one of the men who stood beside Ezra when he read the Book of the Law to the people.

name: Anak
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Ancestor of giant people in Canaan
short: Anak was the ancestor of the Anakim, a race of giants who inhabited Canaan before the Israelite conquest.

name: Anammelech
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Assyrian deity worshiped by Sepharvites
short: Anammelech was an Assyrian deity worshiped by the Sepharvites, who were among the foreign peoples settled in Samaria by the Assyrian king.

name: Anan
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Signer of the covenant during Nehemiah's time
short: Anan was one of the leaders who signed the covenant during the time of Nehemiah.

name: Anani
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Descendant of King David
short: Anani was a descendant of King David, mentioned in the genealogy recorded in 1 Chronicles.

name: Ananiah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Repairer of the wall in Jerusalem
short: Ananiah made repairs to a section of the wall near his house during the rebuilding of Jerusalem under Nehemiah's leadership.

name: Ananias
description: High Priest living at the time of the New Testament
brief: High priest during Paul's trial
short: Ananias, the high priest, presided over Paul's trial and ordered him to be struck on the mouth for his defense.

name: Ananias
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Husband of Sapphira, lied about offering proceeds
short: Ananias, along with his wife Sapphira, lied to the apostles about the proceeds from the sale of their property and faced divine judgment.

name: Ananias
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Disciple in Damascus, baptized Saul (Paul)
short: Ananias, a disciple in Damascus, was sent by God to heal and baptize Saul (later known as Paul) after his conversion on the road to Damascus.

name: Anath
description: Man living before Israel's Monarchy
brief: Father of Shamgar, a judge of Israel
short: Anath was the father of Shamgar, one of the judges who delivered Israel from oppression.

name: Anathoth
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Becher, descendant of Benjamin
short: Anathoth was a son of Becher and a descendant of Benjamin, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin.

name: Anathoth
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Signer of the covenant during Nehemiah's time
short: Anathoth was one of the leaders who signed the covenant during the time of Nehemiah.

name: Andrew
description: Apostle living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Apostle, brother of Simon Peter
short: Andrew, the brother of Simon Peter, was one of the twelve apostles of Jesus Christ and played a significant role in the early church.

name: Andronicus
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Fellow prisoner with Paul, outstanding among the apostles
short: Andronicus, along with Junia, was a fellow prisoner with Paul and was noted as outstanding among the apostles.

name: Aner
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Amorite ally of Abram
short: Aner was an Amorite, one of the allies of Abram, who joined him in the battle against the kings who had taken Lot captive.

name: Aniam
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Shemida, descendant of Manasseh
short: Aniam was a son of Shemida and a descendant of Manasseh, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Manasseh.

name: Anna
description: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Prophetess who witnessed Jesus' dedication in the temple
short: Anna, a prophetess and widow, witnessed the dedication of the infant Jesus in the temple and spoke about Him to all who were looking forward to the redemption of Jerusalem.

name: Annas
description: High Priest living at the time of the New Testament
brief: High priest during Jesus' ministry and trial
short: Annas, a high priest, played a significant role in the events surrounding Jesus' arrest, trial, and crucifixion, as well as in the early persecution of the apostles.

name: Anthothijah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Shashak, descendant of Benjamin
short: Anthothijah was a descendant of Benjamin, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin.

name: Antipas
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Faithful martyr in Pergamum
short: Antipas, described as Christ's faithful witness, was martyred in Pergamum, where Satan's throne was said to be.

name: Anub
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Coz, descendant of Judah
short: Anub was a descendant of Judah, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah.

name: Apelles
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Approved in Christ, greeted by Paul
short: Apelles, described as "approved in Christ," was among those greeted by Paul in his letter to the Romans.

name: Aphiah
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Ancestor of King Saul, a Benjamite
short: Aphiah, a Benjamite, was an ancestor of King Saul, the first king of Israel.

name: Apollos
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Eloquent Jewish Christian from Alexandria, co-worker with Paul
short: Apollos, an eloquent and learned Jewish Christian from Alexandria, was an important figure in the early church who worked alongside Paul in spreading the gospel.

name: Apphia
description: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Recipient of Paul's letter to Philemon
short: Apphia, likely a member of Philemon's household, was one of the recipients of Paul's letter to Philemon.

name: Aquila
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Jewish Christian tentmaker, co-worker with Paul
short: Aquila, along with his wife Priscilla, was a Jewish Christian who worked as a tentmaker and played a significant role in the early church, partnering with Paul in his ministry.

name: Ara
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Jether, descendant of Asher
short: Ara was a descendant of Asher, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Asher.

name: Arad
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: A Benjamite, son of Beriah.
short: Arad was a Benjamite, one of the sons of Beriah.

name: Arah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Shual, an Asherite
short: Arah, the son of Shual ('Ulla'), was a descendant of Asher.

name: Arah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Father-in-law of Tobiah the Ammonite
short: Arah, whose daughter was married to Shechaniah, was the father-in-law of Tobiah the Ammonite.

name: Arah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A Jewish leader whose daughter married Tobiah's son.
short: Arah's daughter was married to the son of Tobiah the Ammonite.

name: Aram
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Shemer, descendant of Asher
short: Aram was a descendant of Asher, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Asher.

name: Aram
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Shem, ancestor of the Arameans
short: Aram, a son of Shem and ancestor of the Aramean people.

name: Aram
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Kemuel, nephew of Abraham
short: Aram was the son of Kemuel, who was the son of Abraham's brother Nahor.

name: Aramitess
description: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Concubine of Manasseh; mother of Asriel
short: An Aramitess, who was a concubine of Manasseh, gave birth to Machir and Asriel..

name: Aran
description: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Dishan, descendant of Seir the Horite
short: Aran was a descendant of Seir the Horite, mentioned in the genealogies of Esau's family and the Horite clans.

name: Arba
description: Canaanite living before Israel's Monarchy
brief: Father of Anak, former name of Hebron
short: Arba was the father of Anak and the namesake of Kiriath-arba, which was the former name of Hebron.

name: Archelaus
description: Ethnarch living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Son of Herod the Great, Ethnarch of Judea
short: Archelaus, son of Herod the Great, Ethnarch over Judea, causing Joseph to fear returning there with Mary and the child Jesus.

name: Archippus
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Fellow soldier and minister in Colossae
short: Archippus, addressed as a fellow soldier by Paul, was urged to complete the ministry he had received in the Lord.

name: Ard
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Benjamin, brother of Bela
short: Ard, a son of Benjamin, is listed among the descendants of Jacob who went to Egypt during the famine.

name: Ard
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Grandson of Benjamin, son of Bela
short: Ard, a grandson of Benjamin, is mentioned in the census of the Israelites taken in the wilderness of Moab.

name: Ardon
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Caleb, brother of Jether and Mered
short: Ardon was a son of Caleb, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah.

name: Areli
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Gad, grandson of Jacob
short: Areli, a son of Gad, is mentioned in the genealogy of Jacob and the census of the Israelites in the wilderness.

name: Aretas
description: King living at the time of the New Testament
brief: King of the Nabataeans in Damascus
short: Aretas, the king of the Nabataeans, governed Damascus and tried to arrest Paul.

name: Argob
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Officer of King Pekahiah of Israel
short: Argob, along with Arieh, was with King Pekahiah when Pekah conspired against him and assassinated him.

name: Aridai
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Son of Haman, enemy of the Jews
short: Aridai was one of the ten sons of Haman, who were killed and hanged after their father's downfall.

name: Aridatha
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Son of Haman, enemy of the Jews
short: Aridatha was one of the ten sons of Haman, who were killed and hanged after their father's downfall.

name: Arieh
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Officer of King Pekahiah of Israel
short: Arieh, along with Argob, was with King Pekahiah when Pekah conspired against him and assassinated him.

name: Ariel
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: One of the leaders summoned by Ezra
short: Ariel was one of the leaders summoned by Ezra to assist in the return of the exiles to Jerusalem.

name: Arioch
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Captain of Nebuchadnezzar's guard
short: Arioch, the captain of King Nebuchadnezzar's guard, was commanded to execute the wise men of Babylon but brought Daniel before the king to interpret his dream.

name: Arioch
description: King living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: King of Ellasar, ally of Chedorlaomer
short: Arioch, king of Ellasar, was one of the four kings who joined forces with Chedorlaomer in the battle against the five kings of the plain.

name: Arisai
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Son of Haman, enemy of the Jews
short: Arisai was one of the ten sons of Haman, who were killed and hanged after their father's downfall.

name: Aristarchus
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Macedonian companion of Paul, fellow prisoner
short: Aristarchus, a Macedonian from Thessalonica, was a faithful companion of Paul during his missionary journeys and imprisonment.

name: Aristobulus
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Believer in Rome, greeted by Paul
short: Paul sends greetings to those who belong to the household of Aristobulus, suggesting that Aristobulus was a prominent believer in Rome.

name: Armoni
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Son of Saul by Rizpah, killed by Gibeonites
short: Armoni was a son of Saul by his concubine Rizpah, killed by the Gibeonites (<ref="2Sa.21.8">2Sa.21.8</ref>).

name: Arnan
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Descendant of David's son Solomon
short: Arnan was a descendant of David's son Solomon (<ref="1Ch.3.21">1Ch.3.21</ref>).

name: Arod
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Gad and founder of the Arodite clan
short: Arod, son of Gad, was the founder of the Arodite clan (<ref="Gen.46.16; Num.26.17">Gen.46.16; Num.26.17</ref>).

name: Arpachshad
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Shem, ancestor of Abraham
short: Arpachshad, son of Shem, was born two years after the flood and was an ancestor of Abraham (<ref="Gen.10.22,24; 11:10-13; 1Ch.1.17-18,24; Luke 3:36">Gen.10.22,24; 11:10-13; 1Ch.1.17-18,24; Luke 3:36</ref>).

name: Artaxerxes
description: Artaxerxes Longimanus, an emperor living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Persian king during Ezra and Nehemiah's time
short: Artaxerxes was the Persian king who allowed Ezra and Nehemiah to return to Jerusalem (<ref="Ezra 7:1,11-12,21; Neh.2.1; 5:14">Ezra 7:1,11-12,21; Neh.2.1; 5:14</ref>).

name: Artemas
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Companion of Paul, potential replacement for Titus
short: Artemas was a companion of Paul who could potentially replace Titus in Crete (<ref="Titus 3:12">Titus 3:12</ref>).

name: Arza
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Steward of King Elah's household in Tirzah
short: Arza was the steward of King Elah's household in Tirzah (<ref="1Ki.16.9">1Ki.16.9</ref>).

name: Asa
description: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Levite gatekeeper who resettled in Jerusalem
short: Asa was a Levite gatekeeper who resettled in Jerusalem (<ref="1Ch.9.16">1Ch.9.16</ref>).

name: Asa
description: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: King of Judah, son of Abijah; father of Jehoshaphat
short: Asa was a king of Judah who reigned for 41 years, known for his religious reforms (1Kings 15; 2Chr 14-16).

name: Asahel
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Levite sent by Jehoshaphat to teach the Law
short: Asahel was a Levite sent by Jehoshaphat to teach the Book of the Law in Judah (<ref="2Ch.17.8">2Ch.17.8</ref>).

name: Asahel
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Levite in charge of tithes under Hezekiah
short: Asahel was a Levite appointed by Hezekiah to distribute the tithes and dedicated things (<ref="2Ch.31.13">2Ch.31.13</ref>).

name: Asahel
description: David's compatriot living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Son of Zeruiah, brother of Joab, killed by Abner
short: Asahel, son of Zeruiah and brother of Joab, was a fast runner killed by Abner during a battle (<ref="2Sam 2; 3:27, 30; 23:24; 1Ch.2.16; 11:26; 27:7">2Sam 2; 3:27, 30; 23:24; 1Ch.2.16; 11:26; 27:7</ref>).

name: Asahel
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Opposed Ezra's dissolution of mixed marriages
short: Asahel, along with Jahzeiah, opposed Ezra's plan to dissolve mixed marriages among the returned exiles (<ref="Ezra 10:15">Ezra 10:15</ref>).

name: Asaiah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Levite leader who helped bring the ark to Jerusalem
short: Asaiah was a Levite leader who assisted in bringing the ark of the covenant to Jerusalem during David's reign (<ref="1Ch.15.6, 11">1Ch.15.6, 11</ref>).

name: Asaiah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Simeonite leader during Hezekiah's reign
short: Asaiah was a Simeonite leader during the reign of King Hezekiah (<ref="1Ch.4.36">1Ch.4.36</ref>).

name: Asaiah
description: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Merarite Levite, ancestor of Ethan the singer
short: Asaiah was a Merarite Levite, an ancestor of Ethan the singer (<ref="1Ch.6.30">1Ch.6.30</ref>).

name: Asaiah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Descendant of Judah living in Jerusalem
short: Asaiah, a descendant of Judah, lived in Jerusalem (<ref="1Ch.9.5">1Ch.9.5</ref>).

name: Asaiah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Servant of King Josiah during Book of Law discovery
short: Asaiah was a servant of King Josiah sent to consult the prophetess Huldah about the Book of the Law (<ref="2Ki.22.12, 14; 2Ch.34.20">2Ki.22.12, 14; 2Ch.34.20</ref>).

name: Asaph
description: Singer living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Levite musician, psalmist, and ancestor of temple singers

name: Asaph
description: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Levite descendant who resettled in Jerusalem
short: Asaph was a Levite descendant who resettled in Jerusalem after the exile (<ref="1Ch.9.15; Neh.11.17">1Ch.9.15; Neh.11.17</ref>).

name: Asaph
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Recorder during King Hezekiah's reign
short: Asaph served as the recorder during the reign of King Hezekiah of Judah (<ref="2Ki.18.18, 37; Isa.36.3, 22">2Ki.18.18, 37; Isa.36.3, 22</ref>).

name: Asaph
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Keeper of the king's forest during Nehemiah's time
short: Asaph was the keeper of the king's forest during Nehemiah's time (<ref="Neh.2.8">Neh.2.8</ref>).

name: Asarel
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Jehallelel, from the tribe of Judah
short: Asarel was a son of Jehallelel, a descendant of Judah (<ref="1Ch.4.16">1Ch.4.16</ref>).

name: Asen
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Ancestor of exiles who returned to Jerusalem
short: Asen was an ancestor of 223 individuals who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian captivity.

name: Asenath
description: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Egyptian wife of Joseph; mother of Manasseh and Ephraim
short: Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera, priest of On, was given to Joseph as his wife by Pharaoh (<ref="Gen.41.45, 50; 46:20">Gen.41.45, 50; 46:20</ref>).

name: Asharelah
description: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Levite musician appointed by David to prophesy with lyres
short: Asharelah (or Jesharelah) was a Levite musician appointed by David to prophesy with lyres (<ref="1Ch.25.2, 14">1Ch.25.2, 14</ref>).

name: Ashbel
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Benjamin, founder of the Ashbelite clan
short: Ashbel was a son of Benjamin and the founder of the Ashbelite clan (<ref="Gen.46.21; Num.26.38; 1Ch.8.1">Gen.46.21; Num.26.38; 1Ch.8.1</ref>).

name: Asher
description: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Jacob and Zilpah, founder of the tribe of Asher
short: Asher was the eighth son of Jacob, born to Zilpah, Leah's maidservant, and became the founder of the tribe of Asher (<ref="Gen.30.13; 46:17; Deu.33:24; Jos.19:24-34; Luke 2.36">Gen.30.13; 46:17; Deu.33:24; Jos.19:24-34; Luke 2.36</ref>).

name: Ashhur
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Descendant of Judah through Hezron
short: Ashhur, a descendant of Judah through Hezron, was the  father (ie founder) of Tekoa (<ref="1Ch.2.24; 4:5">1Ch.2.24; 4:5</ref>).

name: Ashkenaz
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Grandson of Japheth, son of Gomer
short: Ashkenaz was a grandson of Japheth and son of Gomer, mentioned in the Table of Nations (<ref="Gen.10.3; 1Ch.1.6">Gen.10.3; 1Ch.1.6</ref>).

name: Ashpenaz
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Chief official in Nebuchadnezzar's court
short: Ashpenaz was the chief official in Nebuchadnezzar's court, responsible for selecting and training young Israelite exiles (<ref="Dan.1.3">Dan.1.3</ref>).

name: Ashvath
description: Man living before Israel's Monarchy
brief: Son of Japhlet, descendant of Asher
short: Ashvath was a son of Japhlet and a descendant of Asher (<ref="1Ch.7.33">1Ch.7.33</ref>).

name: Asiel
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Descendant of Simeon
short: Asiel was a descendant of Simeon mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe (<ref="1Ch.4.35">1Ch.4.35</ref>).

name: Asnah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Head of a family of temple servants who returned from exile
short: Asnah was the head of a family of temple servants (Nethinim) who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian exile (<ref="Ezra 2:50">Ezra 2:50</ref>).

name: Aspatha
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: One of the ten sons of Haman
short: Aspatha was one of the ten sons of Haman, who were executed after their father's downfall (<ref="Est.9.7">Est.9.7</ref>).

name: Asriel
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Gilead, descendant of Manasseh
short: Asriel was a son of Gilead and a descendant of Manasseh (<ref="1Ch.7.14">1Ch.7.14</ref>).

name: Asriel
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Manasseh, founder of the Asrielite clan
short: Asriel was a son of Manasseh and the founder of the Asrielite clan (<ref="Num.26.31; Josh 17:2">Num.26.31; Josh 17:2</ref>).

name: Asshur
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Shem; father of the Assyrians
short: Asshur was a son of Shem and is considered the father of the Assyrians (<ref="Gen.10.22; 1Ch.1.17">Gen.10.22; 1Ch.1.17</ref>).

name: Assir
description: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Levite ancestor of the prophet Samuel
short: Assir was a Levite ancestor of Samuel the prophet (<ref="1Ch.6.23">1Ch.6.23, 37</ref>).

name: Assir
description: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Korah who is grandson of Kohath
short: Assir was a son of Korah and great-grandson of Kohath, from the tribe of Levi (<ref="Exo.6.24; 1Ch.6.22">Exo.6.24; 1Ch.6.22</ref>).

name: Asyncritus
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Believer in Rome greeted by Paul
short: Asyncritus was a believer in Rome to whom Paul sent greetings (<ref="Rom.16.14">Rom.16.14</ref>).

name: Atarah
description: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Wife of Jerahmeel; mother of Onam
short: Atarah was the wife of Jerahmeel and the mother of Onam, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah (<ref="1Ch.2.26">1Ch.2.26</ref>).

name: Ater
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Head of a family that returned from Babylonian exile
short: Ater was the head of a family that returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian captivity (<ref="Ezr.2.16; Neh.7.21">Ezr.2.16; Neh.7.21</ref>).

name: Ater
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Head of a family of gatekeepers who returned from exile
short: Ater was the head of a family of gatekeepers who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian captivity (<ref="Ezr.2.42; Neh.7.45">Ezr.2.42; Neh.7.45</ref>).

name: Ater
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: One of the signers of the covenant during Nehemiah's time
short: Ater was one of the individuals who signed the covenant during the time of Nehemiah's reforms (<ref="Neh.10.17">Neh.10.17</ref>).

name: Athaiah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Descendant of Judah who resettled in Jerusalem
short: Athaiah, a descendant of Judah, was one of the people who resettled in Jerusalem after the exile (<ref="Neh.11.4">Neh.11.4</ref>).

name: Athaliah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Descendant of Benjamin
short: Athaliah was a descendant of Benjamin mentioned in the genealogy of Saul's family (<ref="1Ch.8.26">1Ch.8.26</ref>).

name: Athaliah
description: Queen living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Queen of Judah, daughter of Ahab and Jezebel
short: Athaliah, the daughter of Ahab and Jezebel, became queen of Judah and ruled for six years before being overthrown (<ref="2Ki.8.26; 11:1-3, 13-14, 20; 2Ch.22.2, 10-12; 23:12-13, 21; 24:7">2Ki.8.26; 11:1-3, 13-14, 20; 2Ch.22.2, 10-12; 23:12-13, 21; 24:7</ref>).

name: Athaliah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Descendant of Elam who returned from Babylonian exile
short: Athaliah, a descendant of Elam, was among those who returned to Jerusalem with Ezra (<ref="Ezr.8.7">Ezr.8.7</ref>).

name: Athlai
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: One of those who agreed to put away foreign wives
short: Athlai was one of the men who agreed to put away their foreign wives during Ezra's reforms (<ref="Ezr.10.28">Ezr.10.28</ref>).

name: Attai
