description: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: One of David's mighty men, a Gadite warrior
short: Attai the son of Zabad was one of David's mighty men, a Gadite warrior who joined him at Ziklag (<ref="1Ch.12.11">1Ch.12.11</ref>).

name: Attai
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Grandson of Sheshan, descendant of Judah
short: Attai was the grandson of Sheshan, a descendant of Judah (<ref="1Ch.2.35-36">1Ch.2.35-36</ref>).

name: Attai
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of King Rehoboam and Maacah
short: Attai was a son of King Rehoboam of Judah and his wife Maacah (<ref="2Ch.11.20">2Ch.11.20</ref>).

name: Augustus
description: Emperor living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Roman emperor during the birth of Jesus
short: Augustus, also known as Caesar, was the Roman emperor during the time of Jesus' birth and early life (<ref="Luk.2.1; 3:1; Act.25.21, 25; 27:1">Luk.2.1; 3:1; Act.25.21, 25; 27:1</ref>).

name: Azaliah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Father of Shaphan the scribe during Josiah's reign
short: Azaliah was the father of Shaphan the scribe, who served during the reign of King Josiah of Judah (<ref="2Ki.22.3; 2Ch.34.8">2Ki.22.3; 2Ch.34.8</ref>).

name: Azaniah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: One of the Levites who sealed the covenant
short: Azaniah was one of the Levites who sealed the covenant during the time of Nehemiah (<ref="Neh.10.9">Neh.10.9</ref>).

name: Azarel
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: One of the Danite warriors who joined David at Ziklag
short: Azarel was one of the Danite warriors who joined David at Ziklag (<ref="1Ch.12.6">1Ch.12.6</ref>).

name: Azarel
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Leader of the half-tribe of Manasseh under David
short: Azarel son of Jeroham was the leader of the half-tribe of Manasseh during David's reign (<ref="1Ch.27.22">1Ch.27.22</ref>).

name: Azarel
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: One of those who married foreign women during Ezra's time
short: Azarel was among those who had married foreign women during the time of Ezra (<ref="Ezr.10.41">Ezr.10.41</ref>).

name: Azarel
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Priest who participated in the dedication of Jerusalem's wall
short: Azarel was a priest who participated in the dedication of Jerusalem's wall during Nehemiah's time (<ref="Neh.12.36">Neh.12.36</ref>).

name: Azariah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Descendant of Jerahmeel, son of Hezron
short: Azariah was a descendant of Jerahmeel, the son of Hezron, from the tribe of Judah (<ref="1Ch.2.38, 39">1Ch.2.38, 39</ref>).

name: Azariah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Ethan, descendant of Judah
short: Azariah was the son of Ethan, a descendant of Judah (<ref="1Ch.2.8">1Ch.2.8</ref>).

name: Azariah
description: Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Grandfather of Ezra, descended from High Priests
short: Azariah was father of Seraiah, father of Ezra. His ancestors served as high priests (<ref="1Ch.6.13, 14; 9:11; Ezr.7.1">1Ch.6.13, 14; 9:11; Ezr.7.1</ref>).

name: Azariah
description: Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Descendant of Zadok, a priest before Solomon's reign
short: Azariah, the descendant of Zadok, was a priest before the reign of King Solomon (<ref="1Ch.6.10-11">1Ch.6.10-11</ref>).

name: Azariah
description: Priest living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: High priest during Solomon's reign, descendant of Zadok
short: Azariah, the descendant of Zadok, served as high priest during the reign of King Solomon (<ref="1Ch.6.10, 11; Ezr.7.3">1Ch.6.10, 11; Ezr.7.3</ref>).

name: Azariah
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Son of Nathan, an official in Solomon's court
short: Azariah, the son of Nathan, was an official in King Solomon's court (<ref="1Ki.4.5">1Ki.4.5</ref>).

name: Azariah
description: Prophet living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Prophet who encouraged King Asa to seek God
short: Azariah, the son of Oded, was a prophet who encouraged King Asa of Judah to seek God (<ref="2Ch.15.1">2Ch.15.1</ref>).

name: Azariah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of King Jehoshaphat of Judah
short: Azariah was one of the sons of King Jehoshaphat of Judah (<ref="2Ch.21.2">2Ch.21.2</ref>).

name: Azariah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A commander who helped crown Joash king
short: Azariah son of Jeroham was a military commander who supported Jehoiada in restoring Joash to the throne of Judah.

name: Azariah
description: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A commander who supported Joash's coronation
short: Azariah son of Obed was one of the commanders who supported Jehoiada in making Joash king.

name: Azariah
description: Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: High priest who confronted King Uzziah
short: Azariah, the high priest, confronted King Uzziah when he attempted to burn incense in the temple (<ref="2Ch.26.17 , 20">2Ch.26.17, 20</ref>).

name: Azariah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Leader who opposed the enslaving of captives
short: Azariah, along with other leaders, opposed the enslaving of captives from Judah during the reign of King Ahaz (<ref="2Ch.28.12">2Ch.28.12</ref>).

name: Azariah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A Levite who helped purify the temple
short: Azariah son of Jehallel was a Merarite Levite who helped purify the temple under King Hezekiah.

name: Azariah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A Levite who helped purify the temple
short: Azariah son of Jehallelel was a Kohathite Levite who helped purify the temple under King Hezekiah.

name: Azariah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Chief priest during Hezekiah's reign
short: Azariah, the chief priest from the family of Zadok, served during the reign of King Hezekiah (<ref="2Ch.31.10, 13">2Ch.31.10, 13</ref>).

name: Azariah
description: Daniel's compatriot living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: One of Daniel's companions, survived the fiery furnace
short: Azariah, also known as Abednego, was one of Daniel's companions who survived the fiery furnace (<ref="Dan.1.6, 7, 11, 19; 2:17, 49; 3">Dan.1.6, 7, 11, 19; 2:17, 49; 3</ref>).

name: Azariah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Son of Maaseiah, repairer of Jerusalem's wall
short: Azariah, son of Maaseiah, repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall near his house during Nehemiah's time (<ref="Neh.3.23, 24">Neh.3.23, 24</ref>).

name: Azariah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Priest who participated in the dedication of Jerusalem's wall
short: Azariah was a priest who participated in the dedication of Jerusalem's wall during Nehemiah's time (<ref="Neh.7.7; 10:2; 12:33">Neh.7.7; 10:2; 12:33</ref>).

name: Azariah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Levite who helped the people understand the Law
short: Azariah was a Levite who helped the people understand the Law during the time of Ezra (<ref="Neh.8.7">Neh.8.7</ref>).

name: Azariahu
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of King Jehoshaphat of Judah
short: Azariahu was one of the sons of King Jehoshaphat of Judah (<ref="2Ch.21.2">2Ch.21.2</ref>).

name: Azaz
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Descendant of Reuben; father of Bela
short: Azaz, a descendant of Reuben, was the father of Bela (<ref="1Ch.5.8">1Ch.5.8</ref>).

name: Azaziah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Levite musician during David's reign
short: Azaziah was a Levite musician who played the harp during the reign of King David (<ref="1Ch.15.21">1Ch.15.21</ref>).

name: Azaziah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Leader of the half-tribe of Manasseh under David
short: Azaziah was the leader of the half-tribe of Manasseh during the reign of King David (<ref="1Ch.27.20">1Ch.27.20</ref>).

name: Azaziah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Levite during Hezekiah's reign, in charge of offerings
short: Azaziah was a Levite during the reign of King Hezekiah, appointed to oversee the freewill offerings (<ref="2Ch.31.13">2Ch.31.13</ref>).

name: Azbuk
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Father of Nehemiah, who repaired part of Jerusalem's wall
short: Azbuk was the father of Nehemiah, who repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall near the tombs of David (<ref="Neh.3.16">Neh.3.16</ref>).

name: Azel
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Descendant of Saul, had six sons
short: Azel, a descendant of Saul, had six sons: Azrikam, Bokeru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan (<ref="1Ch.8.37, 38; 9:43, 44">1Ch.8.37, 38; 9:43, 44</ref>).

name: Azgad
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Ancestor of exiles who returned to Jerusalem
short: Azgad was the ancestor of 1,222 (or 2,322) exiles who returned to Jerusalem (<ref="Ezr.2.12; 8:12; Neh.7.17">Ezr.2.12; 8:12; Neh.7.17</ref>).

name: Azgad
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Leader who sealed the covenant during Nehemiah's time
short: Azgad was one of the leaders who sealed the covenant during the time of Nehemiah (<ref="Neh.10.15">Neh.10.15</ref>).

name: Aziza
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Descendant of Zattu, had married a foreign woman
short: Aziza, a descendant of Zattu, was one of the men who had married foreign women during the time of Ezra (<ref="Ezr.10.27">Ezr.10.27</ref>).

name: Azmaveth
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Benjamite warrior who joined David at Ziklag
short: Azmaveth, a Benjamite warrior, was one of the men who joined David at Ziklag when he was fleeing from Saul (<ref="1Ch.12.3">1Ch.12.3</ref>).

name: Azmaveth
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Overseer of royal treasuries under King David
short: Azmaveth son of Adiel was in charge of King David's treasuries (<ref="1Ch.27.25">1Ch.27.25</ref>).

name: Azmaveth
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Descendant of Saul, son of Jehoaddah
short: Azmaveth, a descendant of Saul, son of Jehoaddah..

name: Azmaveth
description: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: One of David's mighty men, a Barhumite
short: Azmaveth the Barhumite was one of David's mighty men, known for his valor (<ref="2Sa.23.31; 1Ch.11.33">2Sa.23.31; 1Ch.11.33</ref>).

name: Azor
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Ancestor of Jesus Christ in the genealogy of Matthew
short: Azor was an ancestor of Jesus Christ, mentioned in the genealogy of Matthew (<ref="Matt 1:13, 14">Matt 1:13, 14</ref>).

name: Azriel
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Ruler of the tribe of Naphtali under David
short: Azriel son of Jeremoth was the ruler of the tribe of Naphtali during the reign of King David (<ref="1Ch.27.19">1Ch.27.19</ref>).

name: Azriel
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Head of a half-tribe of Manasseh in Gilead
short: Azriel was a head of a father's house in the half-tribe of Manasseh in Gilead (<ref="1Ch.5.24">1Ch.5.24</ref>).

name: Azriel
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Official sent to arrest the prophet Jeremiah
short: Azriel was one of the officials sent by King Jehoiakim to arrest the prophet Jeremiah (<ref="Jer.36.26">Jer.36.26</ref>).

name: Azrikam
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A descendant of David through Jehoiachin.
short: Azrikam was a descendant of David through Jehoiachin.

name: Azrikam
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A descendant of Saul and Jonathan.
short: Azrikam was a descendant of Saul and Jonathan.

name: Azrikam
description: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A Levite living in Jerusalem.
short: Azrikam was a Levite who lived in Jerusalem.

name: Azrikam
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: An official in King Ahaz's household.
short: Azrikam was an official in charge of King Ahaz's palace.

name: Azubah
description: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Wife of Caleb and mother of Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.
short: Azubah was Caleb's wife and the mother of his sons Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.

name: Azubah
description: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: The mother of King Jehoshaphat of Judah.
short: Azubah was the mother of King Jehoshaphat of Judah.

name: Azzan
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Father of Paltiel, a leader from the tribe of Issachar.
short: Azzan was the father of Paltiel, a leader from Issachar chosen to help divide Canaan.

name: Azzur
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Father of the wicked prince Jaazaniah.
short: Azzur was the father of Jaazaniah, one of the wicked princes Ezekiel saw in a vision.

name: Azzur
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Father of the false prophet Hananiah.
short: Azzur was the father of Hananiah, a false prophet who opposed Jeremiah.

name: Azzur
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A leader who sealed Nehemiah's covenant.
short: Azzur was one of the leaders who sealed Nehemiah's covenant.

name: Baal
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A descendant of Reuben.
short: Baal was a descendant of Reuben, the firstborn son of Jacob.

name: Baal
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: A son of Abiel and descendant of Benjamin.
short: Baal was a son of Abiel and a descendant of Benjamin.

name: Baal-hanan
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: An overseer of olive and sycamore trees under David.
short: Baal-hanan the Gederite was in charge of the olive and sycamore trees in the lowlands under David's reign.

name: Baal-hanan
description: King living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: A king of Edom.
short: Baal-hanan was a king of Edom who reigned before Israel had kings.

name: Baalis
description: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: King of the Ammonites during the Babylonian exile.
short: Baalis, the king of the Ammonites, sent Ishmael to assassinate Gedaliah the governor.

name: Baal-zebub
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A Philistine god worshiped at Ekron.
short: Baal-zebub was the god of Ekron whom Ahaziah consulted about his illness.

name: Baana
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: One of Solomon's twelve district governors.
short: Baana son of Ahilud was one of Solomon's twelve district governors.

name: Baana
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: One of Solomon's twelve district governors.
short: Baana son of Hushai governed the territory of Asher and Aloth under Solomon.

name: Baana
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A man who helped repair the wall of Jerusalem.
short: Baana son of Zadok made repairs to a section of Jerusalem's wall.

name: Baanah
description: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: One of David's mighty warriors from Netophah.
short: Baanah the Netophathite was one of David's mighty warriors.

name: Baanah
description: David's compatriots living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: A captain who murdered Ish-bosheth, Saul's son.
short: Baanah and his brother Rechab assassinated Ish-bosheth, hoping to gain favor with David.

name: Baanah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A leader who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian exile.
short: Baanah was one of the leaders who returned with Zerubbabel from Babylon to Jerusalem.

name: Baanah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A leader who sealed Nehemiah's covenant.
short: Baanah was one of the leaders who sealed the covenant during Nehemiah's time.

name: Baara
description: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A wife of Shaharaim, a Benjamite.
short: Baara was one of the wives of Shaharaim, a descendant of Benjamin.

name: Baaseiah
description: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A Levite in the lineage of Gershom.
short: Baaseiah was a Levite descended from Gershom, the son of Levi.

name: Baasha
description: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Third king of Israel who ruled for 24 years.
short: Baasha, son of Ahijah, became king of Israel and reigned for 24 years.

name: Bakbakkar
description: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A Levite who lived in Jerusalem.
short: Bakbakkar was a Levite who resided in Jerusalem.

name: Bakbuk
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Ancestor of temple servants who returned from Babylonian exile.
short: Bakbuk was the ancestor of a family of temple servants who returned from exile.

name: Bakbukiah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A Levite who served in Jerusalem after the exile.
short: Bakbukiah was a Levite who held leadership roles in Jerusalem after the exile.

name: Balaam
description: Prophet living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: A prophet hired to curse Israel but blessed them instead.
short: Balaam was a pagan prophet hired by Balak to curse Israel, but he blessed them instead.

name: Baladan
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Father of Babylonian king Merodach-baladan (or 'Berodach-baladan').
short: Baladan was the father of Merodach-baladan, king of Babylon.

name: Balak
description: King living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: King of Moab who hired Balaam to curse Israel.
short: Balak, son of Zippor, was the king of Moab who tried to curse Israel through Balaam.

name: Bani
description: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A Levite musician in the time of David.
short: Bani was a Levite who served as a musician during David's reign.

name: Bani
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A descendant of Perez from the tribe of Judah.
short: Bani, a descendant of Perez, was among those who settled in Jerusalem.

name: Bani
description: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: One of David's mighty warriors from the tribe of Gad.
short: Bani the Gadite was one of David's mighty warriors.

name: Bani
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: An Israelite who agreed to put away his foreign wife.
short: Bani was one of the men who had married foreign women and agreed to put them away.

name: Bani
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A family group that had married foreign women.
short: The sons of Bani were among those who had married foreign women during Ezra's time.

name: Bani
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Ancestor of a family who returned from Babylonian exile.
short: Bani was the ancestor of a family that returned to Judah from Babylonian captivity.

name: Bani
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A leader who sealed Nehemiah's covenant.
short: Bani was one of the leaders who sealed the covenant during Nehemiah's time.

name: Bani
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A Levite overseer in Jerusalem during Nehemiah's time.
short: Bani was a Levite who served as an overseer in Jerusalem.

name: Bani
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A Levite who helped repair the wall of Jerusalem.
short: Bani, a Levite, made repairs to a section of Jerusalem's wall.

name: Bani
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A Levite who taught the Law and led prayers.
short: Bani (Binnui) was a Levite involved in teaching the Law and leading prayers during Nehemiah's time.

name: Bani
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A Levite who led prayers and sealed Nehemiah's covenant.
short: Bani was a Levite who led prayers of confession and sealed the covenant during Nehemiah's time.

name: Barabbas
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: A notorious prisoner released instead of Jesus.
short: Barabbas, a notorious prisoner, was released by Pilate instead of Jesus at the crowd's demand.

name: Barachel
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: The father of Elihu, one of Job's friends.
short: Barachel the Buzite was the father of Elihu, one of the men who spoke to Job.

name: Barak
description: Judge living before Israel's Monarchy
brief: An Israelite commander who defeated Canaanite forces with Deborah.
short: Barak, son of Abinoam, led the Israelites to victory against Canaanite forces under Deborah's leadership.

name: Bariah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A descendant of David through the line of Solomon.
short: Bariah was a descendant of King David through Solomon's line.

name: Bar-jesus
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: A Jewish sorcerer who opposed Paul and Barnabas.
short: Bar-Jesus, also known as Elymas, was a Jewish sorcerer who tried to hinder Paul and Barnabas' ministry.

name: Barkos
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Ancestor of a family of temple servants who returned from exile.
short: Barkos was the ancestor of a family of temple servants who returned from Babylonian captivity.

name: Barnabas
description: Levite living at the time of the New Testament
brief: A Levite from Cyprus who accompanied Paul on missionary journeys.
short: Barnabas, also known as Joseph or Joses, was a Levite from Cyprus who played a significant role in the early church and accompanied Paul on missionary journeys.

name: Bartholomew
description: Apostle living at the time of the New Testament
brief: One of the twelve apostles of Jesus Christ.
short: Bartholomew was one of the twelve apostles chosen by Jesus.

name: Bartimaeus
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: A blind beggar healed by Jesus near Jericho.
short: Bartimaeus, a blind beggar, was healed by Jesus as He was leaving Jericho.

name: Baruch
description: Jeremiah's servant living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Jeremiah's scribe who recorded and delivered his prophecies.
short: Baruch, son of Neriah, served as Jeremiah's scribe and faithfully recorded and delivered his prophecies.

name: Baruch
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A priest who sealed Nehemiah's covenant.
short: Baruch was a priest who sealed the covenant during Nehemiah's time.

name: Baruch
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A descendant of Judah who settled in Jerusalem.
short: Baruch, a descendant of Perez from the tribe of Judah, settled in Jerusalem after the exile.

name: Baruch
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A man who repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall.
short: Baruch, son of Zabbai, repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall during Nehemiah's time.

name: Barzillai
description: David's compatriot living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: A Gileadite who provided for David during Absalom's rebellion.
short: Barzillai the Gileadite supplied provisions to David during his flight from Absalom and was later honored by the king.

name: Barzillai
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Grandfather of Michal's adopted sons.
short: Barzillai the Meholathite was the grandfather of the five sons Michal adopted.

name: Barzillai
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Ancestor of a priestly family who returned from exile.
short: The descendants of Barzillai were a priestly family who returned from Babylonian exile but could not prove their lineage.

name: Basemath
description: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Wife of Ahimaaz, one of Solomon's district governors.
short: Basemath, daughter of Solomon, was married to Ahimaaz, one of Solomon's twelve district governors.

name: Bathsheba
description: David's wife living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Wife of Uriah, later married David and bore Solomon.
short: Bathsheba, the wife of Uriah, later became David's wife and the mother of Solomon.

name: Bath-shua
description: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Judah's Canaanite wife; mother of Er, Onan, and Shelah.
short: Bath-shua, a Canaanite woman, was Judah's wife and the mother of his first three sons.

name: Bavvai
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A leader who helped repair Jerusalem's wall
short: Bavvai, son of Henadad and ruler of half the district of Keilah, repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall.

name: Bazluth
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Ancestor of temple servants who returned from exile.
short: Bazluth (Bazlith) was the ancestor of a family of temple servants who returned from Babylonian captivity.

name: Bealiah
description: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A Benjamite warrior who joined David at Ziklag.
short: Bealiah, a Benjamite warrior, was one of the men who joined David at Ziklag.

name: Bebai
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Head of a family that returned from Babylonian exile.
short: Bebai was the head of a family that returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian captivity.

name: Bebai
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Ancestor of exiles who returned with Ezra to Jerusalem.
short: Zechariah, a descendant of Bebai, led 28 men of his family to return with Ezra to Jerusalem.

name: Bebai
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A leader who sealed Nehemiah's covenant.
short: Bebai was one of the leaders who sealed the covenant during Nehemiah's time.

name: Becher
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Benjamin, listed among those who entered Egypt.
short: Becher was a son of Benjamin and is listed among the family members who entered Egypt with Jacob.

name: Becher
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: An Ephraimite clan head in the wilderness census.
short: The Becherites, descendants of Becher, were a clan of the tribe of Ephraim during the wilderness census.

name: Becorath
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: An ancestor of King Saul from the tribe of Benjamin.
short: Becorath was an ancestor of King Saul and a member of the tribe of Benjamin.

name: Bedad
description: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Father of Hadad, an Edomite king.
short: Bedad was the father of Hadad, one of the kings of Edom before Israel had a king.

name: Bedan
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A descendant of Manasseh through Machir and Gilead.
short: Bedan was a descendant of Manasseh, listed in the genealogy of Machir and Gilead.

name: Bedeiah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: An Israelite who married a foreign woman during the exile.
short: Bedeiah was one of the Israelites who had married foreign women during the exile and agreed to send them away.

name: Beera
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A descendant of Asher through Zophah.
short: Beera was a descendant of Asher, listed in the genealogy of Zophah.

name: Beerah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A Reubenite leader exiled by the Assyrian king Tiglath-Pileser.
short: Beerah, a leader from the tribe of Reuben, was taken into exile by Tiglath-Pileser, king of Assyria.

name: Beeri
description: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: A Hittite, father of Esau's wife Judith.
short: Beeri the Hittite was the father of Judith, one of Esau's wives.

name: Beeri
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Father of the prophet Hosea.
short: Beeri was the father of Hosea, the prophet who authored the biblical book bearing his name.

name: Bela
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A Reubenite, son of Azaz.
short: Bela, a descendant of Reuben, was the son of Azaz

name: Bela
description: King living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Beor, the first king of Edom.
short: Bela, son of Beor, was the first king to reign in Edom before Israel had a king.

name: Bela
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
briefest: Son of Benjamin and father of Ezbon
brief: Son of Benjamin, head of the Belaite clan
short: Bela was a son of Benjamin and the head of the Belaite clan within the tribe of Benjamin.

name: Belshazzar
description: Emperor living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: The last Emperor of Babylon, son of Nabonidus.
short: Belshazzar, the last Emperor of Babylon, is mentioned in the book of Daniel as the son of Nebuchadnezzar (though historically known as the son of Nabonidus).

name: Ben
description: Singer living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A Levite appointed as a gatekeeper for the ark.
short: Ben, a Levite, was appointed as one of the gatekeepers for the ark during its transfer to Jerusalem.

name: Ben-abinadab
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Solomon's son-in-law, an official in his administration.
short: Ben-abinadab, Solomon's son-in-law, was one of the twelve officials appointed over Israel to provide food for the king and his household.

name: Benaiah
description: Singer living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A Levite musician during the transfer of the ark.
short: Benaiah, a Levite, played the lyre and served as a gatekeeper during the transfer of the ark to Jerusalem.

name: Benaiah

description: Prophet living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Prophet during Babylonian exile; author of the Book of Ezekiel.
short: Ezekiel was a prophet during the Babylonian exile who authored the Book of Ezekiel and served as a sign to the people of Israel.

name: Ezer
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Gadite warrior; joined David at Ziklag.
short: Ezer was a Gadite warrior who joined David at Ziklag when he was fleeing from King Saul.

name: Ezer
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Father or founder of Hushah, of Ephrathah.
short: Ezer was the father or founder of Hushah and a son of Hur of Ephrathah.

name: Ezer
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Ephraim; killed by the men of Gath.
short: Ezer was a son of Ephraim who was killed by the men of Gath while attempting to steal their livestock.

name: Ezer
description: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Horite chief in Seir; son of Seir the Horite.
short: Ezer was a Horite chief in the land of Seir, a son of Seir the Horite.

name: Ezer
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Levite; participated in the dedication of Jerusalem's wall.
short: Ezer was a Levite who participated in the dedication of Jerusalem's wall during the time of Nehemiah.

name: Ezer
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Ruler of Mizpah; repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall.
short: Ezer, the ruler of Mizpah, repaired another section of Jerusalem's wall near the armory.

name: Ezra
description: Priest living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Priest; scribe; led a group of exiles back to Jerusalem.
short: Ezra was a priest and scribe who led a group of Jewish exiles back to Jerusalem and played a key role in the spiritual reformation of the people.

name: Ezra
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Priest; returned from Babylon with Zerubbabel; participated in wall dedication.
short: Ezra was a priest who returned from Babylon with Zerubbabel and participated in the dedication of Jerusalem's wall.

name: Ezrah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Chelub; mentioned in Judah's genealogy.
short: Ezrah was a son of Chelub, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah.

name: Ezri
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Overseer of David's agricultural workers.
short: Ezri was the overseer of King David's agricultural workers who tilled the soil.

name: Felix
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Roman governor of Judea; heard Paul's case.
short: Felix was a Roman governor of Judea who heard the case against Paul and kept him in custody for two years.

name: Festus
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Roman governor of Judea; heard Paul's case; sent him to Rome.
short: Porcius Festus succeeded Felix as the Roman governor of Judea and heard Paul's case, ultimately sending him to Rome for trial.

name: Fortunatus
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Corinthian Christian; visited Paul in Ephesus.
short: Fortunatus was a Corinthian Christian who, along with Stephanas and Achaicus, visited Paul in Ephesus and refreshed his spirit.

name: Gaal
description: Man living before Israel's Monarchy
brief: Son of Ebed; led a revolt against Abimelech.
short: Gaal, the son of Ebed, led a revolt against Abimelech, the ruler of Shechem, but was defeated and driven out of the city.

name: Gabbai
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Benjamite leader who settled in Jerusalem.
short: Gabbai was a Benjamite leader who settled in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

name: Gad
description: Prophet living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Prophet during the reigns of David and Solomon.
short: Gad was a prophet who advised King David and wrote a book of his acts.

name: Gad
description: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Israelite tribe; descended from Gad, son of Jacob.
short: Gad was one of the twelve tribes of Israel, descended from Gad, the son of Jacob, and known for their military prowess and settlement east of the Jordan River.

name: Gaddi
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Susi; representative of Manasseh among the spies.
short: Gaddi, the son of Susi, was the representative of the tribe of Manasseh among the twelve spies sent to explore Canaan.

name: Gaddiel
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Sodi; representative of Zebulun among the spies.
short: Gaddiel, the son of Sodi, was the representative of the tribe of Zebulun among the twelve spies sent to explore Canaan.

name: Gadi
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Father of Menahem, king of Israel.
short: Gadi was the father of Menahem, who became king of Israel after assassinating Shallum.

name: Gaham
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Nahor and Reumah.
short: Gaham was one of the sons born to Nahor, Abraham's brother, and his concubine Reumah.

name: Gahar
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Ancestor of temple servants who returned from Babylonian exile.
short: Gahar was an ancestor of a group of temple servants (Nethinim) who returned to Jerusalem from the Babylonian exile.

name: Gaius
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Recipient of John's third epistle; commended for his faithfulness.
short: Gaius, the recipient of John's third epistle, was commended for his faithfulness to the truth and his hospitality to traveling missionaries.

name: Gaius
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Macedonian; Paul's traveling companion; caught in Ephesian riot.
short: Gaius, a Macedonian and traveling companion of Paul, was seized along with Aristarchus during the riot in Ephesus.

name: Gaius
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Derbean; accompanied Paul on his journey to Jerusalem.
short: Gaius of Derbe accompanied Paul on his journey from Greece to Jerusalem, along with several others.

name: Gaius
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Corinthian believer; host to Paul and the church.
short: Gaius, a Corinthian believer baptized by Paul, hosted Paul and the whole church in his home.

name: Galal
description: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Levite musician; descendant of Asaph; lived in Jerusalem.
short: Galal, a Levite musician and descendant of Asaph, lived in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

name: Galal
description: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Levite musician; descendant of Jeduthun; lived in Jerusalem.
short: Galal, a Levite musician and descendant of Jeduthun, lived in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile and assisted in the temple service.

name: Gallio
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Roman proconsul of Achaia; refused to judge Paul.
short: Gallio, the Roman proconsul of Achaia, refused to judge Paul when the Jews brought charges against him in Corinth.

name: Gamaliel
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Pharisee; teacher of the law; Paul's mentor.
short: Gamaliel, a respected Pharisee and teacher of the law, was Paul's mentor and advised the Sanhedrin to be cautious in their treatment of the apostles.

name: Gamaliel
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Leader of the tribe of Manasseh during the Exodus.
short: Gamaliel, the son of Pedahzur, was the leader of the tribe of Manasseh during the Israelites' journey through the wilderness.

name: Gamul
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Head of a priestly division in David's time.
short: Gamul was the head of the twenty-second priestly division organized during King David's reign.

name: Gareb
description: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: One of David's mighty warriors; an Ithrite.
short: Gareb the Ithrite was one of David's mighty warriors, known for his military prowess.

name: Gatam
description: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Eliphaz; grandson of Esau; Edomite chief.
short: Gatam was a son of Eliphaz, grandson of Esau, and one of the chiefs of Edom.

name: Gazez
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Caleb and his concubine Ephah.
short: Gazez was a son of Caleb and his concubine Ephah, born after Haran.

name: Gazez
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Grandson of Caleb through Haran
short: Gazez was a grandson of Caleb, born to Haran's son Gazez.

name: Gazzam
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Ancestor of temple servants who returned from Babylonian exile.
short: Gazzam was an ancestor of a group of temple servants (Nethinim) who returned to Jerusalem from the Babylonian exile.

name: Geber
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Son of Uri; one of Solomon's twelve district governors.
short: Geber, the son of Uri, was one of the twelve district governors appointed by King Solomon to provide food for the royal household.

name: Gedaliah
description: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Son of Jeduthun; a temple musician during David's reign.
short: Gedaliah, a son of Jeduthun, was one of the temple musicians appointed by King David to prophesy with lyres, harps, and cymbals.

name: Gedaliah
description: Governor living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Appointed governor of Judah by Babylonians; assassinated by Ishmael.
short: Gedaliah, appointed governor of Judah by the Babylonians after the fall of Jerusalem, was assassinated by Ishmael, leading to the flight of the remaining Jews to Egypt.

name: Gedaliah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Priest who married a foreign woman during the Exile.
short: Gedaliah, a priest, was among those who had married foreign women during the Babylonian exile and pledged to put them away.

name: Gedaliah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Pashhur; an official during Zedekiah's reign.
short: Gedaliah, the son of Pashhur, was one of the officials who heard Jeremiah's message and urged King Zedekiah to put him to death.

name: Gedaliah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Grandfather of the prophet Zephaniah.
short: Gedaliah was the grandfather of the prophet Zephaniah, who prophesied during the reign of King Josiah of Judah.

name: Gedor
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Son of Abiel, the founder of Gibeon.
short: Gedor was a son of Abiel (or 'Jeiel'), the  father (ie re-founder) of Gibeon, and an ancestor of King Saul.

name: Gehazi
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Elisha's servant; punished with leprosy for greed and deceit.
short: Gehazi, the servant of the prophet Elisha, was punished with leprosy for his greed and deceit in the matter of Naaman's healing.

name: Gemalli
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Father of Ammiel, the spy from the tribe of Dan.
short: Gemalli was the father of Ammiel, who represented the tribe of Dan as one of the twelve spies sent to explore Canaan.

name: Gemariah
description: Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Hilkiah; messenger sent by Zedekiah to Nebuchadnezzar.
short: Gemariah, the son of Hilkiah, was a messenger sent by King Zedekiah of Judah to deliver a letter to King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon.

name: Gemariah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Shaphan; official during Jehoiakim's reign; opposed burning scroll.
short: Gemariah, the son of Shaphan, was an official during King Jehoiakim's reign who opposed the burning of Jeremiah's scroll.

name: Genubath
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Son of Hadad the Edomite; raised in Pharaoh's palace.
short: Genubath was the son of Hadad the Edomite and was raised in Pharaoh's palace alongside the Pharaoh's own children.

name: Gera
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Bela, grandson of Benjamin.
short: Gera was a son of Bela and a grandson of Benjamin.

name: Gera
description: Man living before Israel's Monarchy
brief: Son of Ehud, a Benjamite.
short: Gera (or Heglam) was a son of Ehud, a Benjamite, and was among those who were carried into exile.

name: Gera
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Benjamite; cursed David during Absalom's rebellion; later sought forgiveness.
short: Gera was a Benjamite who cursed David during Absalom's rebellion but later sought forgiveness when David returned to Jerusalem.

name: Gera
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Descendant of Benjamin; ancestor of Ehud, a judge of Israel.
short: Gera was a descendant of Benjamin and an ancestor of Ehud, a left-handed judge who delivered Israel from Moabite oppression.

name: Gershom
description: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Moses; father of Jonathan, a renegade priest.
short: Gershom was the firstborn son of Moses and Zipporah, and his descendant Jonathan served as a priest for the idolatrous Danites.

name: Gershom
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Descendant of Phinehas; returned to Jerusalem with Ezra.
short: Gershom, a descendant of Phinehas, was among the men who returned to Jerusalem with Ezra after the Babylonian exile.

name: Gershon
description: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Firstborn son of Levi; head of the Gershonite Levites.
short: Gershon was the firstborn son of Levi and the ancestor of the Gershonite Levites, who were responsible for the tabernacle curtains, coverings, and related duties.

name: Geshan
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Jahdai, a descendant of Caleb.
short: Geshan was a son of Jahdai, a wife of Caleb, from the tribe of Judah.

name: Geshem
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Arab opponent of Nehemiah; tried to hinder wall rebuilding.
short: Geshem the Arab, along with Sanballat and Tobiah, opposed Nehemiah's efforts to rebuild the walls of Jerusalem and tried to intimidate and discourage him.

name: Gether
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Aram; grandson of Shem; part of Table of Nations.
short: Gether was a son of Aram and a grandson of Shem, mentioned in the genealogies of the Table of Nations.

name: Geuel
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Machi; representative of Gad among the twelve spies.
short: Geuel, the son of Machi, was the representative of the tribe of Gad among the twelve spies sent by Moses to explore Canaan.

name: Gibea
description: Woman or town of the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: With Machbenah, daughters or towns of Sheva.
short: Gibea, with Machbenah, daughters or cities founded by Sheva.

name: Giddalti
description: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Heman; a temple musician during David's reign.
short: Giddalti was one of the sons of Heman, appointed by King David as a temple musician to prophesy with lyres, harps, and cymbals.

name: Giddel
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Ancestor of temple servants who returned from Babylonian exile.
short: Giddel was an ancestor of a group of temple servants (Nethinim) who returned to Jerusalem from the Babylonian exile.

name: Giddel
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Ancestor of Solomon's servants who returned from Babylonian exile.
short: Giddel was an ancestor of a group of Solomon's servants who returned to Jerusalem from the Babylonian exile.

name: Gideon
description: Judge living before Israel's Monarchy
brief: Judge of Israel; defeated Midianites; tested and reassured by God.
short: Gideon, also called Jerubbaal or Jerubbesheth, was a judge of Israel who, with God's help, defeated the Midianites and delivered Israel from oppression.

name: Gideoni
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Leader of the tribe of Benjamin during the Exodus.
short: Gideoni, the son of Abidan, was the leader of the tribe of Benjamin during the Israelites' journey through the wilderness.

name: Gilalai
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Priest and musician during the dedication of Jerusalem's wall.
short: Gilalai was a priest and musician who participated in the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem during Nehemiah's time.

name: Gilead
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Descendant of Manasseh; son of Michael; father of Jaroah.
short: Gilead, a descendant of Manasseh, was the son of Michael and the father of Jaroah, as recorded in the genealogy of the tribe of Gad.

name: Gilead
description: Man living before Israel's Monarchy
brief: Father of Jephthah, a judge of Israel.
short: Gilead was the father of Jephthah, a mighty warrior and judge of Israel who delivered the Israelites from the Ammonites.

name: Gilead
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Machir; grandson of Manasseh; father of six sons.
short: Gilead was the son of Machir, grandson of Manasseh, and father of six sons who became the heads of Gileadite clans.

name: Ginath
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Father of Tibni, who opposed Omri for kingship.
short: Ginath was the father of Tibni, who contended with Omri for the throne of Israel.

name: Ginnethon
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A priest who sealed the covenant during Nehemiah's time.
short: Ginnethon, a priest, was among those who sealed the covenant during Nehemiah's reforms.

name: Gishpa
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: An overseer of the temple servants during Nehemiah's time.
short: Gishpa was an overseer of the temple servants (Nethinim) during Nehemiah's time.

name: Gog
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: A descendant of Reuben, son of Joel.
short: Gog, a descendant of Reuben, is mentioned in the genealogy of Reuben in <ref="1Ch.5.4">1Ch.5.4</ref>.

name: Goliath
description: Giant living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: A Philistine giant defeated by David.
short: Goliath was the Philistine champion from Gath who was defeated by David in a battle.

name: Gomer
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Japheth; father of Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.
short: Gomer, a son of Japheth, was the father of Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah, as listed in the Table of Nations.

name: Gomer
description: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Hosea's wife, a promiscuous woman.
short: Gomer, the daughter of Diblaim, was the wife of the prophet Hosea.

name: Guni
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A descendant of Gad; father of Abdiel.
short: Guni, a descendant of Gad, was the father of Abdiel, as mentioned in the genealogy of Gad.

name: Guni
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Naphtali, grandson of Jacob.
short: Guni was a son of Naphtali and a grandson of Jacob, as listed in the genealogies of Genesis and Numbers.

name: Haahashtari
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A descendant of Judah through Hezron.
short: Haahashtari was a descendant of Judah through Hezron, as listed in the genealogy in 1 Chronicles.

name: Habaiah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A priest whose descendants were unable to prove their lineage.
short: Habaiah was a priest whose descendants were excluded from the priesthood due to insufficient genealogical records.

name: Habakkuk
description: Prophet living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A prophet who questioned God's justice.
short: Habakkuk, a prophet, wrote the book bearing his name, which records his dialogue with God about justice and faith.

name: Habazziniah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Grandfather of Jaazaniah, a Rechabite leader.
short: Habazziniah was the grandfather of Jaazaniah, a leader of the Rechabites during Jeremiah's time.

name: Hacaliah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Father of Nehemiah, the governor of Judah.
short: Hacaliah was the father of Nehemiah, who served as the governor of Judah during the Persian period.

name: Hachmoni
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Father of Jehiel, one of David's family servants.
short: Hachmoni was the father of Jehiel who, with Jonathan attended King David's sons.

name: Hadad
description: King living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: An Edomite prince who opposed Solomon.
short: Hadad, an Edomite prince, fled to Egypt and later became an adversary to King Solomon.

name: Hadad
description: Arabian living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: A son of Ishmael, Abraham's son.
short: Hadad was one of the twelve sons of Ishmael, Abraham's son.

name: Hadad
description: King living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: King of Edom, succeeded Husham.
short: Hadad, son of Bedad, became king of Edom after Husham's death.

name: Hadad
description: King living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: The last king of Edom before Israelite rule.
short: Hadad, also known as Hadar, was the last king of Edom before the Israelites established their monarchy.

name: Hadadezer
description: King living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: King of Zobah, defeated by David.
short: Hadadezer, king of Zobah, was defeated by King David in battle, and his allies, the Arameans, became subject to Israel.

name: Hadlai
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Father of Amasa, who opposed taking captives from Judah.
short: Hadlai was the father of Amasa, who opposed taking captives from Judah during the reign of King Ahaz.

name: Hadoram
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Joktan, a descendant of Shem.
short: Hadoram was a son of Joktan and a descendant of Shem, mentioned in the genealogies of Genesis and 1 Chronicles.

name: Hagab
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A temple servant who returned from Babylonian exile.
short: Hagab was among the temple servants who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian captivity, as recorded in Ezra.

name: Hagabah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A temple servant who returned from Babylonian exile.
short: Hagabah, also known as Hagaba, was among the temple servants who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian captivity.

name: Hagar
description: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Sarah's Egyptian maidservant; mother of Ishmael.
short: Hagar, Sarah's Egyptian maidservant, bore Abraham a son named Ishmael and is also mentioned in Paul's allegory in Galatians.

name: Haggai
description: Prophet living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A prophet who encouraged the rebuilding of the temple.
short: Haggai, a prophet during the post-exilic period, urged the people to rebuild the temple in Jerusalem.

name: Haggedolim
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A priest mentioned in Nehemiah's time.
short: Haggedolim was a priest during the time of Nehemiah, mentioned in the list of priests and Levites.

name: Haggi
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Gad, grandson of Jacob.
short: Haggi was a son of Gad and a grandson of Jacob, mentioned in the genealogies of Genesis and Numbers.

name: Haggiah
description: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A Levite, descendant of Merari.
short: Haggiah, a Levite descended from Merari, is mentioned in the genealogy of the Levites in 1 Chronicles.

name: Haggith
description: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: One of David's wives; mother of Adonijah.
short: Haggith was one of King David's wives and the mother of Adonijah, who attempted to claim the throne.

name: Hagri
description: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A Gadite, father of Mibhar, one of David's mighty men.
short: Hagri was the father of Mibhar, one of David's mighty men from the tribe of Gad.

name: Hakkatan
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Father of Johanan, a leader who returned from Babylon.
short: Hakkatan was the father of Johanan, a leader who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian exile.

name: Hakkoz
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A priest in the time of David.
short: Hakkoz was a priest who served during the reign of King David, as mentioned in the priestly divisions.

name: Hakkoz
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A post-exilic priest whose descendants were excluded from the priesthood.
short: Hakkoz was a priest whose descendants were unable to prove their priestly lineage after the Babylonian exile.

name: Hakkoz
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A priest who helped repair the wall of Jerusalem.
short: Hakkoz, a priest, was involved in repairing sections of the wall of Jerusalem during Nehemiah's time.

name: Hakupha
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A temple servant who returned from Babylonian exile.
short: Hakupha was among the temple servants who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian captivity.

name: Hallohesh
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Father of Shallum, a leader who helped repair Jerusalem's wall.
short: Hallohesh was the father of Shallum, a leader who helped repair the wall of Jerusalem during Nehemiah's time.

name: Ham
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: One of Noah's three sons, father of Canaan.
short: Ham, one of Noah's three sons, was the father of Canaan and the ancestor of various nations.

name: Haman
description: Persian living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A Persian official who plotted to destroy the Jews.
short: Haman, a high-ranking Persian official, conspired to kill all the Jews in the empire but was ultimately thwarted by Queen Esther and Mordecai.

name: Hammath
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A Kenite clan, descendants of Salma.
short: Hammath was a Kenite clan, listed among the descendants of Salma, the  father (ie founder) of Bethlehem.

name: Hammedatha
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: The father of Haman, the enemy of the Jews.
short: Hammedatha was the father of Haman, the Persian official who plotted to destroy the Jews in the book of Esther.

name: Hammelech
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Father of Jerahmeel and Malchijah (or 'Malchiah'), officials during Jeremiah's time.
short: Hammelech, meaning "the king," was the father of Jerahmeel and Malchijah (or 'Malchiah'), officials mentioned in the book of Jeremiah.

name: Hammolecheth
description: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Sister of Gilead; mother of Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.
short: Hammolecheth, the sister of Gilead, was the mother of Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.

name: Hammuel
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Mishma, a descendant of Simeon.
short: Hammuel, a descendant of Simeon, was the son of Mishma.

name: Hamor
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: A Hivite prince, father of Shechem.
short: Hamor, a Hivite prince, was the father and founder of Shechem and negotiated with Jacob's sons after Shechem's assault on Dinah.

name: Hamul
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Perez, grandson of Judah.
short: Hamul was a son of Perez and a grandson of Judah, mentioned in the genealogies of Genesis, Numbers, and 1 Chronicles.

name: Hamutal
description: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Mother of Jehoahaz and Zedekiah, kings of Judah.
short: Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah, was the mother of Jehoahaz and Zedekiah, two kings of Judah.

name: Hanamel
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Jeremiah's cousin, from whom he bought a field.
short: Hanamel, Jeremiah's cousin, sold a field to the prophet as a sign of future restoration during the Babylonian siege.

name: Hanan
description: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: One of David's mighty warriors, son of Maacah.
short: Hanan, the son of Maacah, was one of King David's mighty warriors.

name: Hanan
