description: Tetrarch living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Tetrarch of Galilee during Jesus' ministry.
short: Herod Antipas was the tetrarch of Galilee during Jesus' ministry and played a role in Jesus' trial.

name: Herod
description: King Herod the Great: Ruler living at the time of the New Testament
brief: The Great, Roman-appointed king of Judea during Jesus' birth.
short: Herod the Great was the Roman-appointed king of Judea who ruled during the time of Jesus' birth.

name: Herodias
description: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Wife of Herod Antipas who had John beheaded.
short: Herodias was the wife of Herod Antipas, who had John the Baptist beheaded at her request.

name: Herodion
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: A relative of Paul in Rome.
short: Herodion was a relative of Paul in Rome to whom Paul sent greetings.

name: Hesed
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: A district overseer under Solomon.
short: Hesed was one of the twelve district overseers who provided supplies for King Solomon and his household.

name: Heth
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Canaan and ancestor of the Hittites.
short: Heth was a son of Canaan and the ancestor of the Hittites, a prominent people group in the ancient Near East.

name: Hezekiah
description: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A righteous king of Judah.
short: Hezekiah was a king of Judah who instituted religious reforms and trusted in God during the Assyrian invasion.

name: Hezekiah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Ancestor of exiles who returned to Jerusalem.
short: Hezekiah was an ancestor of exiles who returned to Jerusalem.

name: Hezekiah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A clan leader who returned from Babylonian exile.
short: Hezekiah was a clan leader among the exiles who returned to Jerusalem from Babylon.

name: Hezekiah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Ancestor of the prophet Zephaniah
short: Hezekiah was an ancestor of the prophet Zephaniah.

name: Hezion
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Grandfather of Ben-Hadad, king of Aram.
short: Hezion was the grandfather of Ben-Hadad I, the king of Aram during the reign of Asa, king of Judah.

name: Hezir
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A priest in the time of David.
short: Hezir was a priest who was assigned the 17th division of priestly service in the time of King David.

name: Hezir
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A priest who sealed the covenant.
short: Hezir was one of the priests who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah to follow the Law of God.

name: Hezro
description: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: One of David's mighty men.
short: Hezro the Carmelite was one of David's mighty men, known for his valor and military prowess.

name: Hezron
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Perez, grandson of Judah, ancestor of David.
short: Hezron was the son of Perez and grandson of Judah, and his descendants formed the Hezronite clan within the tribe of Judah.

name: Hezron
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Reuben and grandson of Jacob.
short: Hezron was a son of Reuben, the firstborn of Jacob, and his descendants formed a clan within the tribe of Reuben.

name: Hiddai
description: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: One of David's mighty men from Gaash.
short: Hiddai (also called Hurai) from the brooks of Gaash was one of David's mighty men, known for his valor and military prowess.

name: Hiel
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: The Bethelite who rebuilt Jericho.
short: Hiel the Bethelite rebuilt Jericho during the reign of King Ahab, fulfilling Joshua's curse on the city.

name: Hilkiah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A Levite gatekeeper during David's reign.
short: Hilkiah was a Levite who served as a gatekeeper in the tabernacle during the reign of King David.

name: Hilkiah
description: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A Levite descendant of Merari.
short: Hilkiah was a Levite from the family of Merari, mentioned in the genealogy of the Levites.

name: Hilkiah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: An official during King Hezekiah's reign.
short: Hilkiah served as a high-ranking official in the court of King Hezekiah of Judah.

name: Hilkiah
description: High Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: The high priest who discovered the Book of the Law.
short: Hilkiah, the high priest during King Josiah's reign, discovered the Book of the Law in the temple, sparking a religious reform.

name: Hilkiah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: The father of the prophet Jeremiah.
short: Hilkiah, a priest from Anathoth, was the father of the prophet Jeremiah.

name: Hilkiah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A priest who returned from Babylonian exile.
short: Hilkiah was among the priests who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian captivity and served during the high priesthood of Jeshua and Joiakim.

name: Hilkiah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A priest who assisted Ezra.
short: Hilkiah was one of the priests who stood beside Ezra when he read the Book of the Law to the people.

name: Hillel
description: Man living before Israel's Monarchy
brief: Fatther of the judge Abdon
short: Hillel the Pirathonite, a father of judge Abdon of Israel, led the nation for ten years.

name: Hirah
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Judah's Adullamite friend.
short: Hirah was an Adullamite who was a close friend of Judah, the son of Jacob.

name: Hiram
description: Syrian living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: A skilled craftsman from Tyre.
short: Hiram, a skilled craftsman from Tyre, was commissioned by Solomon to create the bronze furnishings for the temple.

name: Hiram
description: King living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: King of Tyre, ally of David and Solomon.
short: Hiram, king of Tyre, provided materials and craftsmen for the construction of David's palace and Solomon's temple and palace.

name: Hizki
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A Benjamite descendant of Elpaal.
short: Hizki was a descendant of Elpaal from the tribe of Benjamin.

name: Hizkiah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A descendant of David through Jeconiah.
short: Hizkiah was one of the descendants of King David through the line of Jeconiah.

name: Hobab
description: Midianite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Moses' brother-in-law, a Midianite.
short: Hobab, the son of Jethro (or 'Reuel') the Midianite and Moses' brother-in-law, was invited by Moses to join the Israelites on their journey to the Promised Land.

name: Hod
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A descendant of Asher.
short: Hod was a descendant of Asher, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Asher.

name: Hodaviah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A descendant of David through Jeconiah.
short: Hodaviah (also known as Hodaiah) was one of the descendants of King David through the line of Jeconiah.

name: Hodaviah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A leader of the half-tribe of Manasseh.
short: Hodaviah was one of the leaders of the half-tribe of Manasseh during the time of King David.

name: Hodaviah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A Benjamite who lived in Jerusalem.
short: Hodaviah was a descendant of Benjamin who resided in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

name: Hodaviah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A Levite who returned from exile.
short: Hodaviah (also known as Hodevah or Judah) was a Levite who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian captivity and assisted in rebuilding the temple.

name: Hodesh
description: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Wife of Shaharaim, a Benjamite
short: Hodesh was one of the wives of Shaharaim, a Benjamite, and the mother of several of his children.

name: Hodiah
description: Woman (?) living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Wife of a Judahite named Ishbar.
short: Hodiah was the wife of Ishbar, a descendant of Judah, and the mother two clans.

name: Hodiah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A leader who signed Nehemiah's covenant.
short: Hodiah was one of the leaders of the people who signed the covenant led by Nehemiah to follow the Law of God.

name: Hodiah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A priest who signed Nehemiah's covenant.
short: Hodiah was one of the priests who signed the covenant led by Nehemiah to follow the Law of God.

name: Hodiah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A Levite involved in teaching and worship.
short: Hodiah (also known as Judah) was a Levite who assisted in teaching the Law and leading worship during the time of Ezra and Nehemiah.

name: Hoglah
description: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Daughter of Zelophehad, of the tribe of Manasseh.
short: Hoglah was one of the five daughters of Zelophehad who received an inheritance in the Promised Land due to their father's lack of male heirs.

name: Hoham
description: King living before Israel's Monarchy
brief: King of Hebron, defeated by Joshua.
short: Hoham, the Amorite king of Hebron, was one of the five kings who formed an alliance against Joshua and the Israelites, but was ultimately defeated.

name: Hophni
description: Priest living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: A corrupt priest, son of Eli.
short: Hophni, along with his brother Phinehas, was a corrupt priest who served under his father Eli at the tabernacle in Shiloh.

name: Hophra
description: Pharaoh living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Pharaoh during Jeremiah's time.
short: Hophra, also known as Pharaoh Apries, was the king of Egypt during the time of the prophet Jeremiah and the Babylonian invasion of Judah.

name: Horam
description: King living before Israel's Monarchy
brief: King of Gezer, defeated by Joshua.
short: Horam, the king of Gezer, came to help Lachish but was defeated by Joshua and the Israelites.

name: Hori
description: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: A Horite people group.
short: The Horites were a people group who inhabited the region of Seir before the Edomites.

name: Hori
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: A spy from the tribe of Simeon.
short: Hori, the son of Shaphat, was one of the twelve spies sent by Moses to explore the land of Canaan.

name: Hosah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A Levite gatekeeper during David's reign.
short: Hosah was a Levite who served as a gatekeeper at the tabernacle during the reign of King David.

name: Hosea
description: Prophet living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A prophet to the northern kingdom of Israel.
short: Hosea was a prophet who ministered to the northern kingdom of Israel during the reigns of several kings, calling the people to repent and return to God.

name: Hoshaiah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A military leader during Jeremiah's time.
short: Hoshaiah, the son of Maaseiah, was one of the military leaders who sought Jeremiah's counsel after the fall of Jerusalem but later disobeyed his prophetic warning.

name: Hoshaiah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A leader during the dedication of Jerusalem's wall.
short: Hoshaiah was one of the leaders who participated in the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem during the time of Nehemiah.

name: Hoshama
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A descendant of King Jeconiah of Judah.
short: Hoshama was a descendant of Jeconiah, the exiled king of Judah, according to the genealogy in 1 Chronicles.

name: Hoshea
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Leader of the half-tribe of Ephraim.
short: Hoshea, the son of Azaziah, was the leader of the half-tribe of Ephraim during King David's reign.

name: Hoshea
description: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: The last king of Israel (northern kingdom).
short: Hoshea was the last king of Israel, reigning from around 732 to 722 BC, until the Assyrian conquest of Samaria.

name: Hoshea
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A leader who sealed Nehemiah's covenant.
short: Hoshea was one of the leaders of the people who signed the covenant led by Nehemiah to follow the Law of God.

name: Hotham
description: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: One of David's mighty warriors from Aroer.
short: Hotham the Aroerite was listed among David's mighty warriors known for their military exploits.

name: Hotham
description: Man living before Israel's Monarchy
brief: A descendant of Asher.
short: Hotham, also known as Helem, was a descendant of Asher mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Asher.

name: Hothir
description: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A son of Heman, a musician in David's court.
short: Hothir was one of the fourteen sons of Heman, appointed by King David to lead worship in the temple.

name: huge man
description: Giant living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: A huge man from Gath, killed by David's warriors.
short: A huge man from Gath, possibly a descendant of the Rephaim, was killed by David's warriors during a battle with the Philistines.

name: Hul
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: A son of Aram, grandson of Shem.
short: Hul was one of the sons of Aram and a grandson of Shem, mentioned in the genealogies of Genesis and 1 Chronicles.

name: Huldah
description: Prophetess living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A prophetess during the reign of King Josiah.
short: Huldah was a prophetess who was consulted by King Josiah's officials regarding the authenticity of the Book of the Law discovered during temple repairs.

name: Huppah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A priest during David's reign.
short: Huppah was a priest who was assigned the thirteenth division of priestly service during King David's reign.

name: Huppim
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: A descendant of Manasseh.
short: Huppim is mentioned in the genealogy of Manasseh as a descendant of Ir or as a son of Machir.

name: Huppim
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: A descendant of Benjamin.
short: Huppim, also known as Hupham or Huram, was a descendant of Benjamin mentioned in the genealogies of Genesis, Numbers, and 1 Chronicles.

name: Hur
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: One of Solomon's twelve district governors.
short: Hur was one of the twelve district governors appointed by King Solomon to oversee the provision of food for the royal household.

name: Hur
description: Aaron's compatriot living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: A companion of Moses and grandfather of Bezalel.
short: Hur was a prominent figure during the Israelites' journey in the wilderness, serving as a support to Moses and the grandfather of Bezalel, the chief artisan of the tabernacle.

name: Hur
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A ruler who helped repair Jerusalem's wall.
short: Hur, the ruler of half the district of Jerusalem, was involved in repairing a section of Jerusalem's wall during Nehemiah's time.

name: Hur
description: King living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: A Midianite king killed by the Israelites.
short: Hur was one of the five Midianite kings slain by the Israelites during the time of Moses.

name: Huri
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A descendant of Gad.
short: Huri was a descendant of Gad, mentioned in the genealogy of the Gadites.

name: Hushah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A son or town founded by Ezer.
short: Hushah was either a descendant of Judah or a town founded by Ezer in the tribe of.

name: Hushai
description: David's compatriot living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: David's friend and advisor who helped him during Absalom's rebellion.
short: Hushai the Arkite was a loyal friend and advisor to King David, who helped him during Absalom's rebellion by countering the advice of Ahithophel.

name: Husham
description: King living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: A king of Edom.
short: Husham was a king of Edom who reigned before the Israelites had kings, according to the genealogies in Genesis and 1 Chronicles.

name: Hushim
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A son of Aher, from the tribe of Dan.
short: Hushim, a son of Aher, is mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Dan in 1 Chronicles.

name: Hushim
description: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A son of Shaharaim, a Benjamite.
short: Hushim was one of the sons of Shaharaim, a Benjamite, born to him in the country of Moab.

name: Hushim
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Dan, ancestor of the Shuhamites.
short: Hushim, also known as Shuham, was the son of Dan and the ancestor of the Shuhamite clan within the tribe of Dan.

name: Hymenaeus
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: A man who rejected faith and good conscience.
short: Hymenaeus was a man who had rejected the faith and was handed over to Satan by Paul so that he might learn not to blaspheme.

name: Ibhar
description: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: One of King David's sons born in Jerusalem.
short: Ibhar was one of the sons born to David in Jerusalem, as recorded in 2 Samuel and 1 Chronicles.

name: Ibneiah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A Benjamite who lived in Jerusalem.
short: Ibneiah, a descendant of Benjamin, was one of the Israelites who resettled in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

name: Ibnijah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A Benjamite who lived in Jerusalem.
short: Ibnijah, a descendant of Benjamin, was one of the Israelites who resettled in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

name: Ibri
description: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A Levite of the family of Merari.
short: Ibri was a Levite of the family of Merari, mentioned in the context of the divisions of the Levitical priests during the reign of King David.

name: Ibsam
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: A descendant of Issachar.
short: Ibsam was a descendant of Issachar, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Issachar in 1 Chronicles.

name: Ibzan
description: Judge living before Israel's Monarchy
brief: A judge of Israel from Bethlehem.
short: Ibzan was a judge of Israel who led the nation for seven years, had thirty sons and thirty daughters, and was buried in Bethlehem.

name: Ichabod
description: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Son of Phinehas, born when the ark was captured.
short: Ichabod was the son of Phinehas, born when the ark of God was captured by the Philistines and named to reflect the departure of glory from Israel.

name: Idbash
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: A descendant of Judah.
short: Idbash was a descendant of Judah, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah in 1 Chronicles.

name: Iddo
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Zechariah's son, a leader of Manasseh
short: Iddo, the son of Zechariah, was a leader of the half-tribe of Manasseh during King David's reign.

name: Iddo
description: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A Levite in the genealogy of temple singers
short: Iddo (or Adaiah), a Levite in the genealogy of the temple singers.

name: Iddo
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Abinadab's son, an official under King Solomon
short: Iddo, the son of Abinadab, was an official in Mahanaim during King Solomon's reign.

name: Iddo
description: Prophet living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A seer and prophet during the divided monarchy
short: Iddo, a seer and prophet who recorded the events of the reigns of Solomon, Rehoboam, and Abijah.

name: Iddo
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Zechariah's grandfather, a priest and prophet in post-exilic Judah
short: Iddo, the grandfather of the prophet Zechariah, was a priest and prophet in post-exilic Judah.

name: Iddo
description: Prophet living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A prophet in Casiphia during Ezra's time.
short: Iddo was a prophet in Casiphia to whom Ezra sent a message requesting Levites to assist in the temple service.

name: Iddo
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A priest during the time of Zerubbabel.
short: Iddo, also known as Adaia, was a priest who returned to Jerusalem with Zerubbabel and was head of a priestly family during the time of Joiakim.

name: Igal
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A descendant of David.
short: Igal was a descendant of King David, mentioned in the genealogy of David's descendants through his son Jeconiah.

name: Igal
description: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: One of David's mighty warriors.
short: Igal son of Nathan of Zobah was listed among David's mighty warriors known for their military prowess and bravery.

name: Igal
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: A scout from the tribe of Issachar.
short: Igal son of Joseph, from the tribe of Issachar, was one of the twelve scouts sent by Moses to explore Canaan.

name: Igdaliah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A man of God during Jeremiah's time.
short: Igdaliah, a man of God, was associated with a chamber in the house of the Lord during the time of the prophet Jeremiah.

name: Ikkesh
description: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Father of Ira, one of David's mighty warriors.
short: Ikkesh the Tekoite was the father of Ira, one of King David's mighty warriors and a leader in his army.

name: Imlah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Father of the prophet Micaiah.
short: Imlah was the father of Micaiah, a prophet who spoke the truth to King Ahab of Israel, despite the king's displeasure.

name: Immer
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A priestly division and its descendants.
short: Immer was the name of a priestly division during the time of David, and his descendants served as priests in the post-exilic period.

name: Immer
description: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A priestly family in post-exilic Jerusalem.
short: The descendants of Immer were a priestly family who lived in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile, as recorded in 1 Chronicles and Nehemiah.

name: Immer
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Man who repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall
short: Immer was one of the people who helped repair the wall of Jerusalem during Nehemiah's time.

name: Imna
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A descendant of Asher.
short: Imna was a descendant of Asher, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Asher in 1 Chronicles.

name: Imnah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A Levite during Hezekiah's reign.
short: Imnah, a Levite, was appointed as an overseer of the freewill offerings during the religious reforms of King Hezekiah.

name: Imnah
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: A son of Asher and ancestor of the Imnites.
short: Imnah was a son of Asher and the ancestor of the Imnite clan within the tribe of Asher.

name: Imrah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A descendant of Asher.
short: Imrah was a descendant of Asher, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Asher in 1 Chronicles.

name: Imri
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A descendant of Judah who lived in Jerusalem.
short: Imri, a descendant of Perez from the tribe of Judah, was among those who settled in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

name: Imri
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Father of Zaccur, helped rebuild Jerusalem's wall.
short: Imri was the father of Zaccur, who helped rebuild the wall of Jerusalem.

name: Iphdeiah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Descendant of Benjamin through Shashak.
short: Iphdeiah was a descendant of Benjamin through Shashak.

name: Ir
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Bela, descendant of Benjamin.
short: Ir was a son of Bela and descendant of Benjamin.

name: Ira
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: David's priest, a Jairite.
short: Ira the Jairite was a priest under King David.

name: Ira
description: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: One of David's Thirty warriors, from Tekoa.
short: Ira the Tekoite was one of King David's Thirty mighty warriors.

name: Ira
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: One of David's Thirty warriors, an Ithrite.
short: Ira the Ithrite was one of King David's Thirty mighty warriors.

name: Irad
description: Man living at the time before the Flood
brief: Descendant of Cain; father of Mehujael.
short: Irad was a descendant of Cain and the father of Mehujael.

name: Iram
description: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Edomite chief, descendant of Esau.
short: Iram was an Edomite chief, a descendant of Esau.

name: Iri
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Bela, grandson of Benjamin.
short: Iri was a son of Bela and grandson of Benjamin.

name: Irijah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Captain who arrested Jeremiah for desertion.
short: Irijah, a captain, arrested Jeremiah on suspicion of desertion to the Babylonians.

name: Iru
description: Man living before Israel's Monarchy
brief: Son of Caleb, brother of Elah and Naam.
short: Iru was a son of Caleb, along with his brothers Elah and Naam.

name: Isaac
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Abraham; father of Jacob and Esau.
short: Isaac was the son of Abraham and Sarah, and the father of Jacob and Esau. God made a covenant with him, renewing the promises given to Abraham.

name: Isaiah
description: Prophet living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Prophet during reigns of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, Hezekiah.
short: Isaiah was a prophet in Judah during the reigns of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah. His prophecies are recorded in the biblical book bearing his name.

name: Iscah
description: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Daughter of Haran, Milcah's sister, Lot's sister.
short: Iscah was the daughter of Haran and sister of Milcah and Lot.

name: Ishbah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Mered in the genealogy of Judah
short: Ishbah's sons were the  father (ie founder) of Eshtemoa and Keilah, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah..

name: Ishbak
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Abraham and Keturah.
short: Ishbak was a son of Abraham and his concubine Keturah.

name: Ishbi-benob
description: Giant living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Philistine giant who fought against David's men.
short: Ishbi-benob, a Philistine giant, was killed by David's warrior Abishai when he threatened David's life.

name: Ish-bosheth
description: Saul's son living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Son of Saul, king over Israel.
short: Ish-bosheth (also called Eshbaal), Saul's son, was made king over Israel by Abner but was ultimately assassinated, leading to David's rule over all Israel.

name: Ishhod
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Hammoleketh, Manasseh's sister.
short: Ishhod was the son of Hammoleketh, who was the sister of Manasseh.

name: Ishi
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Appaim, descendant of Judah.
short: Ishi was a descendant of Judah through Appaim.

name: Ishi
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Shimon, descendant of Judah.
short: Ishi was a son of Shimon, a descendant of Judah.

name: Ishi
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Leader of Simeonites who attacked Hamites in Gedor.
short: Ishi was one of the leaders of the Simeonites who attacked the Hamites in Gedor during the days of Hezekiah.

name: Ishi
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Head of a father's house in Manasseh.
short: Ishi was a head of a father's house in the half-tribe of Manasseh.

name: Ishma
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Hur, descendant of Judah.
short: Ishma was a son of Hur, a descendant of Judah.

name: Ishmael
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Descendant of Benjamin through Saul's line.
short: Ishmael was a descendant of Benjamin through King Saul's line.

name: Ishmael
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Judah's leader under King Jehoshaphat.
short: Ishmael son of Jehohanan was a leader in Judah during King Jehoshaphat's reign.

name: Ishmael
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Jehohanan; supported Joash as king.
short: Ishmael was the son of Jehohanan, who supported Jehoiada in making Joash king.

name: Ishmael
description: Jeremiah's adversary living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Assassinated Gedaliah the governor; led captives to Ammon.
short: Ishmael, son of Nethaniah, assassinated Gedaliah the governor and led captives to Ammon before being pursued by Johanan.

name: Ishmael
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Priest who married a foreign woman during Ezra's time.
short: Ishmael was a priest who had married a foreign woman and pledged to put her away during Ezra's reforms.

name: Ishmael
description: Abraham's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Abraham and Hagar; father of Arab tribes.
short: Ishmael, the son of Abraham and Hagar, was the ancestor of various Arab tribes. Though not the chosen heir, he was still blessed by God.

name: Ishmaiah
description: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Gibeonite warrior who joined David at Ziklag.
short: Ishmaiah the Gibeonite was a mighty warrior among the Thirty who joined David at Ziklag.

name: Ishmaiah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Leader of the tribe of Zebulun under David.
short: Ishmaiah son of Obadiah was the leader of the tribe of Zebulun during King David's reign.

name: Ishmerai
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Descendant of Benjamin through Elpaal.
short: Ishmerai was a descendant of Benjamin through Elpaal.

name: Ishpah
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Descendant of Benjamin through Beriah.
short: Ishpah was a descendant of Benjamin through Beriah.

name: Ishpan
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Descendant of Benjamin through Shashak.
short: Ishpan was a descendant of Benjamin through Shashak.

name: Ishvah
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Asher, grandson of Jacob.
short: Ishvah was a son of Asher and grandson of Jacob.

name: Ishvi
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Asher, grandson of Jacob.
short: Ishvi (or Isui) was a son of Asher and grandson of Jacob.

name: Ismachiah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Overseer under King Hezekiah during temple restoration.
short: Ismachiah was one of the overseers appointed by King Hezekiah during the restoration of the temple and its services.

name: Israel
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes
short: Israel, also named Jacob, was the son of Isaac, the father of the twelve tribes of Israel, and a key patriarch of the Jewish people.

name: Issachar
description: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Son of Obed-Edom, a gatekeeper in David's time.
short: Issachar was a son of Obed-Edom, a gatekeeper in the time of King David.

name: Issachar
description: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Jacob and Leah, forefather of tribe
short: Issachar was the ninth son of Jacob and fifth by Leah, and he became the forefather of the Israelite tribe of Issachar.

name: Isshiah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Korahite warrior who joined David at Ziklag.
short: Isshiah the Korahite was one of the warriors who joined David at Ziklag.

name: Isshiah
description: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Levite, grandson of Rehabiah during David's reign.
short: Isshiah was a Levite, the son of Rehabiah and grandson of Moses, who served during King David's reign.

name: Isshiah
description: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Levite, descendant of Rehabiah during David's reign.
short: Isshiah (or Jeshaiah) was a Levite, a descendant of Rehabiah, who served during King David's reign.

name: Isshiah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Izrahiah, descendant of Issachar.
short: Isshiah was a son of Izrahiah and a descendant of Issachar.

name: Isshijah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Descendant of Harim; agreed to put away foreign wife.
short: Isshijah, a descendant of Harim, was among those who agreed to put away their foreign wives during Ezra's reforms.

name: Ithamar
description: Priest living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Youngest son of Aaron; served as priest.
short: Ithamar was the fourth and youngest son of Aaron, who served as a priest alongside his brothers Nadab, Abihu, and Eleazar.

name: Ithiel
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Descendant of Benjamin living in Jerusalem.
short: Ithiel, a descendant of Benjamin, was among those who settled in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

name: Ithiel
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Mentioned in Agur's sayings; meaning uncertain.
short: Ithiel is mentioned twice in <ref="Proverbs 30:1">Proverbs 30:1</ref>, but the meaning and context of the name are uncertain.

name: Ithmah
description: Moabite warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Moabite warrior in David's army.
short: Ithmah the Moabite was one of the mighty warriors in David's army.

name: Ithran
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Descendant of Asher, son of Zophah.
short: Ithran (or Jether) was a descendant of Asher, the son of Zophah.

name: Ithran
description: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Descendant of Esau, son of Dishon the Horite.
short: Ithran was a descendant of Esau and son of Dishon the Horite.

name: Ithream
description: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Son of David, born in Hebron to Eglah.
short: Ithream was a son of David, born to him in Hebron by his wife Eglah.

name: Ittai
description: David's compatriot living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Gittite commander who remained loyal to David.
short: Ittai the Gittite was a commander who remained loyal to David during Absalom's rebellion.

name: Ittai
description: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: One of David's mighty men
short: Ittai, one of King David's mighty men, was from Gibeah of Benjamin.

name: Izhar
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Asher listed in the genealogy in Chronicles
short: Izhar was a descendant of Asher mentioned among the genealogies of the twelve tribes of Israel.

name: Izhar
description: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Kohath, grandson of Levi; father of Korah.
short: Izhar (or Amminadab), son of Kohath and father of Korah, was a Levite.

name: Izliah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A Benjamite, son of Elpaal.
short: Izliah was a Benjamite, one of the sons of Elpaal.

name: Izrahiah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Uzzi, an Issacharite
short: Izrahiah, a son of Uzzi, was a descendant of Issachar and a clan head.

name: Izziah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Descendant of Parosh; agreed to put away foreign wife.
short: Izziah, a descendant of Parosh, was among those who agreed to put away their foreign wives during Ezra's reforms.

name: Jaakobah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Simeonite leader during Hezekiah's reign.
short: Jaakobah was a leader from the tribe of Simeon during the reign of King Hezekiah.

name: Jaalah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Returned exile; descendant of Solomon's servants.
short: Jaalah was among the descendants of Solomon's servants who returned to Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

name: Jaare-oregim
description: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Father of Elhanan, who killed Goliath's brother.
short: Jaare-oregim (or Jair) was the father of Elhanan, who killed Lahmi, the brother of Goliath the Gittite.

name: Jaareshiah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Descendant of Benjamin through Jeroham.
short: Jaareshiah was a descendant of Benjamin through Jeroham.

name: Jaasiel
description: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: One of David's mighty warriors, the son of Abner.
short: Jaasiel, the son of Abner, was one of David's mighty warriors.

name: Jaasiel
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Leader of the half-tribe of Manasseh during David's reign.
short: Jaasiel, the son of Abner, was the leader of the half-tribe of Manasseh during King David's reign.

name: Jaasu
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Descendant of Bani; agreed to put away foreign wife.
short: Jaasu, a descendant of Bani, was among those who agreed to put away their foreign wives during Ezra's reforms.

name: Jaazaniah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Leader among the twenty-five men in Ezekiel's vision.
short: Jaazaniah, the son of Azzur, was one of the twenty-five men in Ezekiel's vision who were devising iniquity and giving wicked counsel.

name: Jaazaniah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Israelite elder; participated in idolatry in the temple.
short: Jaazaniah, the son of Shaphan, was one of the seventy elders of Israel who participated in idolatrous practices in the temple, as seen in Ezekiel's vision.

name: Jaazaniah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Jeremiah; a Rechabite during Jeremiah's time.
short: Jaazaniah, the son of Jeremiah, was a Rechabite who was tested by the prophet Jeremiah for his obedience to his ancestor's commands.

name: Jaaziah
description: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Levite, descendant of Merari during David's reign.
short: Jaaziah was a Levite, a descendant of Merari through his son Beno, who served during King David's reign.

name: Jaaziel
description: Singer living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Levite musician during David's reign.
short: Jaaziel (or Aziel or Jeiel) was a Levite appointed as a musician to play the bronze cymbals during the bringing of the ark to Jerusalem in David's reign.

name: Jabal
description: Man living at the time before the Flood
brief: Son of Lamech; father of nomadic herdsmen.
short: Jabal, the son of Lamech and Adah, was the ancestor of those who dwell in tents and have livestock.

name: Jabesh
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Assassinated Zechariah; reigned as king of Israel for a month.
short: Jabesh, the son of Shallum, conspired against and assassinated Zechariah, becoming king of Israel, but reigned for only one month before being killed by Menahem.

name: Jabez
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: More honorable than his brothers; God granted his prayer.
short: Jabez, who was more honorable than his brothers, cried out to God, who granted his request to enlarge his territory and keep him from harm.

name: Jabin
description: King living before Israel's Monarchy
brief: Canaanite king who oppressed Israel; defeated by Deborah and Barak.
short: Jabin, a Canaanite king of Hazor, oppressed Israel for twenty years until he was defeated by Deborah and Barak.

name: Jabin
description: King living before Israel's Monarchy
brief: King of Hazor; led Canaanite coalition against Joshua.
short: Jabin, king of Hazor, formed an alliance with other Canaanite kings to fight against Joshua and the Israelites.

name: Jacan
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Gadite leader during the reign of Jotham.
short: Jacan was a leader from the tribe of Gad during the reign of Jotham, king of Judah.

name: Jachin
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Head of a priestly division during David's reign.
short: Jachin was the head of the twenty-first priestly division organized by King David.

name: Jachin
description: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Priest who lived in Jerusalem after the exile.
short: Jachin was a priest who resided in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

name: Jachin
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Simeon; founder of the Jachinites clan.
short: Jachin (or Jarib), a son of Simeon, was the founder of the Jachinites clan within the tribe of Simeon.

name: Jacob
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Father of Joseph, the husband of Mary.
short: Jacob was the father of Joseph, the husband of Mary, the mother of Jesus.

name: Jada
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Onam and brother of Shammai.
short: Jada was the son of Onam and the brother of Shammai, from the tribe of Judah.

name: Jaddai
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Israelite who agreed to put away his foreign wife.
short: Jaddai was among the Israelites who agreed to put away their foreign wives during Ezra's reforms.

name: Jaddua
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: One of the leaders who sealed Nehemiah's covenant.
short: Jaddua was one of the leaders who sealed the covenant made by the people of Israel during Nehemiah's time.

name: Jaddua
description: Priest living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: High priest during the time of Alexander the Great.
short: Jaddua served as the high priest during the reign of Darius the Persian and was contemporary with Alexander the Great.

name: Jadon
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Meronothite who helped repair Jerusalem's walls under Nehemiah.
short: Jadon the Meronothite was one of the people who helped repair the walls of Jerusalem during Nehemiah's time.

name: Jael
description: Woman living before Israel's Monarchy
brief: Wife of Heber; killed Sisera, the Canaanite commander.
short: Jael, the wife of Heber the Kenite, killed Sisera, the commander of the Canaanite army, by driving a tent peg through his temple.

name: Jahath
description: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Levite, descendant of Shimei, son of Gershon.
short: Jahath was a Levite, a descendant of Shimei, and a grandson of Gershon.

name: Jahath
description: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Levite, son of Shelomoth, descendant of Izhar.
short: Jahath was a Levite, the son of Shelomoth, and a descendant of Izhar.

name: Jahath
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Reaiah, descendant of Judah through Shobal.
short: Jahath was the son of Reaiah and a descendant of Judah through Shobal.

name: Jahath
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Levite who supervised repairs in Josiah's temple restoration.
short: Jahath, along with Obadiah, were Levites from the Merarites who faithfully supervised the workmen repairing the temple during Josiah's reign.

name: Jahaziel
description: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Benjamite warrior who joined David at Ziklag.
short: Jahaziel, a Benjamite warrior, was one of the mighty men who joined David at Ziklag while he was hiding from Saul.

name: Jahaziel
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Levite priest who played the trumpet regularly.
short: Jahaziel, along with Benaiah, were Levite priests who regularly blew the trumpets before the ark of the covenant.

name: Jahaziel
description: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Levite, son of Hebron, during David's reign.
short: Jahaziel, a Levite and son of Hebron, was a chief of the Hebronites during the reign of David.

name: Jahaziel
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Levite who prophesied Jehoshaphat's victory over his enemies.
short: Jahaziel, a Levite and descendant of Asaph, prophesied by the Spirit of the Lord that Jehoshaphat would have victory over his enemies.

name: Jahaziel
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Descendant of Shecaniah; returned with Ezra from Babylon.
short: Jahaziel, a descendant of Shecaniah, was one of the men who returned with Ezra from Babylon to Jerusalem.

name: Jahdai
description: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Descendant of Caleb, son of Jephunneh.
short: Jahdai was one of the descendants of Caleb, the son of Jephunneh.

name: Jahdiel
description: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Mighty warrior and head of a father's house in Manasseh.
short: Jahdiel was a mighty warrior and head of a father's house in the half-tribe of Manasseh, east of the Jordan.

name: Jahdo
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Buz, a Gadite
short: Jahdo, a son of Buz, was a descendant of Gad and a clan head.

name: Jahleel
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Zebulun, grandson of Jacob, and a clan leader.
short: Jahleel, son of Zebulun, was a grandson of Jacob and a clan leader.

name: Jahmai
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Tola, an Issacharite
short: Jahmai, a son of Tola, was a descendant of Issachar and a clan head.

name: Jahzeel
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Naphtali, grandson of Jacob, and a clan leader.
short: Jahzeel (or Jahziel), son of Naphtali, was a grandson of Jacob and a clan leader.

name: Jahzeiah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Opposed Ezra's command for Israelites to divorce foreign wives.
short: Jahzeiah, along with three others, opposed Ezra's order for Israelites to divorce their foreign wives.

name: Jahzerah
description: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Priest in postexilic Jerusalem
short: Jahzerah was a priest who lived in Jerusalem after the exile.

name: Jair
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Mordecai's father, a Benjamite
short: Jair was the father of Mordecai, a Benjamite mentioned in the book of Esther.

name: Jair
description: Judge living before Israel's Monarchy
brief: Gileadite judge who led Israel
short: Jair the Gileadite was a judge who led Israel for twenty-two years.

name: Jair
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Manassite leader who captured Gilead
short: Jair, a descendant of Manasseh, captured the region of Gilead.

name: Jairus
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Synagogue leader whose daughter Jesus healed
short: Jairus, a synagogue leader, sought Jesus to heal his dying daughter.

name: Jakeh
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Father of Agur, the author of Proverbs 30
short: Jakeh was the father of Agur, the author of Proverbs 30.

name: Jakim
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Head of the 12th priestly division
short: Jakim was the head of the 12th priestly division during David's reign.

name: Jakim
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Benjamite, son of Shimei
short: Jakim was a Benjamite, the son of Shimei, mentioned in a genealogy.

name: Jalam
description: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Esau and Oholibamah
short: Jalam was a son of Esau and Oholibamah, and a chief of Edom.

name: Jalon
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Ezrah, from the tribe of Judah
short: Jalon was a son of Ezrah, from the tribe of Judah.

name: Jambres
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Egyptian magician who opposed Moses
short: Jambres was an Egyptian magician who, along with Jannes, opposed Moses.

name: James
description: Father of an apostle living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Father of Judas, an Apostles
short: James, father of Judas who was also know as Thaddaeus, one of the Twelve Apostles chosen by Jesus.

name: James
description: Apostle living at the time of the New Testament
brief: James "the Less", son of Alphaeus
short: James son of Alphaeus, known as "James the Less"was one of the Twelve Apostles.

name: James
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Jesus' brother, leader in the Jerusalem church
short: James, the brother of Jesus, was a leader in the Jerusalem church and authored the epistle of James.

name: James
description: Apostle living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Son of Zebedee, one of the Twelve Apostles
short: James, son of Zebedee and brother of John, was one of the Twelve Apostles and a member of Jesus' inner circle.

name: Jamin
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Ram, descendant of Judah
short: Jamin was a son of Ram and a descendant of Judah.

name: Jamin
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Simeon, grandson of Jacob
short: Jamin was a son of Simeon and a grandson of Jacob.

name: Jamin
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Levite who helped explain the Law to the people
short: Jamin was a Levite who helped explain the Law to the people during the time of Ezra and Nehemiah.

name: Jamlech
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Simeonite leader during Hezekiah's reign
short: Jamlech was a leader from the tribe of Simeon during King Hezekiah's reign.

name: Janai
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Gadite leader who settled in Bashan
short: Janai was a leader from the tribe of Gad who settled in the region of Bashan.

name: Jannai
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Ancestor of Jesus in Luke's genealogy
short: Jannai was an ancestor of Jesus mentioned in Luke's genealogy.

name: Jannes
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Egyptian magician who opposed Moses
short: Jannes was an Egyptian magician who, along with Jambres, opposed Moses.

name: Japheth
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Noah, ancestor of Indo-European peoples
short: Japheth was one of Noah's three sons and the ancestor of the Indo-European peoples.

name: Japhia
description: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Son of David, born in Jerusalem
short: Japhia was one of King David's sons, born to him in Jerusalem.

name: Japhia
description: King living before Israel's Monarchy
brief: King of Lachish, defeated by Joshua
short: Japhia was the king of Lachish, one of the Amorite cities defeated by Joshua.

name: Japhlet
description: Man living before Israel's Monarchy
brief: Descendant of Asher, son of Heber
short: Japhlet was a descendant of Asher and the son of Heber.

name: Jared
description: Man living at the time before the Flood
brief: Ancestor of Noah; father of Enoch
short: Jared was an ancestor of Noah and the father of Enoch, who walked with God.

name: Jarha
description: Egyptian living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Egyptian servant who married Sheshan's daughter
short: Jarha was an Egyptian servant who married the daughter of Sheshan, a descendant of Judah.

name: Jarib
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Priest who married a foreign woman
short: Jarib was a priest who had married a foreign woman during the time of Ezra.

name: Jarib
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Leader sent by Ezra to find Levites
short: Jarib was one of the leaders sent by Ezra to find Levites to serve in the Temple.

name: Jaroah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Gadite, son of Gilead
short: Jaroah was a Gadite, the son of Gilead, mentioned in a genealogy.

name: Jashar
description: Man living before Israel's Monarchy
brief: Ancient Hebrew book mentioned in the Old Testament
short: Jashar was an ancient Hebrew book mentioned in the Old Testament, but not included in the biblical canon.

name: Jashen
description: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Father of some of David's mighty men
short: Jashen, also known as Hashem, was the father of some of David's mighty men.

name: Jashobeam
description: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Korahite who joined David at Ziklag
short: Jashobeam was a Korahite who joined David at Ziklag when he was fleeing from Saul.

name: Jashobeam
description: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Chief of David's mighty men, Hachmoni's son
short: Jashobeam, also known as Josheb-basshebet, was the chief of David's mighty men and the son of Hachmoni.

name: Jashub
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Israelite who married a foreign woman during Ezra's time
short: Jashub was an Israelite who had married a foreign woman during the time of Ezra.

name: Jashub
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Issachar, grandson of Jacob
short: Jashub, also known as Yob, was a son of Issachar and a grandson of Jacob.

name: Jason
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Paul's host in Thessalonica; relative of Paul
short: Jason was Paul's host in Thessalonica and a relative of Paul mentioned in his letter to the Romans.

name: Jathniel
description: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Levite gatekeeper during David's reign
short: Jathniel was a Levite who served as a gatekeeper during the reign of King David.

name: Javan
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Japheth; ancestor of Greek people
short: Javan, the ancestor of the Greek people, was a son of Japheth and grandson of Noah.

name: Jaziz
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Hagrite in charge of David's flocks
short: Jaziz the Hagrite was in charge of King David's flocks.

name: Jeatherai
description: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Levite, son of Zerah, ancestor of Asaph
short: Jeatherai, also known as Ethni, was a Levite, the son of Zerah, and an ancestor of Asaph.

name: Jeberechiah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Witness to Isaiah's prophecy about Maher-shalal-hash-baz
short: Jeberechiah was a witness to Isaiah's prophecy concerning his son Maher-shalal-hash-baz.

name: Jecoliah
description: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Mother of King Uzziah (Azariah) of Judah
