description: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Son of Shammah the Hararite, one of David's mighty men
short: Jonathan, the son of Shammah the Hararite, was one of David's mighty men, known for his military prowess.

name: Jonathan
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Opposed divorcing foreigners, with Jahzeiah and Meshullam
short: Jonathan, along with Jahzeiah and Meshullam, opposed Ezra's demand to put away foreign wives.

name: Jonathan
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Descendant of Adaiah who returned from exile
short: Jonathan, of the descendants of Adaiah, was among those who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian exile.

name: Jonathan
description: Levite living before Israel's Monarchy
brief: A Levite who served as a priest for Dan
short: Jonathan, a Levite from Bethlehem, became a priest for the tribe of Dan after they set up a carved image.

name: Jonathan
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Scribe with a house used as prison
short: Jonathan was a scribe who had a house in Jerusalem that was used as a prison.

name: Jonathan
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Kareah, came to Gedaliah at Mizpah
short: Jonathan son of Kareah was one of the army officers who came to Gedaliah at Mizpah after the fall of Jerusalem.

name: Jonathan
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Head of priestly family of Malluchi
short: Jonathan was the head of the priestly family of Malluchi during the high priesthood of Joiakim.

name: Jonathan
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Priest who participated in dedication of Jerusalem's wall
short: Jonathan, a priest, was among those who blew trumpets at the dedication of Jerusalem's wall.

name: Jorah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Ancestor of exiles who returned to Jerusalem
short: The descendants of Jorah (or Hariph) were among the exiles who returned to Jerusalem from Babylon.

name: Jorai
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A chief of the half-tribe of Manasseh
short: Jorai was a clan chief of the half-tribe of Manasseh during the reign of King Jotham of Judah.

name: Joram
description: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A Levite during the reign of King David
short: Joram was a Levite who served during the reign of King David.

name: Joram
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Son of King Toi, brought gifts to David
short: Joram (or Hadoram), son of King Toi of Hamath, brought gifts to King David after David's defeat of Hadadezer.

name: Jorim
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: An ancestor of Jesus Christ
short: Jorim is listed as one of the ancestors of Jesus Christ in the genealogy recorded by Luke.

name: Jorkeam
description: Man or town at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A son or town founded by Raham
short: Jorkeam was a descendant of Caleb or a town founded by Raham in the tribe of Judah.

name: Josech
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: An ancestor of Jesus Christ
short: Josech (or Joseph) is listed as one of the ancestors of Jesus Christ in the genealogy recorded by Luke.

name: Joseph
description: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Asaph, a musician in David's time
short: Joseph, a son of Asaph, was a musician who served during King David's reign.

name: Joseph
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Candidate to replace Judas as apostle
short: Joseph, also called Barsabbas or Justus, was considered as a replacement for Judas among the apostles.

name: Joseph
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: An Israelite who married a foreign woman
short: Joseph was among the Israelites who had married foreign women during the time of Ezra.

name: Joseph
description: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt
short: Joseph, Jacob's son, rose to power in Egypt and saved his family during a famine.

name: Joseph
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: An ancestor of Jesus Christ
short: Joseph, the son of Mattathias, is listed as an ancestor of Jesus Christ in Luke's genealogy.

name: Joseph
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: An ancestor of Jesus Christ
short: Joseph, the son of Jonam, is listed as an ancestor of Jesus Christ in Luke's genealogy.

name: Joseph
description: Mary's husband living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Husband of Mary and earthly father of Jesus
short: Joseph was the husband of Mary and the earthly father of Jesus Christ.

name: Joseph
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Of Arimathea, buried Jesus in his own tomb
short: Joseph of Arimathea was a wealthy disciple who buried Jesus in his own new tomb.

name: Joseph
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Head of the priestly family of Shebaniah
short: Joseph was the head of the priestly family of Shebaniah during the high priesthood of Joiakim.

name: Joseph
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Representative of Issachar among the spies
short: Joseph son of Igal represented the tribe of Issachar among the twelve spies sent to Canaan.

name: Joses
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Brother of Jesus and son of Mary
short: Joses (or Joseph) was one of Jesus' brothers and a son of Mary.

name: Joses
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Brother of James "the Less" and son of the "other" Mary
short: Joses (or Joseph) was brother of James "the Less" who was an apostle.

name: Joshah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A Simeonite leader during Hezekiah's reign
short: Joshah was one of the leaders from the tribe of Simeon during the reign of King Hezekiah.

name: Joshaphat
description: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: One of David's mighty warriors from Mithan
short: Joshaphat the Mithnite was listed among David's mighty warriors.

name: Joshaphat
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A priest who blew trumpets before the ark
short: Joshaphat, along with other priests, blew trumpets before the ark of the covenant during its transfer to Jerusalem.

name: Joshaviah
description: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: One of David's mighty warriors from Eliahba's sons
short: Joshaviah, a son of Elnaam, was listed among David's mighty warriors.

name: Joshbekashah
description: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A son of Heman, a musician in David's time
short: Joshbekashah, one of Heman's sons, was a musician appointed by King David to lead worship.

name: Joshibiah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A Simeonite leader during Hezekiah's reign
short: Joshibiah was one of the leaders from the tribe of Simeon during the reign of King Hezekiah.

name: Joshua
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Owner of a field in Beth-shemesh
short: The ark of the covenant was placed on a rock in the field of Joshua of Beth-shemesh.

name: Joshua
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Governor of Jerusalem during Josiah's reign
short: Joshua was the governor of Jerusalem during the reign of King Josiah.

name: Joshua
description: Judge living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness and Conquest
brief: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan
short: Joshua, the son of Nun, was Moses' assistant and successor who led the Israelites into the Promised Land.

name: Joshua
description: High Priest living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: High priest during the rebuilding of the temple
short: Joshua (or Jeshua), the son of Jehozadak, was the high priest who led the rebuilding of the temple after the Babylonian exile.

name: Joshua
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: An ancestor of Jesus Christ
short: Joshua (or Jose) is listed as an ancestor of Jesus Christ in Luke's genealogy.

name: Josiah
description: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: King of Judah known for his religious reforms
short: Josiah was a king of Judah who instituted significant religious reforms and repaired the temple.

name: Josiah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: One who provided silver and gold for a crown
short: Josiah (or Hen), along with others, provided silver and gold for a crown in a symbolic act during Zechariah's time.

name: Josiphiah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Father of Shelomith, a returning exile
short: Josiphiah was the father of Shelomith, who was among the exiles who returned with Ezra to Jerusalem.

name: Jotham
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A son of Jahdai, a Calebite
short: Jotham was a son of Jahdai, who was a wife of Caleb.

name: Jotham
description: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: King of Judah and son of Uzziah
short: Jotham, the son of Uzziah, was a king of Judah who reigned for sixteen years.

name: Jotham
description: Man living before Israel's Monarchy
brief: Youngest son of Gideon who escaped Abimelech's massacre
short: Jotham, the youngest son of Gideon, was the only one to escape when Abimelech killed his seventy brothers.

name: Jozabad
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A Manassite leader who joined David at Ziklag
short: One of two men called Jozabad who, along with other Manassite leaders, joined David at Ziklag when he was returning to fight against the Philistines.

name: Jozabad
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A Manassite leader who joined David at Ziklag
short: One of two men called Jozabad who, along with other Manassite leaders, joined David at Ziklag when he was returning to fight against the Philistines.

name: Jozabad
description: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A Benjamite warrior who joined David at Ziklag
short: Jozabad, a Benjamite warrior, was one of the mighty men who joined David at Ziklag.

name: Jozabad
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A Levite appointed as an overseer during Hezekiah's reign
short: Jozabad, a Levite, was one of the overseers appointed by King Hezekiah to distribute the contributions to the priests and Levites.

name: Jozabad
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A Levite who contributed to the Passover celebration
short: Jozabad, along with other Levitical leaders, generously provided animals for the Passover offerings during King Josiah's reign.

name: Jozabad
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A priest who married a foreign woman
short: Jozabad was one of the priests who had married foreign women during the time of Ezra and agreed to put them away.

name: Jozabad
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A Levite who married a foreign woman
short: Jozabad was one of the Levites who had married foreign women during the time of Ezra and agreed to put them away.

name: Jozabad
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A priest who weighed the silver and gold offerings
short: Jozabad, along with Noadiah, was a priest appointed to weigh the silver, gold, and vessels brought as offerings to the temple.

name: Jozabad
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A Levite leader in charge of outside work
short: Jozabad, one of the leaders of the Levites, was in charge of the outside work of the house of God.

name: Jozabad
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A Levite who helped explain the Law to the people
short: Jozabad was one of the Levites who helped the people understand the Law as Ezra read it aloud.

name: Jozacar
description: Ammonite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: One of the servants who killed King Joash
short: Jozacar (or Zabad), along with Jehozabad, was one of the servants who conspired against and killed King Joash of Judah.

name: Jozadak
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A priest whose descendants married foreign women
short: Among the descendants of Jozadak, some priests were found to have married foreign women during the time of Ezra.

name: Jubal
description: Man living at the time before the Flood
brief: Father of musicians who play the lyre and pipe
short: Jubal was the father of all who play the lyre and pipe.

name: Judah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A Levite who married a foreign woman
short: Judah was one of the Levites who had married foreign women during the time of Ezra and agreed to put them away.

name: Judah
description: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Israelite tribe, kingdom, and province
short: Judah, also known as the Jews or Judea, refers to the Israelite tribe, the southern kingdom, and the Roman province in various biblical contexts.

name: Judah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: An ancestor of Jesus Christ
short: Judah is listed as an ancestor of Jesus Christ in Luke's genealogy.

name: Judah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Leader of Judahites living in Jerusalem
short: Judah was a leader of the people of Judah living in Jerusalem after the exile.

name: Judah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A priest who participated in the dedication ceremony
short: Judah, along with other priests, played musical instruments during the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem.

name: Judah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A Levite who participated in the dedication ceremony
short: Judah was one of the Levites who led the thanksgiving choir during the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem.

name: Judas
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: A prophet and leader in the Jerusalem church
short: Judas, also known as Barsabbas, was a prophet and respected leader in the Jerusalem church who accompanied Paul and Barnabas to Antioch.

name: Judas
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: The Galilean, a Jewish rebel leader
short: Judas the Galilean led a revolt against the Roman census during the time of Quirinius, governor of Syria.

name: Judas
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: A Christian living on Straight Street in Damascus
short: Judas was a Christian living on Straight Street in Damascus, where Saul (Paul) stayed after his conversion.

name: Judas
description: Apostle living at the time of the New Testament
brief: One of the twelve apostles of Jesus
short: Judas, also known as Lebbaeus or Thaddaeus, was one of the twelve apostles chosen by Jesus Christ.

name: Judas
description: Apostle living at the time of the New Testament
brief: The apostle who betrayed Jesus
short: Judas Iscariot was one of the twelve apostles who betrayed Jesus, leading to His arrest and crucifixion.

name: Jude
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: A brother of Jesus and author of the epistle
short: Jude, a brother of Jesus, was the author of the Epistle of Jude and is mentioned in the lists of Jesus' siblings.

name: Judith
description: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: A Hittite woman who married Esau
short: Judith, the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, was one of Esau's wives, causing grief to Isaac and Rebekah.

name: Julia
description: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
brief: A Christian woman greeted by Paul in Romans
short: Julia, along with Philologus and Nereus, was greeted by Paul in his letter to the Romans.

name: Julius
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: A centurion of the Augustan Cohort
short: Julius, a centurion of the Augustan Cohort, was responsible for escorting Paul to Rome and showed him kindness during the journey.

name: Junia
description: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
brief: A prominent apostle and relative of Paul
short: Junia, along with Andronicus, was recognized as a prominent apostle and a relative of Paul who had been imprisoned with him.

name: Jushab-hesed
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A descendant of King Jehoiachin
short: Jushab-hesed was one of the sons of Zerubbabel, a descendant of King Jehoiachin of Judah.

name: Justus
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Titius Justus, a Gentile believer who hosted Paul in Corinth
short: Titius Justus, a Gentile worshiper of God, hosted Paul in Corinth after he left the synagogue.

name: Justus
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Jesus Justus, a Jewish believer who supported Paul
short: Jesus, also called Justus, was one of the few Jewish believers who supported Paul during his imprisonment.

name: Kadmiel
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A Levite who returned from Babylonian exile
short: Kadmiel was a Levite who returned from Babylonian exile and played a significant role in the rebuilding of the temple and the spiritual renewal of the people.

name: Kallai
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A priest during the time of Joiakim
short: Kallai was a priest who served during the time of Joiakim, the son of Jeshua, after the Babylonian exile.

name: Kareah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Father of Johanan and Jonathan
short: Kareah was the father of Johanan and Jonathan, two military leaders who joined Gedaliah after the fall of Jerusalem to the Babylonians.

name: Kedar
description: Arabian living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: A son of Ishmael and a nomadic tribe
short: Kedar was a son of Ishmael and the eponymous ancestor of a nomadic Arab tribe known for their tents and flocks.

name: Kedemah
description: Arabian living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: A son of Ishmael; Nodab, a Hagrite tribe
short: Kedemah was a son of Ishmael, while the Nodab were a Hagrite tribe defeated by the Reubenites, Gadites, and half-tribe of Manasseh.

name: Kelaiah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A Levite who married a foreign woman
short: Kelaiah, also known as Kelita, was a Levite who had married a foreign woman and pledged to put her away during Ezra's reform.

name: Kelita
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A Levite who taught the Law and sealed the covenant
short: Kelita was a Levite who helped explain the Law to the people and sealed the covenant during the time of Nehemiah.

name: Kemuel
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A Levite leader during David's reign
short: Kemuel, the son of Hebron, was the leader of the Levites during the reign of King David.

name: Kemuel
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: A son of Nahor and Milcah
short: Kemuel was a son of Nahor and Milcah and the father of Aram.

name: Kemuel
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: A leader from the tribe of Ephraim
short: Kemuel, the son of Shiphtan, was a leader from the tribe of Ephraim appointed to help divide the Promised Land.

name: Kenan
description: Man living at the time before the Flood
brief: Son of Enosh, descendant of Seth
short: Kenan (Cainan), the son of Enosh, was a descendant of Seth and an ancestor of Noah.

name: Kenaz
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A descendant of Caleb
short: Kenaz was a descendant of Caleb, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah.

name: Kenaz
description: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: An Edomite clan descended from Esau
short: Kenaz was one of the clans of Edom, descended from Esau through his son Eliphaz.

name: Kenaz
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Father of Othniel, a judge of Israel
short: Kenaz was the father of Othniel, a judge of Israel who delivered the Israelites from the oppression of Cushan-rishathaim.

name: Keren-happuch
description: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Job's third daughter born after his restoration
short: Keren-happuch was the name of Job's third daughter, born to him after God restored his fortunes.

name: Keros
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A family of temple servants who returned from exile
short: Keros was the name of a family of temple servants (Nethinim) who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian exile.

name: Keturah
description: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Abraham's concubine after Sarah's death
short: Keturah was the concubine Abraham took after the death of Sarah, and she bore him six sons.

name: Keziah
description: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Job's second daughter born after his restoration
short: Keziah was the name of Job's second daughter, born to him after God restored his fortunes.

name: Kish
description: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: A Levite from the Merari clan
short: Kish was a Levite from the clan of Merari, whose descendants were assigned duties in the tabernacle service.

name: Kish
description: Saul's father living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Father of Saul, the first king of Israel
short: Kish was a Benjamite, the father of Saul, who was anointed by Samuel as the first king of Israel.

name: Kish
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A Levite who helped purify the temple
short: Kish, a Levite from the clan of Merari, participated in the purification of the temple during the reign of King Hezekiah.

name: Kish
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: An ancestor of Mordecai
short: Kish, a Benjamite, was an ancestor of Mordecai, the cousin and guardian of Queen Esther.

name: Kishi
description: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A Levite and father of Jeduthun (or 'Ethan')
short: Kishi, also known as Kushaiah, was a Levite from the clan of Merari and the father of Jeduthun (or 'Ethan'), a prominent musician in King David's court.

name: Kohath
description: Levi's son living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Levi; Levite clan ancestor
short: Kohath, son of Levi, was the ancestor of Moses and Aaron.

name: Kolaiah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: False prophet in Babylon
short: Kolaiah, a false prophet among the exiles in Babylon.

name: Kolaiah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Benjamite of Jerusalem
short: Kolaiah, a Benjamite who lived in Jerusalem.

name: Korah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Hebron, descendant of Caleb
short: Korah, son of Hebron, from the tribe of Judah.

name: Korah
description: Aaron's adversary living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Levite rebel leader; his descendants became temple servants
short: Korah, a Levite who rebelled against Moses and Aaron; his descendants became temple musicians and gatekeepers.

name: Korah
description: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Edomite chief, descendant of Eliphaz
short: Korah, an Edomite chief, descendant of Eliphaz, son of Esau.

name: Korah
description: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Esau
short: Korah, son of Esau and Oholibamah

name: Kore
description: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Levite gatekeeper
short: Kore, a Levite gatekeeper, descendant of Korah

name: Kore
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Levite in charge of freewill offerings
short: Kore, a Levite in charge of distributing freewill offerings during Hezekiah's reign.

name: Koz
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Ashhur, a Judahite
short: Koz, a descendant of Judah through Ashhur.

name: Laadah
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Shelah, a Judahite
short: Laadah, a son of Shelah and descendant of Judah.

name: Laban
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Brother of Rebekah; father of Leah and Rachel
short: Laban, the brother of Rebekah and father of Jacob's wives, Leah and Rachel.

name: Ladan
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Descendant of Ephraim
short: Ladan, a descendant of Ephraim.

name: Lael
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Father of Eliasaph, a Gershonite Levite
short: Lael, the father of Eliasaph, a leader of the Gershonite Levites.

name: Lahad
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Jahath, a Judahite
short: Lahad, a descendant of Judah through Jahath.

name: Lahmi
description: Giant living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Brother of Goliath the Gittite
short: Lahmi, the brother of Goliath, was killed by Elhanan the Bethlehemite.

name: Laish
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Father of Michal's husband Palti (or 'Paltiel')
short: Laish, the father of Palti (or 'Paltiel'), to whom Saul gave his daughter Michal in marriage.

name: Lamech
description: Man living at the time before the Flood
brief: Descendant of Cain; first polygamist mentioned in the Bible
short: Lamech, a descendant of Cain, was the first polygamist mentioned in the Bible.

name: Lamech
description: Man living at the time before the Flood
brief: Father of Noah; lived 777 years
short: Lamech, the father of Noah, lived 777 years.

name: Lappidoth
description: Woman living before Israel's Monarchy
brief: Husband of Deborah the prophetess and judge
short: Lappidoth, the husband of Deborah, a prophetess and judge in Israel.

name: Lazarus
description: Mary's brother living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Brother of Mary and Martha; raised from the dead
short: Lazarus, the brother of Mary and Martha, was raised from the dead by Jesus (<ref="Jhn.11.1-44; 12.1-2,9-11">Jhn.11.1-44; 12.1-2,9-11</ref>).

name: Lazarus
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Poor man in Jesus' parable of the rich man
short: Lazarus, a poor man in Jesus' parable of the rich man and Lazarus (<ref="Luk.16.20-25">Luk.16.20-25</ref>).

name: Leah
description: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Wife of Jacob; mother of six sons and Dinah
short: Leah, the first wife of Jacob and mother of six of his sons and his daughter Dinah.

name: Lebanah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Ancestor of temple servants who returned from Babylonian exile
short: Lebanah or Lebana, whose descendants were among the temple servants who returned from the Babylonian exile.

name: Lecah
description: Man or town at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Er, a Judahite
short: Lecah, a descendant of Judah through Er.

name: Lemuel
description: King living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: King mentioned in Proverbs; his mother taught him wisdom
short: Lemuel, a king whose wise sayings are recorded in Proverbs 31, as taught by his mother.

name: Levi
description: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites
short: Levi, son of Jacob and Leah, was the progenitor of the Levites, the priestly tribe of Israel.

name: Levi
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Son of Melchi, an ancestor of Jesus
short: Levi, son of Melchi, an ancestor of Jesus mentioned in Luke's genealogy (<ref="Luk.3.24">Luk.3.24</ref>).

name: Levi
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Simeon, an ancestor of Jesus
short: Levi, son of Simeon, an ancestor of Jesus mentioned in Luke's genealogy (<ref="Luk.3.29">Luk.3.29</ref>).

name: Libni
description: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Grandson of Merari; grandson of Levi
short: Libni, a grandson of Merari and grandson of Levi.

name: Libni
description: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Gershon; grandson of Levi
short: Libni or Ladan, a son of Gershon and grandson of Levi.

name: Likhi
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Shemida, a Manassite
short: Likhi, a son of Shemida and descendant of Manasseh.

name: Linus
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Christian in Rome; greeted by Paul
short: Linus, a Christian in Rome to whom Paul sent greetings.

name: Lo-ammi
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Symbolic name of Hosea's son; represents God's rejection of Israel
short: Lo-ammi, meaning "not my people," was the symbolic name given to Hosea's son, representing God's rejection of Israel.

name: Lois
description: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Grandmother of Timothy; commended for her faith

short: Mirmah, a Benjamite, is listed in the genealogy of Shaharaim.

name: Mishael
description: Daniel's compatriot living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A Jewish exile in Babylon, friend of Daniel.
short: Mishael, also known as Meshach, was one of the four young Jewish men chosen to serve in Nebuchadnezzar's court and was a companion of Daniel during the Babylonian exile.

name: Mishael
description: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: A Levite who helped remove the bodies of Nadab and Abihu.
short: Mishael, a Levite and cousin of Aaron, assisted in removing the bodies of Nadab and Abihu after they offered unauthorized fire before the Lord.

name: Mishael
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A Levite who stood beside Ezra during the reading of the Law.
short: Mishael, a Levite, was one of those who stood beside Ezra as he read the Book of the Law to the people.

name: Misham
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A Benjamite, son of Elpaal.
short: Misham, a Benjamite, was one of the sons of Elpaal mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin.

name: Mishma
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A Simeonite, son of Mibsam.
short: Mishma, a descendant of Simeon, was the son of Mibsam and the father of Hammuel.

name: Mishma
description: Arabian living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: A son of Ishmael, Abraham's son.
short: Mishma was one of the twelve sons of Ishmael, Abraham's son by Hagar, and is listed among the chiefs of the Ishmaelite tribes.

name: Mishmannah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A Gadite warrior who joined David at Ziklag.
short: Mishmannah, a Gadite, was one of the warriors who joined David at Ziklag when he was fleeing from Saul.

name: Mispar
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: One of the returnees from Babylonian exile.
short: Mispar, also known as Mispereth, was among the first group of exiles who returned to Jerusalem from Babylon under the leadership of Zerubbabel.

name: Mithredath
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: The treasurer of King Cyrus of Persia.
short: Mithredath, the treasurer of King Cyrus of Persia, was responsible for overseeing the return of the temple articles to Sheshbazzar, the prince of Judah.

name: Mithredath
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A Persian official who opposed the rebuilding of Jerusalem.
short: Mithredath was one of the Persian officials who wrote a letter to King Artaxerxes, accusing the Jews of rebuilding Jerusalem's walls.

name: Mizzah
description: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: A grandson of Esau and a chief of Edom.
short: Mizzah was a grandson of Esau and one of the chiefs of Edom listed in the genealogies of Genesis and 1 Chronicles.

name: Mnason
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: A Cypriot disciple who hosted Paul in Jerusalem.
short: Mnason, an early disciple from Cyprus, provided lodging for Paul and his companions when they arrived in Jerusalem.

name: Moab
description: Moabite living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Lot, born from an incestuous relationship.
short: Moab, the son of Lot by his eldest daughter, was the ancestor of the Moabite people.

name: Molid
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Abisur, of the tribe of Judah.
short: Molid was the son of Abisur and Abihail, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah.

name: Mordecai
description: Esther's relative living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Esther's cousin, a Jewish leader in the Persian court.
short: Mordecai, Esther's cousin and guardian, played a crucial role in saving the Jews from Haman's plot during the reign of King Ahasuerus (Xerxes) of Persia.

name: Mordecai
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A leader who returned from Babylonian exile.
short: Mordecai was one of the leaders who returned with Zerubbabel from Babylonian captivity to Jerusalem.

name: Moses
description: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt
short: Moses was a prophet whom God used to lead Israel out of slavery in Egypt and give them the law.

name: Moza
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Caleb by his concubine Ephah
short: Moza was a son of Caleb, the renowned spy, by his concubine Ephah.

name: Moza
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Zimri, descendant of King Saul
short: Moza, a Benjamite, was a descendant of King Saul.

name: Muppim
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: A son of Benjamin.
short: Muppim, also known as Shephupham, Shephuphan, or Shuphamite, was a son of Benjamin mentioned in the genealogies of Genesis, Numbers, and 1 Chronicles.

name: Mushi
description: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: A Levite, son of Merari, and head of a clan.
short: Mushi was a son of Merari and a grandson of Levi, who became the head of the Mushite clan within the Levitical tribe.

name: Naam
description: Man living before Israel's Monarchy
brief: Son of Caleb, from the tribe of Judah.
short: Naam was a son of Caleb, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah in 1 Chronicles.

name: Naamah
description: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: An Ammonite; mother of King Rehoboam of Judah.
short: Naamah, an Ammonite woman, was the mother of Rehoboam, who succeeded his father Solomon as king of Judah.

name: Naamah
description: Woman living at the time before the Flood
brief: Daughter of Lamech and Zillah, sister of Tubal-cain.
short: Naamah was the daughter of Lamech and Zillah, and the sister of Tubal-cain, mentioned in the genealogy of Cain.

name: Naaman
description: Man living before Israel's Monarchy
brief: A descendant of Benjamin, son of Ehud.
short: Naaman, a descendant of Benjamin, was one of the sons of Ehud mentioned in the genealogy of 1 Chronicles.

name: Naaman
description: Syrian living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Aramean commander healed of leprosy by Elisha.
short: Naaman, a commander of the Aramean army, was healed of his leprosy by the prophet Elisha, demonstrating God's power and compassion.

name: Naaman
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: A son of Benjamin.
short: Naaman, also known as Nohah, was one of the sons of Benjamin mentioned in the genealogies of Genesis and 1 Chronicles.

name: Naaman
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Grandson of Benjamin, head of the Naamite clan.
short: Naaman, a grandson of Benjamin through Bela, was the head of the Naamite clan within the tribe of Benjamin.

name: Naarah
description: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Wife of Ashhur, the founder of Tekoa.
short: Naarah was one of the two wives of Ashhur, the  father (ie founder) of Tekoa, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah.

name: Naarai
description: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: One of David's mighty warriors, son of Ezbai.
short: Naarai, the son of Ezbai, was one of the mighty warriors who fought alongside King David.

name: Nabal
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Wealthy Carmelite; husband of Abigail. He was known for foolishness.
short: Nabal, a wealthy man from Carmel, was known for his foolishness and mistreatment of David, which nearly led to his demise.

name: Naboth
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Jezreelite vineyard owner, unjustly killed by Ahab and Jezebel.
short: Naboth, a Jezreelite, was unjustly killed by King Ahab and Queen Jezebel for refusing to sell his ancestral vineyard.

name: Nacon
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Threshing floor where Uzzah touched the ark.
short: Nacon, also known as Chidon, was the owner of the threshing floor where Uzzah touched the ark of God and was struck down.

name: Nadab
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Shammai, from the tribe of Judah.
short: Nadab was a son of Shammai, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah.

name: Nadab
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Son of Abiel, from the tribe of Benjamin.
short: Nadab was a son of Abiel, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin.

name: Nadab
description: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: King of Israel, son of Jeroboam I, reigned briefly.
short: Nadab, the son of Jeroboam I, reigned as king of Israel for two years before being assassinated by Baasha.

name: Nadab
description: Priest living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Aaron, consumed by fire for offering incense.
short: Nadab, the eldest son of Aaron, was consumed by fire from the Lord for offering unauthorized incense.

name: Naggai
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: An ancestor of Jesus Christ.
short: Naggai is mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus Christ as recorded in the Gospel of Luke.

name: Naham
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Brother of Hodiah who married Ishbar.
short: Naham, the brother of Hodiah whose son founded Keilah the Garmite city.

name: Nahamani
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: One who returned from Babylonian exile with Zerubbabel.
short: Nahamani was among those who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian captivity with Zerubbabel.

name: Naharai
description: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: One of David's mighty men, Joab's armor-bearer.
short: Naharai the Beerothite, Joab's armor-bearer, was one of David's mighty men.

name: Nahash
description: King living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Ammonite king who besieged Jabesh Gilead.
short: Nahash, the king of the Ammonites, besieged Jabesh Gilead and threatened to gouge out the right eyes of its inhabitants.

name: Nahash
description: King living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Ammonite king, father of Hanun, showed kindness to David.
short: Nahash, the king of the Ammonites and father of Hanun, had shown kindness to David, prompting David to send envoys to console Hanun after Nahash's death.

name: Nahash
description: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Mother of Abigail and Zeruiah, David's sisters.
short: Nahash, the mother of David and his sisters Abigail and Zeruiah, is mentioned in the context of Amasa's lineage.

name: Nahash
description: King living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: King of the Ammonites, provided supplies to David.
short: Nahash, the king of the Ammonites, provided supplies to David and his men during their time in Mahanaim.

name: Nahath
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A Levite during the reign of King Hezekiah.
short: Nahath was one of the Levites appointed by King Hezekiah to oversee the distribution of offerings and tithes.

name: Nahath
description: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: A descendant of Esau, a chief of Edom.
short: Nahath, a descendant of Esau, was one of the chiefs of Edom.

name: Nahbi
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: The spy from the tribe of Naphtali.
short: Nahbi, the son of Vophsi, was the representative from the tribe of Naphtali among the twelve spies sent to explore Canaan.

name: Nahor
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Serug; father of Terah, Abraham's father.
short: Nahor, the son of Serug and father of Terah, was Abraham's grandfather.

name: Nahor
description: Abraham's brother living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Terah, Abraham's brother; father of Bethuel.
short: Nahor, the son of Terah and brother of Abraham, was the father of Bethuel and the grandfather of Rebekah.

name: Nahshon
description: Man living before Israel's Monarchy
brief: Son of Amminadab, leader of Judah, ancestor of David.
short: Nahshon, the son of Amminadab, was a leader of the tribe of Judah during the Exodus and an ancestor of King David and Jesus Christ.

name: Nahum
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: An ancestor of Jesus Christ.
short: Nahum is mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus Christ as recorded in the Gospel of Luke.

name: Nahum
description: Prophet living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Old Testament prophet, author of the Book of Nahum.
short: Nahum, identified as the Elkoshite, was a prophet of God who delivered a message of judgment against the Assyrian city of Nineveh.

name: Naomi
description: Woman living before Israel's Monarchy
brief: Israelite woman, mother-in-law of Ruth.
short: Naomi, also known as Mara, was an Israelite woman who, after losing her husband and sons, returned from Moab to Bethlehem with her daughter-in-law Ruth.

name: Naphish
description: Arabian living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Ishmael, defeated by Reubenites, Gadites, and Manassites.
short: Naphish, a son of Ishmael, was among the Hagrite tribes defeated by the Reubenites, Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.

name: Naphtali
description: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Jacob, founder of the tribe of Naphtali.
short: Naphtali, the sixth son of Jacob and second son of Bilhah, was the founder of the Israelite tribe that bore his name.

name: Narcissus
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Christian in Rome with a household
short: Narcissus was likely a wealthy Christian in Rome with a household of believers.

name: Nathan
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Attai, from the tribe of Judah.
short: Nathan, the son of Attai, is mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah.

name: Nathan
description: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: One of David's mighty men, brother of Joel.
short: Nathan, the brother of Joel, was one of David's mighty men.

name: Nathan
description: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Son of David and Bathsheba, ancestor of Jesus.
short: Nathan, a son of David and Bathsheba, is mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus Christ.

name: Nathan
description: Prophet living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Prophet during the reigns of David and Solomon.
short: Nathan, a prophet of God, served during the reigns of David and Solomon, offering guidance, confronting David's sin, and supporting Solomon's accession to the throne.

name: Nathan
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: An Israelite who married a foreign woman during the Exile.
short: Nathan is listed among the Israelites who had married foreign women during the Exile and pledged to put them away.

name: Nathan
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A leader summoned by Ezra to help teach the Law.
short: Nathan, along with other leaders, was summoned by Ezra to assist in teaching the Law to the people.

name: Nathanael
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Disciple of Jesus, from Cana in Galilee.
short: Nathanael, also known as Bartholomew, was one of Jesus' twelve disciples, who was initially skeptical but later confessed Jesus as the Son of God.

name: Nathan-melech
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A court official during King Josiah's reign.
short: Nathan-melech was a court official who had living quarters near the entrance of the temple during King Josiah's reign.

name: Neariah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Descendant of David, son of Shemaiah.
short: Neariah, a descendant of King David, was the son of Shemaiah and had three sons: Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam.

name: Neariah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A Simeonite leader who defeated the Amalekites.
short: Neariah, along with other Simeonite leaders, defeated the remaining Amalekites during the reign of King Hezekiah.

name: Nebai
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A leader who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah.
short: Nebai was one of the leaders who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah to follow God's law.

name: Nebaioth
description: Arabian living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Firstborn son of Ishmael; father of a tribe.
short: Nebaioth, the firstborn son of Ishmael, was the ancestor of a tribe known for their flocks and mentioned in Isaiah's prophecy of future blessing.

name: Nebat
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Father of Jeroboam, the first king of Israel.
short: Nebat was the father of Jeroboam I, who became the first king of the northern kingdom of Israel after the division of the monarchy.

name: Nebuchadnezzar
description: Emperor living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Emperor of Babylon who conquered Judah
short: Nebuchadnezzar II was the powerful Emperor of Babylon who destroyed Jerusalem and exiled the Jews.

name: Nebu-sar-sekim
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Babylonian official at Jerusalem's fall
short: Nebu-sar-sekim was a high official in Nebuchadnezzar's army when Jerusalem fell.

name: Nebushazban
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Babylonian official during the fall of Jerusalem.
short: Nebushazban, a Babylonian official, was among those who took charge of Jeremiah after the fall of Jerusalem.

name: Nebuzaradan
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Babylonian captain of the guard during Jerusalem's fall.
short: Nebuzaradan, the captain of the Babylonian guard, oversaw the destruction of Jerusalem, the exile of its inhabitants, and the release of Jeremiah.

name: Neco
description: Pharaoh living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Egyptian Pharaoh during the reigns of Josiah and Jehoiakim.
short: Pharaoh Neco II, the ruler of Egypt, opposed King Josiah of Judah, installed Jehoiakim as a vassal king, and was later defeated by Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon.

name: Nedabiah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Descendant of King Jeconiah of Judah
short: Nedabiah was a descendant of Jeconiah, the exiled king of Judah.

name: Nehemiah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A leader who returned from Babylon to Jerusalem.
short: Nehemiah was among the leaders who returned with Zerubbabel from Babylonian exile to Jerusalem.

name: Nehemiah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Governor of Judah, rebuilt Jerusalem's walls.
short: Nehemiah, the son of Hacaliah, served as the governor of Judah and led the rebuilding of Jerusalem's walls in the mid-5th century BC.

name: Nehemiah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Son of Azbuk, repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall.
short: Nehemiah, the son of Azbuk, was a leader who repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall near the tombs of David during the rebuilding process led by Nehemiah the governor.

name: Nehushta
description: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Mother of King Jehoiachin of Judah.
short: Nehushta, the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem, was the mother of King Jehoiachin of Judah.

name: Nekoda
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A family of temple servants who returned from exile.
short: The descendants of Nekoda were among the temple servants who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian captivity.

name: Nekoda
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Family excluded from the priesthood after the Exile.
short: The descendants of Nekoda were among those who could not prove their priestly lineage after returning from the Babylonian exile.

name: Nemuel
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Eliab, from the tribe of Reuben.
short: Nemuel was a son of Eliab and a member of the tribe of Reuben.

name: Nepheg
description: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Son of King David, born in Jerusalem.
short: Nepheg was one of the sons of King David, born to him in Jerusalem.

name: Nepheg
description: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Izhar, from the tribe of Levi.
short: Nepheg was a son of Izhar and a member of the Levite clan of Kohath.

name: Ner
description: Saul's uncle living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Father of Abner, King Saul's commander.
short: Ner was the father of Abner, the commander of King Saul's army, and a member of Saul's family.

name: Nereus
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: A Christian in Rome greeted by Paul.
short: Nereus was a Christian in Rome to whom Paul sent greetings in his letter to the Romans.

name: Nergal-sar-ezer
description: Babylonian official living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Future Babylonian king at Jerusalem's fall
short: Nergal-sar-ezer was a Babylonian official present at the capture of Jerusalem in 587 BC and probably became king Neriglissar.

name: Nergal-sar-ezer
description: Babylonian official of Samgar living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Babylonian official at Jerusalem's fall
short: Nergal-sar-ezer the Rab-mag was a Babylonian official present at the capture of Jerusalem in 587 BC.

name: Neri
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Ancestor of Jesus
short: Neri was an ancestor of Jesus, mentioned in Luke's genealogy.

name: Neriah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Father of Baruch
short: Neriah was the father of Baruch, Jeremiah's scribe.

name: Nero
description: Emperor living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Roman emperor
short: Nero was likely the Roman emperor during Paul's final imprisonment.

name: Nethanel
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Priest who blew trumpets
short: Nethanel was a priest who blew trumpets before the ark of God.

name: Nethanel
description: David's brother living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Brother of David
short: Nethanel was a son of Jesse and brother of King David.

name: Nethanel
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Scribe during David's reign
short: Nethanel was a scribe who helped divide the priests into their divisions during David's reign.

name: Nethanel
description: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Son of Obed-Edom
short: Nethanel was one of the sons of Obed-Edom, the Levite.

name: Nethanel
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Levite sent to teach
short: Nethanel was a Levite sent by Jehoshaphat to teach the Book of the Law in Judah.

name: Nethanel
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Levite leader under Josiah
short: Nethanel was a Levite leader who contributed to Josiah's Passover celebration.

name: Nethanel
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Priest during Ezra's time
short: Nethanel was a priest who had married a foreign woman during the Exile.

name: Nethanel
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Priest during Nehemiah's time
short: Nethanel was a priest in Jerusalem during the time of Nehemiah.

name: Nethanel
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Musician in dedication parade
short: Nethanel was a musician who participated in the dedication of Jerusalem's wall.

name: Nethanel
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Leader of Issachar
short: Nethanel son of Zuar was the leader of the tribe of Issachar during the wilderness wanderings.

name: Nethaniah
description: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Musician in David's time, descended from Asaph
short: Nethaniah was a musician in David's time, brother of Asharelah (or 'Asarelah').

name: Nethaniah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Levite sent to teach
short: Nethaniah was a Levite sent by Jehoshaphat to teach the Book of the Law in Judah.

name: Nethaniah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Father of Ishmael
short: Nethaniah was the father of Ishmael, the assassin of Gedaliah the governor.

name: Nethaniah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Official under Jehoiakim
short: Nethaniah was the father of Jehudi, an official in King Jehoiakim's court.

name: Neziah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Ancestor of temple servants
short: Neziah was the ancestor of a family of temple servants who returned from the Babylonian exile.

name: Nicanor
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: One of seven deacons
short: Nicanor was one of the seven men chosen to assist the apostles in the early Jerusalem church.

name: Nicodemus
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Pharisee who visited Jesus
short: Nicodemus was a Pharisee and a member of the Jewish ruling council who had several encounters with Jesus.

name: Nicolaus
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Proselyte chosen as deacon
short: Nicolaus was a proselyte from Antioch chosen as one of the seven deacons in the early church.

name: Nimrod
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Mighty hunter, built cities
short: Nimrod was a mighty hunter and ruler who built several notable cities, including Babel and Nineveh.

name: Nimshi
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Grandfather of Jehu
short: Nimshi was the grandfather of Jehu, the king of Israel who overthrew the dynasty of Ahab.

name: Noadiah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Levite in charge of treasuries
short: Noadiah was a Levite entrusted with the oversight of the treasuries during the time of Ezra.

name: Noadiah
description: Woman living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: False prophetess opposed Nehemiah
short: Noadiah was a false prophetess who opposed Nehemiah during the rebuilding of Jerusalem's walls.

name: Noah
description: Flood survivor living at the time before the Flood
brief: Righteous man, built ark, survived flood
short: Noah was a righteous man who built the ark and survived the great flood with his family.

name: Noah
description: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Daughter of Zelophehad
short: Noah was one of the daughters of Zelophehad who received an inheritance in the Promised Land.

name: Nobah
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Captured Kenath, renamed it Nobah
short: Nobah was an Israelite who captured the town of Kenath and renamed it after himself.

name: Nogah
description: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Son of David
short: Nogah was one of King David's sons born in Jerusalem.

name: Nun
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Father of Joshua
short: Nun was the father of Joshua, Moses' assistant and successor as leader of Israel.

name: Nympha
description: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Hosted a church in her house
short: Nympha was a woman who hosted a church in her house in Laodicea.

name: Obadiah
description: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Gadite warrior who joined David
short: Obadiah was a Gadite warrior who joined David at Ziklag when he was fleeing from Saul.

name: Obadiah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Ruler over Zebulun in David's time
short: Obadiah was the ruler over the tribe of Zebulun during the reign of King David.

name: Obadiah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Descendant of David
short: Obadiah was a descendant of King David, mentioned in the genealogy of David's descendants.

name: Obadiah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Azel
short: Obadiah was one of the six sons of Azel, a descendant of King Saul.

name: Obadiah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Izrahiah
short: Obadiah was one of the five sons of Izrahiah, a descendant of Issachar.

name: Obadiah
description: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Gatekeeper, descendant of Jeduthun
short: Obadiah, also known as Abda, was a gatekeeper and descendant of Jeduthun who served in the temple.

name: Obadiah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Ahab's palace administrator, protected prophets
short: Obadiah was a palace administrator under King Ahab who feared the Lord and protected a hundred prophets during Jezebel's persecution.

name: Obadiah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Levite sent to teach in Judah
short: Obadiah was a Levite sent by King Jehoshaphat to teach the Book of the Law in the cities of Judah.

name: Obadiah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Levite overseer of temple repairs
short: Obadiah was a Levite who served as an overseer during the temple repairs under King Josiah.

name: Obadiah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Returnee from Babylon
short: Obadiah was one of the leaders who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian exile with Ezra.

name: Obadiah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Signatory to Nehemiah's covenant
short: Obadiah was one of the leaders who signed the covenant of faithfulness during Nehemiah's time.

name: Obadiah
description: Prophet living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Prophet who prophesied against Edom
short: Obadiah was a prophet who delivered a message of judgment against the nation of Edom.

name: Obal
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Joktan
short: Obal was one of the sons of Joktan, a descendant of Shem, mentioned in the Table of Nations.

name: Obed
description: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Ishmaelite warrior in David's army
short: Obed was an Ishmaelite warrior who fought in David's army.

name: Obed
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Descendant of Judah
short: Obed was a descendant of Judah through the line of Jerahmeel.

name: Obed
description: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Gatekeeper, son of Shemaiah
short: Obed was a gatekeeper in the temple, the son of Shemaiah.

name: Obed
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Father of Azariah
short: Obed was the father of Azariah, one of the captains who supported Joash in overthrowing Athaliah.

name: Obed
description: Man living before Israel's Monarchy
brief: Son of Boaz and Ruth
short: Obed was the son of Boaz and Ruth, and the grandfather of King David.

name: Obed-edom
description: Singer living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Gittite who housed the Ark
short: Obed-edom was a Gittite in whose house the Ark of the Covenant stayed for three months, bringing blessings to his household.

name: Obil
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Overseer of David's camels
short: Obil the Ishmaelite was in charge of King David's camels.

name: Ochran
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Father of Pagiel
short: Ochran was the father of Pagiel, a leader from the tribe of Asher during the Exodus.

name: Oded
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Prophet, father of Azariah
short: Oded was a prophet and the father of Azariah, who prophesied during the reign of King Asa of Judah.

name: Oded
description: Prophet living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Prophet who confronted victorious Israelite army
short: Oded was a prophet who confronted the Israelite army returning from a victory over Judah, urging them to release their Judean captives.

name: Og
description: King living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: King of Bashan, defeated by Israel
short: Og was the Amorite king of Bashan who was defeated by the Israelites during their journey to the Promised Land.

name: Ohad
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Simeon
short: Ohad was one of the sons of Simeon, as listed in the genealogies.

name: Ohel
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Descendant of Judah
short: Ohel was a descendant of Judah through the line of Zerubbabel.

name: Oholah
description: Woman living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Symbolic name for Samaria
short: Oholah was a symbolic name given to Samaria, representing the northern kingdom of Israel in Ezekiel's prophecy.

name: Oholiab
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Skilled craftsman for the tabernacle
short: Oholiab was a skilled craftsman from the tribe of Dan who was appointed to work on the construction of the tabernacle.

name: Oholibah
description: Woman living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Symbolic name for Jerusalem
short: Oholibah was a symbolic name given to Jerusalem, representing the southern kingdom of Judah in Ezekiel's prophecy.

name: Oholibamah
description: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Wife of Esau
short: Oholibamah was one of Esau's wives, a descendant of Seir the Horite.

name: Olympas
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Believer greeted by Paul
short: Olympas was a believer in Rome to whom Paul sent greetings.

name: Omar
description: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Eliphaz, grandson of Esau
short: Omar was a son of Eliphaz and a grandson of Esau, mentioned in the genealogies of Edom.

name: Omri
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Chief of the tribe of Issachar
short: Omri was the chief of the tribe of Issachar during the reign of King David.

name: Omri
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Descendant of Benjamin
short: Omri was a descendant of Benjamin, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe.

name: Omri
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Descendant of Judah in Jerusalem
short: Omri was a descendant of Judah who lived in Jerusalem after the exile.

name: Omri
description: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: King of Israel; father of Ahab
short: Omri was the sixth king of Israel who established Samaria as the capital and founded a powerful dynasty.

name: On
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Reubenite involved in Korah's rebellion
short: On was a Reubenite who joined Korah in his rebellion against Moses and Aaron.

name: Onam
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Descendant of Judah, son of Jerahmeel
short: Onam was a descendant of Judah, the son of Jerahmeel, and had two sons, Shammai and Jada.

name: Onam
description: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Descendant of Seir the Horite
short: Onam was a descendant of Seir the Horite, mentioned in the genealogies of Edom.

name: Onan
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Judah
short: Onan was the second son of Judah, who was punished by God for his wicked actions.

name: Onesimus
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Runaway slave, convert of Paul
short: Onesimus was a runaway slave who became a Christian through Paul's ministry and was the subject of Paul's letter to Philemon.

name: Onesiphorus
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Friend and supporter of Paul
short: Onesiphorus was a friend of Paul who often refreshed him and was not ashamed of his imprisonment.

name: Ophir
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Joktan
short: Ophir was a son of Joktan, a descendant of Shem, mentioned in the Table of Nations.

name: Ophrah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Meonothai
short: Ophrah was the son of Meonothai, a descendant of Judah.

name: Oreb
description: Man living before Israel's Monarchy
brief: Midianite prince, killed by Ephraimites
short: Oreb was a Midianite prince who was killed by the Ephraimites during the time of Gideon.

name: Oren
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Son of Jerahmeel
short: Oren was a son of Jerahmeel, a descendant of Judah.

name: Ornan
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Jebusite, sold threshing floor to David
short: Ornan (Araunah) was a Jebusite who sold his threshing floor to King David, which later became the site of Solomon's temple.

name: Orpah
description: Woman living before Israel's Monarchy
brief: Naomi's daughter-in-law, stayed in Moab
short: Orpah was Naomi's daughter-in-law who stayed in Moab after the death of her husband, while Ruth accompanied Naomi to Bethlehem.

name: Osnappar
description: King living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Assyrian king who settled people in Samaria
short: Osnappar (probably Ashurbanipal) was an Assyrian king who brought people from various regions and settled them in Samaria.

name: Othni
description: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Shemaiah, gatekeeper of the ark
short: Othni was a son of Shemaiah and served as a gatekeeper for the ark of the covenant.

name: Othniel
description: Judge living before Israel's Monarchy
brief: First judge of Israel, Caleb's nephew
short: Othniel, Caleb's nephew, was the first judge of Israel who delivered the people from Cushan-Rishathaim.

name: Ozem
description: David's brother living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Brother of David
short: Ozem was one of David's brothers, a son of Jesse.

name: Ozem
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Nephew of Caleb
short: Ozem was a son of Jerahmeel and a nephew of Caleb.

name: Paarai
description: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: One of David's mighty men
short: Paarai the Arbite was one of David's mighty men, known for his military prowess.

name: Padon
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Ancestor of temple servants
short: Padon was an ancestor of a group of temple servants who returned from the Babylonian exile.

name: Pagiel
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Leader of the tribe of Asher
short: Pagiel, son of Ochran, was the leader of the tribe of Asher during the wilderness wanderings.

name: Pahath-moab
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Group of returnees from Babylonian exile
short: Pahath-moab was a group of people who returned to Jerusalem from the Babylonian exile, some of whom married foreign women.

name: Pahath-moab
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Signatory of the covenant
short: Pahath-moab was one of the leaders who signed the covenant of renewal during Nehemiah's time.

name: Pahath-moab
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Repairer of the wall of Jerusalem
short: Pahath-moab was one of the people who repaired a section of the wall of Jerusalem under Nehemiah's leadership.

name: Palal
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Son of Uzai, repaired Jerusalem's wall
short: Palal, son of Uzai, repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall near the Parbar during Nehemiah's time.

name: Pallu
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Reuben, ancestor of the Palluites
short: Pallu was a son of Reuben and the ancestor of the Palluite clan within the tribe of Reuben.

name: Palti
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Michal's husband from Gallim
short: Palti (Paltiel), son of Laish, was Michal's husband from Gallim before she was taken back by David.

name: Palti
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Raphu, spy from Benjamin
short: Palti, son of Raphu, was the spy from the tribe of Benjamin sent to explore Canaan.

name: Paltiel
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Leader from Issachar, helped divide Canaan
short: Paltiel, son of Azzan, was the leader from the tribe of Issachar who helped divide the land of Canaan.

name: Parmashta
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Son of Haman, killed by the Jews
short: Parmashta was one of Haman's ten sons killed by the Jews in Susa during the events of Purim.

name: Parmenas
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: One of the seven deacons
short: Parmenas was one of the seven men chosen by the apostles to serve as deacons in the early church.

name: Parnach
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Father of Elizaphan, leader from Zebulun
short: Parnach was the father of Elizaphan, the leader from the tribe of Zebulun who helped divide the land of Canaan.

name: Parosh
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Family that returned from Babylonian exile
short: Parosh was the head of a family that returned to Jerusalem from the Babylonian exile, some of whom married foreign women.

name: Parosh
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Leader who returned with Zerubbabel
short: Parosh was a leader who returned to Jerusalem with Zerubbabel, bringing a group of his descendants.

name: Parosh
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A clan leader who sealed Nehemiah's covenant
short: Parosh, a clan leader who sealed the covenant of Nehemiah.

name: Parosh
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A man involved in repairing Jerusalem's wall
short: Parosh, a man who made repairs near the house of Pedaiah son of Parosh.

name: Parshandatha
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Son of Haman killed by the Jews
short: Parshandatha, one of the ten sons of Haman killed by the Jews.

name: Paruah
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Father of one of Solomon's district governors
short: Paruah, the father of Jehoshaphat, who was one of Solomon's twelve district governors.

name: Pasach
description: Man living before Israel's Monarchy
brief: Son of Japhlet from the tribe of Asher
short: Pasach, a son of Japhlet, who was a descendant of Asher.

name: Paseah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Eshton from the tribe of Judah
short: Paseah, a son of Eshton, who was from the tribe of Judah.

name: Paseah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Ancestor of temple servants who returned from exile
short: Paseah, whose descendants were among the temple servants that returned from Babylonian exile.

name: Paseah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Father of Joiada, who repaired the Old Gate
short: Paseah the father of Joiada (or 'Jehoiada'), who helped repair the Old Gate of Jerusalem.

name: Pashhur
description: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Head of a priestly family that returned from exile
short: Pashhur, the ancestor of a priestly family that returned from Babylonian exile.

name: Pashhur
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Priest who opposed Jeremiah and was renamed Magor-missabib
short: Pashhur, a priest who opposed Jeremiah and was renamed Magor-missabib, meaning "terror on every side."

name: Pashhur
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Priest sent by Zedekiah to inquire of Jeremiah
short: Pashhur, a priest King Zedekiah sent to inquire of Jeremiah.

name: Pashhur
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Gedaliah, an official who opposed Jeremiah
short: Pashhur, the son of Gedaliah, one of the officials who opposed Jeremiah.

name: Pashhur
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Priest who sealed Nehemiah's covenant
short: Pashhur, one of the priests who sealed the covenant in Nehemiah's time.

name: Patrobas
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Believer in Rome greeted by Paul
short: Patrobas, a believer in Rome to whom Paul sent greetings.

name: Paul
description: Apostle living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Apostle to the Gentiles, author of many NT epistles
short: Paul, also known as Saul, the apostle to the Gentiles and author of many New Testament epistles.

name: Pedahel
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Leader from Naphtali appointed to divide Canaan
short: Pedahel, son of Ammihud, the leader from Naphtali appointed to help divide Canaan.

name: Pedahzur
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Father of Gamaliel, leader from Manasseh
short: Pedahzur, father of Gamaliel, the leader from the tribe of Manasseh during the wilderness wanderings.

name: Pedaiah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Officer over the half-tribe of Manasseh
short: Pedaiah, son of Parosh, an officer over the half-tribe of Manasseh in King David's administration.

name: Pedaiah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Descendant of King Jehoiachin of Judah
short: Pedaiah, a descendant of King Jehoiachin of Judah born during the Babylonian captivity.

name: Pedaiah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Father of Zebidah, mother of King Jehoiakim
short: Pedaiah, father of Zebidah, who was the mother of King Jehoiakim of Judah.

name: Pedaiah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Benjamite who settled in Jerusalem after the exile
short: Pedaiah, a Benjamite who settled in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

name: Pedaiah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Levite appointed as a treasurer by Nehemiah
short: Pedaiah, a Levite Nehemiah appointed as a treasurer over the storehouses.

name: Pedaiah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Father of a man who repaired Jerusalem's wall
short: Pedaiah, father of a man who made repairs to the wall of Jerusalem in Nehemiah's time.

name: Pedaiah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Levite who assisted Ezra in reading the Law
short: Pedaiah, a Levite who stood with Ezra when he read the Law to the people.

name: Pekah
description: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: King of Israel who reigned for 20 years
short: Pekah, son of Remaliah, king of Israel who reigned for 20 years.

name: Pekahiah
description: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: King of Israel who reigned for 2 years
short: Pekahiah, son of Menahem, king of Israel who reigned for 2 years before being assassinated.

name: Pelaiah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Descendant of King David
short: Pelaiah, a descendant of King David, mentioned in the genealogy of 1Chronicles 3.

name: Pelaiah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Levite who helped explain the Law and signed the covenant
short: Pelaiah, a Levite who helped explain the Law to the people and signed Nehemiah's covenant.

name: Pelaliah
description: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Priest in Jerusalem during Nehemiah's time
short: Pelaliah, a priest who lived in Jerusalem during Nehemiah's time.

name: Pelatiah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Descendant of King Solomon
short: Pelatiah, a descendant of King Solomon mentioned in the genealogy of 1Chronicles 3.

name: Pelatiah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Simeonite leader who attacked the Amalekites
short: Pelatiah, a Simeonite leader who joined in an attack against the Amalekites.

name: Pelatiah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Prince of Israel whom Ezekiel saw in a vision
short: Pelatiah, a prince of Israel whom Ezekiel saw in a vision, and who died as Ezekiel prophesied.

name: Pelatiah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Priest who signed Nehemiah's covenant
short: Pelatiah, a priest who signed the covenant during Nehemiah's time.

name: Peleg
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Descendant of Shem, ancestor of Abraham
short: Peleg, a descendant of Shem and ancestor of Abraham, during whose time the earth was divided.

name: Pelet
description: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Benjamite warrior who joined David at Ziklag
short: Pelet, a Benjamite warrior who joined David at Ziklag, along with his brother Berachah.

name: Pelet
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Jahdai, descendant of Judah
short: Pelet, a son of Jahdai, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah in 1Chronicles 2.

name: Peleth
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Jonathan, descendant of Jerahmeel
short: Peleth, a son of Jonathan and descendant of Jerahmeel, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah.

name: Peleth
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Reubenite, father of On who rebelled against Moses
short: Peleth, a Reubenite; father of On who joined Korah's rebellion against Moses.

name: Peninnah
description: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Elkanah's wife, rival of Hannah
short: Peninnah, one of Elkanah's two wives and the rival of Hannah, Samuel's mother.

name: Penuel
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Hur, descendant of Judah
short: Penuel, a son of Hur and descendant of Judah, mentioned in the genealogy of 1Chronicles 4.

name: Penuel
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Shashak, descendant of Benjamin
short: Penuel, a son of Shashak and descendant of Benjamin, mentioned in the genealogy of 1Chronicles 8.

name: Peresh
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Machir, grandson of Manasseh
short: Peresh, a son of Machir and grandson of Manasseh, mentioned in the genealogy of 1Chronicles 7.

name: Perez
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Judah, ancestor of David and Jesus
short: Perez, son of Judah and Tamar, was an ancestor of King David and Jesus Christ.

name: Persis
description: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Female Christian in Rome greeted by Paul
short: Persis, a beloved female Christian in Rome whom Paul greeted in his letter to the Romans.

name: Peruda
