description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Ancestor of a family of Solomon's servants
short: Peruda or Perida, the ancestor of a family of Solomon's servants who returned from the Babylonian exile.

name: Peter
description: Apostle living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church
short: Peter, also known as Simon, Cephas, or Simon Bar-Jonah, was one of the twelve apostles of Jesus and a prominent leader in the early Christian church.

name: Pethahiah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Head of the 19th priestly division
short: Pethahiah, head of the 19th priestly division in the time of David.

name: Pethahiah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Levite who married a foreign woman
short: Pethahiah, a Levite who married a foreign woman during the time of Ezra.

name: Pethahiah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Levite appointed for the king's matters
short: Pethahiah, a Levite appointed to represent the people before the Persian king during the time of Nehemiah.

name: Pethahiah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Levite who led the people in confession
short: Pethahiah, a Levite who led the people in confession and worship during the time of Nehemiah.

name: Pethuel
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Father of the prophet Joel
short: Pethuel, the father of the prophet Joel, as mentioned in <ref="Jol.1.1">Joel.1.1</ref>.

name: Peullethai
description: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Son of Obed-Edom, a temple gatekeeper
short: Peullethai, the eighth son of Obed-Edom, a gatekeeper in the temple during the time of David.

name: Phanuel
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Father of the prophetess Anna
short: Phanuel, the father of Anna, a prophetess who witnessed the infant Jesus at the temple.

name: Pharaoh
description: Pharaoh living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Pharaoh and father-in-law of Mered, a descendant of Judah
short: Pharaoh, the Egyptian ruler whose daughter Bithiah married Mered, a descendant of Judah.

name: Pharaoh
description: Pharaoh living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Egyptian Pharaoh during Solomon's reign
short: Pharaoh, the Egyptian ruler who made an alliance with King Solomon and gave him his daughter in marriage.

name: Pharaoh
description: Pharaoh living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Egyptian Pharaoh during Hezekiah's reign
short: Pharaoh, the Egyptian ruler whom Judah's King Hezekiah sought as an ally against the Assyrian threat.

name: Pharaoh
description: Pharaoh living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Egyptian Pharaoh during Moses' birth and early life
short: Pharaoh, the Egyptian ruler who oppressed the Israelites and decreed the killing of Hebrew male infants during the time of Moses' birth.

name: Pharaoh
description: Pharaoh living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Egyptian Pharaoh during the Exodus
short: Pharaoh, the Egyptian ruler who refused to release the Israelites from slavery, resulting in the ten plagues and the Exodus.

name: Pharaoh
description: Pharaoh living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Egyptian ruler during Abraham's visit
short: Pharaoh, the Egyptian ruler who took Abraham's wife Sarah into his palace during their visit to Egypt.

name: Pharaoh
description: Pharaoh living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Egyptian ruler during Joseph's time
short: Pharaoh, the Egyptian ruler who elevated Joseph to a position of authority and welcomed his family to Egypt during a severe famine.

name: Pharaoh
description: Pharaoh living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Egyptian Pharaoh during Jeremiah's time
short: Pharaoh, the Egyptian ruler mentioned among those who would face God's judgment, as prophesied by Jeremiah.

name: Phicol
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Commander of Abimelech's army
short: Phicol, the commander of the army of Abimelech, the Philistine king of Gerar, who accompanied Abimelech in making treaties with Abraham and Isaac.

name: Philemon
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Recipient of Paul's letter, Colossian slave owner
short: Philemon, a Christian from Colossae to whom Paul wrote a letter appealing for the reconciliation with his runaway slave, Onesimus.

name: Philetus
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: False teacher who opposed Paul
short: Philetus, along with Hymenaeus, was a false teacher who had strayed from the truth and taught that the resurrection had already taken place.

name: Philip
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: One of the seven deacons, evangelized in Samaria
short: Philip, one of the seven deacons chosen by the early church in Jerusalem, who preached the gospel in Samaria and baptized an Ethiopian eunuch.

name: Philip
description: Tetrarch living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Tetrarch of Iturea and Traconitis
short: Philip, the son of Herod the Great, who ruled as tetrarch of Iturea and Traconitis during the time of John the Baptist's ministry.

name: Philip
description: Apostle living at the time of the New Testament
brief: One of the twelve apostles of Jesus
short: Philip, one of the twelve apostles chosen by Jesus, from Bethsaida in Galilee.

name: Philip
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Herod Antipas' brother, first husband of Herodias
short: Philip, the half-brother of Philip the Tetrarch, and Herod Antipas who took Philip's wife, leading to John the Baptist's condemnation of their marriage.

name: Philistine
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Descendants of Mizraim, son of Ham
short: The Philistines, a people group descended from Mizraim, the son of Ham, according to the Table of Nations in Genesis and 1 Chronicles.

name: Philologus
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Believer in Rome greeted by Paul
short: Philologus, a Christian in Rome to whom Paul sent greetings in his letter to the Romans.

name: Phinehas
description: Priest living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Wicked son of Eli the priest
short: Phinehas, the son of Eli the priest, was known for his wickedness and died in battle against the Philistines along with his brother Hophni.

name: Phinehas
description: High Priest living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Aaron's grandson; zealous priest who opposed idolatry
short: Phinehas, the son of Eleazar and grandson of Aaron, was a priest known for his zeal in opposing idolatry and turning away God's wrath from Israel.

name: Phinehas
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Priest during Ezra's time
short: Phinehas, a priest who assisted in weighing and recording the gold, silver, and vessels brought to Jerusalem by Ezra.

name: Phlegon
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Believer in Rome greeted by Paul
short: Phlegon, a Christian in Rome to whom Paul sent greetings in his letter to the Romans.

name: Phoebe
description: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Deacon of the church in Cenchreae
short: Phoebe, a deacon of the church in Cenchreae, whom Paul commended to the believers in Rome.

name: Phygelus
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Believer who deserted Paul in Asia
short: Phygelus, along with Hermogenes, was mentioned by Paul as having deserted him during his ministry in Asia.

name: Pilate
description: Ruler living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Roman governor who presided over Jesus' trial
short: Pontius Pilate, the Roman governor of Judea who presided over the trial of Jesus and ultimately ordered his crucifixion.

name: Pildash
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Nephew of Abraham
short: Pildash, one of the sons of Nahor, Abraham's brother, and Milcah.

name: Pilha
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Signatory to Nehemiah's covenant
short: Pilha, one of the leaders of the people who signed the covenant during Nehemiah's time.

name: Piltai
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Head of a priestly family
short: Piltai, the head of the priestly family of Moadiah during the time of Joiakim, the high priest.

name: Pinon
description: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Edomite clan chief descended from Esau
short: Pinon, one of the chiefs of Edom, descended from Esau, mentioned in the genealogies of Genesis and 1 Chronicles.

name: Piram
description: King living before Israel's Monarchy
brief: Amorite king of Jarmuth
short: Piram, the Amorite king of Jarmuth, who joined a coalition against Joshua and the Israelites.

name: Pispa
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Descendant of Asher
short: Pispa, a descendant of Asher, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Asher in 1 Chronicles.

name: Pithon
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Descendant of King Saul
short: Pithon, a descendant of King Saul, mentioned in the genealogies of the tribe of Benjamin in 1 Chronicles.

name: Pochereth-hazzebaim
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Family of Solomon's servants
short: Pochereth-hazzebaim, a family listed among the descendants of Solomon's servants who returned from the Babylonian exile.

name: Poratha
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Son of Haman, enemy of the Jews
short: Poratha, one of the ten sons of Haman, who was hanged along with his brothers after their father's downfall.

name: Potiphar
description: Egyptian living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Egyptian official who bought Joseph as a slave
short: Potiphar, the Egyptian officer who purchased Joseph as a slave and later imprisoned him after false accusations by Potiphar's wife.

name: Potiphera
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Egyptian priest, father-in-law of Joseph
short: Potiphera, the priest of On (Heliopolis), whose daughter Asenath was given to Joseph as a wife by Pharaoh.

name: Priscilla
description: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Early Christian teacher; wife of Aquila
short: Priscilla, also known as Prisca, was a Jewish Christian and the wife of Aquila, who worked with Paul in his ministry and hosted a church in their home.

name: Prochorus
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: One of the seven deacons in Jerusalem
short: Prochorus, one of the seven men chosen by the early church in Jerusalem to oversee the daily distribution of food to widows.

name: Puah
description: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Hebrew midwife in Egypt
short: Puah, one of the two Hebrew midwives, along with Shiphrah, who defied Pharaoh's order to kill male Hebrew babies.

name: Puah
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Issachar, grandson of Jacob
short: Puah, also known as Puvah, was a son of Issachar and grandson of Jacob, and his descendants were called the Punites.

name: Puah
description: Man living before Israel's Monarchy
brief: Father of judge Tola
short: Puah, the son of Dodo from the tribe of Issachar, who's son Tola judged Israel after Abimelech.

name: Publius
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Chief official of Malta who hosted Paul
short: Publius, the chief official of Malta, who hosted Paul and his companions for three days after their shipwreck on the island.

name: Pudens
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Christian in Rome who greeted Timothy
short: Pudens, a Christian in Rome who sent greetings to Timothy through Paul's letter.

name: Purah
description: Man living before Israel's Monarchy
brief: Gideon's servant who accompanied him to the Midianite camp
short: Purah was Gideon's servant who went with him to spy on the Midianite camp.

name: Put
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Ham, grandson of Noah
short: Put was a son of Ham and grandson of Noah.

name: Putiel
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Father-in-law of Eleazar, son of Aaron
short: Putiel was the father-in-law of Eleazar, son of Aaron.

name: Pyrrhus
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: A Berean who accompanied Paul to Asia
short: Pyrrhus was a Berean who accompanied Paul on his journey to Asia.

name: Quartus
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: A Christian brother in Corinth who sent greetings to Rome
short: Quartus, a Christian brother in Corinth, sent greetings to the believers in Rome through Paul's letter.

name: Queen of Sheba
description: Queen living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: A queen who visited Solomon and praised his wisdom
short: The Queen of Sheba visited King Solomon, tested him with questions, and praised his wisdom and prosperity.

name: Quirinius
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Governor of Syria during a census mentioned in Luke
short: Quirinius was the governor of Syria when a census was taken, as mentioned in Luke's Gospel.

name: Raamah
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Cush, grandson of Ham, great-grandson of Noah
short: Raamah was a son of Cush, grandson of Ham, and great-grandson of Noah, mentioned in the Table of Nations.

name: Rab-mag
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A Babylonian official present at the fall of Jerusalem
short: Rab-mag, a Babylonian official, was present at the capture of Jerusalem by Nebuchadnezzar's army.

name: Rab-saris
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A Babylonian official sent by King Sennacherib to Jerusalem
short: Rab-saris was one of the Babylonian officials sent by King Sennacherib to Jerusalem during his campaign against Judah.

name: Rab-saris
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A Babylonian official present at the fall of Jerusalem
short: Rab-saris, a Babylonian official, was present at the capture of Jerusalem by Nebuchadnezzar's army.

name: Rabshakeh
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A Babylonian official who taunted Hezekiah and Jerusalem's people
short: Rabshakeh was a Babylonian official who tried to intimidate Hezekiah and the people of Jerusalem into surrendering.

name: Rachel
description: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Wife of Jacob; mother of Joseph and Benjamin
short: Rachel was the beloved wife of Jacob, and the mother of Joseph and Benjamin.

name: Raddai
description: David's brother living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: One of David's brothers, son of Jesse
short: Raddai was one of David's brothers, a son of Jesse.

name: Rahab
description: Woman living before Israel's Monarchy
brief: A Canaanite woman who helped the Israelite spies in Jericho
short: Rahab, a Canaanite woman from Jericho, hid the Israelite spies and was spared during the city's destruction.

name: Raham
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Shema and founder of Jorkeam, of Judah
short: Raham was the son of Shema and the father or founder of Jorkeam, from the tribe of Judah.

name: Rakem
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Sheresh, of the tribe of Manasseh
short: Rakem was a son of Sheresh, from the tribe of Manasseh.

name: Ram
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Firstborn son of Jerahmeel, of the tribe of Judah
short: Ram was the firstborn son of Jerahmeel, from the tribe of Judah.

name: Ram
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Ancestor of Elihu, who spoke to Job
short: Ram was an ancestor of Elihu, one of the men who spoke to Job.

name: Ram
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Son of Hezron, ancestor of David and Jesus
short: Ram was the son of Hezron and an ancestor of King David and Jesus Christ.

name: Ramiah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: One of the men who married foreign women
short: Ramiah was one of the men who had married foreign women during the time of Ezra.

name: Rapha
description: Giant living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Ancestor of Philistine giants; his descendants fought against David's warriors.
short: Rapha was the ancestor of several Philistine giants who fought against David and his mighty warriors.

name: Raphah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Binea, a descendant of King Saul
short: Raphah (or Rephaiah) was a son of Binea and a descendant of King Saul.

name: Raphu
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Father of Palti, a spy sent by Moses
short: Raphu was the father of Palti, one of the twelve spies sent by Moses to explore Canaan.

name: Reaiah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A Reubenite, son of Micah
short: Reaiah was a Reubenite, the son of Micah, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Reuben.

name: Reaiah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Ancestor of temple servants who returned from Babylonian exile
short: Reaiah was an ancestor of temple servants who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian exile.

name: Reba
description: King living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: A Midianite king killed by the Israelites
short: Reba was one of the five Midianite kings killed by the Israelites during the time of Moses.

name: Rebekah
description: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Wife of Isaac; mother of Jacob and Esau
short: Rebekah was the wife of Isaac and the mother of Jacob and Esau.

name: Rechab
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Ancestor of the Rechabites, who were faithful to God
short: Rechab was the ancestor of the Rechabites, a nomadic tribe known for their faithfulness to God's commands.

name: Rechab
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: A captain of Ishbosheth's army, with his brother Baanah
short: Rechab and his brother Baanah were captains in Ishbosheth's army during the time of David.

name: Rechab
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Father of Malchijah, who repaired the Dung Gate
short: Rechab was the father of Malchijah, who repaired the Dung Gate during the rebuilding of Jerusalem's walls.

name: Reelaiah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: One of the leaders who returned with Zerubbabel
short: Reelaiah (or Raamiah) was one of the leaders who returned to Jerusalem with Zerubbabel after the Babylonian exile.

name: Regem
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Jahdai, of the tribe of Judah
short: Regem was a son of Jahdai, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah.

name: Regem-melech
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A messenger sent to inquire of the Lord
short: Regem-melech was one of the messengers sent to the house of God to inquire of the Lord.

name: Rehabiah
description: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Eliezer, grandson of Moses, a Levite
short: Rehabiah was the son of Eliezer and grandson of Moses, a Levite with many descendants.

name: Rehob
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Father of Hadadezer, king of Zobah
short: Rehob was the father of Hadadezer, the king of Zobah, who was defeated by King David.

name: Rehob
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: One of the leaders who sealed the covenant
short: Rehob was one of the leaders who sealed the covenant during the time of Nehemiah.

name: Rehoboam
description: King living at the time of United Monarchyand Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Solomon, first king of Judah
short: Rehoboam was the son of Solomon and the first king of Judah after the division of the kingdom.

name: Rehum
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: One of the leaders who returned with Zerubbabel
short: Rehum (or Harim or Nehum) was one of the leaders who returned to Jerusalem with Zerubbabel after the Babylonian exile.

name: Rehum
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A Persian official who wrote to King Artaxerxes
short: Rehum was a Persian official who wrote to King Artaxerxes, attempting to stop the rebuilding of Jerusalem.

name: Rehum
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: One who sealed the covenant during Nehemiah's time
short: Rehum was one of the individuals who sealed the covenant during the time of Nehemiah.

name: Rehum
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A Levite who helped repair the wall of Jerusalem
short: Rehum was a Levite who helped repair a section of the wall of Jerusalem during Nehemiah's time.

name: Rei
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: A supporter of Solomon during Adonijah's rebellion
short: Rei was one of the people who remained loyal to King Solomon during Adonijah's attempt to seize the throne.

name: Rekem
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Hebron, of the tribe of Judah
short: Rekem was a son of Hebron, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah.

name: Rekem
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: A Midianite king killed by the Israelites
short: Rekem was one of the five Midianite kings killed by the Israelites during the time of Moses.

name: Remaliah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Father of Pekah, king of Israel
short: Remaliah was the father of Pekah, who became king of Israel and reigned for 20 years.

name: Rephael
description: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A gatekeeper of the temple during David's reign
short: Rephael was one of the gatekeepers of the temple during the reign of King David.

name: Rephah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Beriah, of the tribe of Asher
short: Rephah was a son of Beriah, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Asher.

name: Rephaiah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A descendant of King David
short: Rephaiah was a descendant of King David, mentioned in the genealogy of David's descendants.

name: Rephaiah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: A Simeonite leader who attacked the Amalekites
short: Rephaiah was a Simeonite leader who led an attack against the Amalekites during the time of Hezekiah.

name: Rephaiah
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Tola, of the tribe of Issachar
short: Rephaiah was a son of Tola, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Issachar.

name: Rephaiah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Son of Hur, who helped repair Jerusalem's wall
short: Rephaiah was the son of Hur and ruler of half the district of Jerusalem, who helped repair a section of the city wall.

name: Resheph
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Beriah, of the tribe of Asher
short: Resheph was a son of Beriah, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Asher.

name: Reu
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Peleg, ancestor of Abraham
short: Reu was the son of Peleg and an ancestor of Abraham, living to the age of 239 years.

name: Reuben
description: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Firstborn son of Jacob and Leah
short: Reuben was the firstborn son of Jacob and Leah, and his descendants formed one of the twelve tribes of Israel.

name: Reuel
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: A Benjamite, son of Ibnijah
short: Reuel was a Benjamite mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin.

name: Reuel
description: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Esau and Basemath, a chief of Edom
short: Reuel was a son of Esau and Basemath, and he became a chief in the land of Edom.

name: Reumah
description: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Concubine of Nahor, Abraham's brother
short: Reumah was the concubine of Nahor, Abraham's brother, and she bore him four sons.

name: Rezin
description: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: King of Aram (Syria) during the reign of Ahaz
short: Rezin was the king of Aram (Syria) who allied with Pekah, king of Israel, against Ahaz, king of Judah.

name: Rezin
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Ancestor of a family of temple servants (Nethinim)
short: Rezin was the ancestor of a family of temple servants (Nethinim) who returned from the Babylonian exile.

name: Rezon
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Son of Eliada, adversary of Solomon
short: Rezon, son of Eliada, was an adversary of Solomon who reigned over Aram (Syria) in Damascus.

name: Rhesa
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Son of Zerubbabel, ancestor of Jesus
short: Rhesa was the son of Zerubbabel and an ancestor of Jesus Christ, according to Luke's genealogy.

name: Rhoda
description: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Servant girl in the house of Mary
short: Rhoda was a servant girl in the house of Mary, the mother of John Mark, who recognized Peter's voice at the door.

name: Ribai
description: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Father of Ittai, one of David's mighty men
short: Ribai was the father of Ittai the Gibeathite, one of David's mighty men.

name: Rimmon
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Father of Baanah and Rechab, murderers of Ish-bosheth
short: Rimmon was a Beerothite and the father of Rechab and Baanah, who murdered Ish-bosheth, Saul's son.

name: Rinnah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Shimon, of the tribe of Judah
short: Rinnah was a son of Shimon, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah.

name: Riphath
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Gomer, grandson of Japheth
short: Riphath was a son of Gomer and grandson of Japheth, mentioned in the Table of Nations.

name: Rizia
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Ulla, of the tribe of Asher
short: Rizia was a son of Ulla, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Asher.

name: Rizpah
description: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Concubine of Saul; mother of Armoni and Mephibosheth
short: Rizpah was a concubine of King Saul and the mother of Armoni and Mephibosheth, who were executed by the Gibeonites.

name: Rohgah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Shomer, of the tribe of Asher
short: Rohgah was a son of Shomer (or 'Shamer'), mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Asher.

name: Romamti-ezer
description: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Heman, a Levitical singer
short: Romamti-ezer was a son of Heman and a Levitical singer during the reign of King David.

name: Rosh
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Benjamin, grandson of Jacob
short: Rosh (or Rapha) was a son of Benjamin and grandson of Jacob, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin.

name: Rufus
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Son of Simon of Cyrene, who carried Jesus' cross
short: Rufus was the son of Simon of Cyrene, who was compelled to carry Jesus' cross on the way to His crucifixion.

name: Rufus
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Believer in Rome, son of Paul's "mother"
short: Rufus was a believer in Rome, chosen in the Lord, whose mother had also been a mother figure to Paul.

name: Ruth
description: Woman living before Israel's Monarchy
brief: Moabite woman, ancestor of David and Jesus
short: Ruth was a Moabite woman who married Boaz and became an ancestor of King David and Jesus Christ.

name: Sabtah
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Cush, grandson of Ham
short: Sabtah (or Sabta) was a son of Cush and a grandson of Ham, mentioned in the Table of Nations.

name: Sabteca
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Cush, grandson of Ham
short: Sabteca was a son of Cush and a grandson of Ham, mentioned in the Table of Nations.

name: Sachar
description: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Son of Obed-edom, a Levitical gatekeeper
short: Sachar was a son of Obed-edom and a Levitical gatekeeper during the reign of King David.

name: Sachia
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Shaharaim, a Benjamite
short: Sachia was a son of Shaharaim, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin.

name: Sallai
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Benjamite who settled in Jerusalem after the exile
short: Sallai was a Benjamite who settled in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile, as recorded in Nehemiah 11.

name: Sallu
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Benjamite who lived in Jerusalem
short: Sallu was a Benjamite who lived in Jerusalem, as recorded in the genealogy of 1Chronicles 9.

name: Sallu
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Benjamite who settled in Jerusalem after the exile
short: Sallu was a Benjamite leader who settled in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile, as recorded in Nehemiah 11.

name: Sallu
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Priest who returned from Babylonian exile with Zerubbabel
short: Sallu (or Sallai) was a priest who returned from the Babylonian exile with Zerubbabel and later signed the covenant under Nehemiah.

name: Salma
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Hur, founder of Bethlehem
short: Salma was the son of Hur and the  father (ie founder) of Bethlehem, as mentioned in the genealogy of Judah.

name: Salmon
description: Man living before Israel's Monarchy
brief: Son of Nahshon; husband of Rahab; ancestor of David
short: Salmon (or Sala) was the son of Nahshon and husband of Rahab - an ancestor of King David and Jesus Christ.

name: Salome
description: Woman living at the time of New Testament - daughter of Herodias
brief: Danced for Herod, requested John the Baptist's execution
short: Salome, the daughter of Herodias, danced before Herod and requested the execution of John the Baptist.

name: Salome
description: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Witness of Jesus' crucifixion and resurrection
short: Salome was one of the women who witnessed Jesus' crucifixion and resurrection. She was perhaps the wife of Zebedee.

name: Salu
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Father of Zimri, a Simeonite prince
short: Salu was the father of Zimri, a Simeonite prince who was killed by Phinehas for his involvement with a Midianite woman.

name: Samgar
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Babylonian official present at the fall of Jerusalem
short: Samgar was a Babylonian official present at the fall of Jerusalem, as recorded in the book of Jeremiah.

name: Samlah
description: King living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: King of Edom before Israel had kings
short: Samlah was a king of Edom who reigned before Israel had kings, as mentioned in the genealogies of Esau.

name: Samson
description: Judge living before Israel's Monarchy
brief: Israelite judge with great strength from God
short: Samson was an Israelite judge known for his God-given strength, which he used to fight against the Philistines.

name: Samuel
description: Prophet living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Prophet and last judge of Israel before the kings
short: Samuel was a prophet and the last judge of Israel before the establishment of the monarchy, who anointed both Saul and David as kings.

name: Sanballat
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Governor of Samaria, opposed Nehemiah's rebuilding of Jerusalem
short: Sanballat was the governor of Samaria who opposed Nehemiah's efforts to rebuild the walls of Jerusalem.

name: Saph
description: Giant living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Philistine giant killed by Sibbechai the Hushathite
short: Saph (or Sippai) was a Philistine giant who was killed by Sibbechai the Hushathite during a battle with the Philistines.

name: Sapphira
description: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Wife of Ananias, lied to the apostles, died
short: Sapphira, along with her husband Ananias, lied to the apostles about the proceeds from a property sale and died as a result.

name: Sarah
description: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Wife of Abraham; mother of Isaac
short: Sarah (or Sarai) was the wife of Abraham and the mother of Isaac, through whom God fulfilled His promise to make Abraham a great nation.

name: Saraph
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Shelah, descendant of Judah
short: Saraph was a son of Shelah and a descendant of Judah, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah.

name: Saul
description: King living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel
short: Saul was the first king of Israel, anointed by the prophet Samuel, who initially followed God but later disobeyed and was rejected as king.

name: Sceva
description: Priest living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Jewish chief priest whose seven sons attempted to exorcise demons
short: Sceva was a Jewish chief priest whose seven sons attempted to exorcise demons in the name of Jesus, as mentioned in the book of Acts.

name: Seba
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Cush, brother of Raamah
short: Seba was a son of Cush and brother of Raamah.

name: Secundus
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Thessalonian believer who accompanied Paul
short: Secundus was a Thessalonian believer who accompanied Paul on his journey.

name: Segub
description: Man living before Israel's Monarchy
brief: Son of Hezron; father of Jair
short: Segub, son of Hezron, was the father of Jair, who had twenty-three cities in Gilead.

name: Segub
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Hiel the Bethelite
short: Segub was the son of Hiel, who rebuilt Jericho during Ahab's reign.

name: Seir
description: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Horite chief, ancestor of the Horites of Seir
short: Seir was a Horite chief and an ancestor of the Horites who inhabited the land of Seir.

name: Seled
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Nadab, died without children
short: Seled, a son of Nadab, died without having any children.

name: Semachiah
description: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Shemaiah, gatekeeper of the temple
short: Semachiah, a son of Shemaiah, served as a gatekeeper in the temple during the time of David.

name: Semein
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Ancestor of Jesus Christ
short: Semein is mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus Christ, as recorded in Luke's Gospel.

name: Sennacherib
description: Emperor living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Assyrian Emperor who invaded Judah
short: Sennacherib and Sargon were Assyrian kings who led military campaigns against Judah during the reigns of King Hezekiah and King Ahaz, respectively.

name: Seorim
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Priest during David's reign, head of the fourth division
short: Seorim was a priest who served during David's reign and was the head of the fourth priestly division.

name: Serah
description: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Daughter of Asher, sister of Asher's sons
short: Serah was the daughter of Asher and the sister of Asher's sons, as mentioned in the genealogies of the tribe of Asher.

name: Seraiah
description: Man living before Israel's Monarchy
brief: Son of Kenaz; father of Joab
short: Seraiah, the son of Kenaz, was the father of Joab, who was the father of the Valley of Craftsmen.

name: Seraiah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Asiel, descendant of Simeon
short: Seraiah, the son of Asiel, was a descendant of Simeon mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Simeon.

name: Seraiah
description: High Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: High priest during the reign of Zedekiah
short: Seraiah served as the high priest during the reign of King Zedekiah and was executed by the Babylonians after the fall of Jerusalem.

name: Seraiah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Officer under Gedaliah, son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite
short: Seraiah, the son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, was one of the officers who served under Gedaliah, the governor appointed by the Babylonians after the fall of Jerusalem.

name: Seraiah
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: David's scribe, also known as Shavsha, Sheva, Sheya, or Shisha
short: Seraiah, also known as Shavsha, Sheva, Sheya, or Shisha, served as David's scribe during his reign.

name: Seraiah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Priest who returned from Babylonian exile
short: Seraiah was a priest who returned from the Babylonian exile and is mentioned in the lists of returning exiles and priests.

name: Seraiah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Azriel, sent to capture Jeremiah and Baruch
short: Seraiah, the son of Azriel, was one of the men sent by King Jehoiakim to capture Jeremiah and Baruch.

name: Seraiah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Neriah's son, Baruch's brother, accompanied Zedekiah to Babylon
short: Seraiah, the son of Neriah and brother of Baruch, accompanied King Zedekiah to Babylon and carried a message from Jeremiah.

name: Sered
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Zebulun, ancestor of the Seredites
short: Sered was a son of Zebulun and the ancestor of the Seredite clan.

name: Sergius Paulus
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Proconsul of Cyprus, converted under Paul's ministry
short: Sergius Paulus, the proconsul of Cyprus, was an intelligent man who sought to hear the word of God and believed after witnessing Paul's confrontation with Elymas the sorcerer.

name: Serug
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Reu; father of Nahor, ancestor of Abraham
short: Serug was the son of Reu, the father of Nahor, and an ancestor of Abraham, living to the age of 230 years.

name: Seth
description: Man living at the time before the Flood
brief: Third son of Adam and Eve, ancestor of righteous line
short: Seth was the third son of Adam and Eve, born after the death of Abel, and became the ancestor of the righteous line of humanity.

name: Sethur
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Michael, spy from the tribe of Asher
short: Sethur, the son of Michael, was one of the twelve spies sent by Moses to scout out the land of Canaan, representing the tribe of Asher.

name: Shaaph
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Jahdai, a Calebite
short: Shaaph, a son of Jahdai, was a descendant of Caleb.

name: Shaaph
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Maacah, Caleb's concubine
short: Shaaph, a son of Caleb's concubine Maacah, was the father of Madmannah.

name: Shaashgaz
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Eunuch in charge of King Ahasuerus' concubines
short: Shaashgaz was the eunuch appointed by King Ahasuerus to be in charge of the concubines in the royal harem.

name: Shabbethai
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Levite who opposed Ezra's marriage reforms
short: Shabbethai, a Levite, opposed Ezra's efforts to address the issue of intermarriage among the returned exiles.

name: Shabbethai
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Levite in charge of external affairs in Jerusalem
short: Shabbethai, a Levite, was responsible for overseeing external affairs in Jerusalem during the time of Nehemiah.

name: Shabbethai
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Levite who helped explain the Law to the people
short: Shabbethai, a Levite, assisted in explaining the Law to the people during the public reading led by Ezra.

name: Shaharaim
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Benjamite who had wives Hushim and Baara
short: Shaharaim, a Benjamite, had two wives, Hushim and Baara, and he sent them away.

name: Shallum
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Sismai, descendant of Judah
short: Shallum, the son of Sismai, was a descendant of Judah through the line of Jerahmeel.

name: Shallum
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Josiah, king of Judah
short: Shallum was a son of Josiah, king of Judah, and the brother of Jehoiakim and Zedekiah.

name: Shallum
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Shaul, descendant of Simeon
short: Shallum was the son of Shaul and a descendant of Simeon.

name: Shallum
description: Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: High priest, son of Zadok and father of Hilkiah
short: Shallum, also known as Meshullam, was a high priest during the time of the kings of Judah, serving as the son of Zadok and the father of Hilkiah.

name: Shallum
description: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Gatekeeper of the tabernacle during David's reign
short: Shallum was a gatekeeper of the tabernacle during the reign of David, and his descendants continued to serve as gatekeepers in the temple.

name: Shallum
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Ephraimite leader who opposed taking captives from Judah
short: Shallum, along with other leaders from Ephraim, opposed the army of Israel taking captives from Judah during the reign of King Ahaz.

name: Shallum
description: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: King of Israel who conspired against Zechariah
short: Shallum, son of Jabesh, conspired against Zechariah, king of Israel, assassinated him, and succeeded him as king, reigning for one month.

name: Shallum
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Husband of Huldah the prophetess
short: Shallum, the husband of Huldah the prophetess, was the keeper of the wardrobe during the reign of King Josiah.

name: Shallum
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Singer who married a foreign woman during Ezra's time
short: Shallum was one of the singers who had married a foreign woman and agreed to put her away during Ezra's reforms.

name: Shallum
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Israelite who married a foreign woman during Ezra's time
short: Shallum was one of the Israelites who had married a foreign woman and pledged to put her away during Ezra's reforms.

name: Shallum
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Uncle of Jeremiah the prophet
short: Shallum was the uncle of Jeremiah the prophet and the father of Hanamel, who sold a field to Jeremiah.

name: Shallum
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Father of Maaseiah, keeper of the threshold
short: Shallum was the father of Maaseiah, who was a keeper of the threshold during the time of Jeremiah the prophet.

name: Shallum
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Son of Hallohesh, repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall
short: Shallum, the son of Hallohesh and ruler of half the district of Jerusalem, repaired a section of the city wall along with his daughters.

name: Shallum
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Son of Col-hozeh, repaired the Fountain Gate
short: Shallum, the son of Col-hozeh and ruler of the district of Mizpah, repaired the Fountain Gate and the wall of the Pool of Shelah during Nehemiah's rebuilding of Jerusalem's walls.

name: Shalmai
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Nethinim ancestor whose descendants returned from Babylonian exile
short: Shalmai (or Shamlai) was an ancestor of the Nethinim, and his descendants were among those who returned to Jerusalem from the Babylonian exile.

name: Shalmaneser
description: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Assyrian king who conquered Samaria and exiled Israelites
short: Shalmaneser, king of Assyria, besieged Samaria and conquered the northern kingdom of Israel, exiling its inhabitants and ending the kingdom's existence.

name: Shama
description: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Mighty man in David's army, a Harodite
short: Shama, the son of Hotham the Aroerite, was one of the mighty men in David's army.

name: Shamgar
description: Judge living before Israel's Monarchy
brief: Judge of Israel who killed 600 Philistines
short: Shamgar, the son of Anath, was a judge of Israel who delivered the nation by killing 600 Philistines with an oxgoad.

name: Shamhuth
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Fifth division commander in David's army
short: Shamhuth the Izrahite was the commander of the fifth division in David's army, serving during the fifth month.

name: Shamir
description: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Levite descendant of Uzziel
short: Shamir (or Shamur) was a Levite descended from Uzziel, the son of Kohath.

name: Shamma
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Zophah, descendant of Asher
short: Shamma was a son of Zophah and a descendant of Asher.

name: Shammah
description: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Mighty man in David's army, defended a lentil field
short: Shammah, one of David's mighty men, single-handedly defended a lentil field against the Philistines, resulting in a great victory for Israel.

name: Shammah
description: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Mighty man in David's army, a Harodite
short: Shammah (or Shammoth) the Harodite was one of David's mighty men, known for his bravery and skill in battle.

name: Shammah
description: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Mighty man in David's army, son of Agee the Hararite
short: Shammah (or Shagee) the Hararite, the son of Agee, was one of David's mighty men, known for his bravery and skill in battle.

name: Shammah
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Reuel, grandson of Esau
short: Shammah was a son of Reuel and a grandson of Esau, and he became a chief of Edom.

name: Shammai
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Onam; father of Nadab and Abishur
short: Shammai, the son of Onam, was the father of Nadab and Abishur, who were descendants of Jerahmeel, the son of Hezron.

name: Shammai
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Father of Maon, ancestor of Caleb
short: Shammai was the father of Maon and an ancestor of Caleb, a prominent figure in the tribe of Judah.

name: Shammai
description: Man living before Israel's Monarchy
brief: Son of Mered
short: Shammai, the son of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh and Mered who was a descendant of Judah.

name: Shammua
description: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Son of David born in Jerusalem
short: Shammua (or Shimea) was one of the sons of David born to him in Jerusalem.

name: Shammua
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Priest during the time of Nehemiah
short: Shammua was a priest who served during the time of Nehemiah and was a signatory to the covenant renewal.

name: Shammua
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Spy from the tribe of Reuben
short: Shammua, the son of Zaccur, was the spy representing the tribe of Reuben who was sent to explore the land of Canaan.

name: Shamsherai
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Benjamite descendant living in Jerusalem
short: Shamsherai was a Benjamite descendant who lived in Jerusalem during the time of the genealogical records in 1 Chronicles.

name: Shapham
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Gadite leader during the reign of Jotham
short: Shapham was a leader of the Gadites who lived in Gilead during the reign of Jotham, king of Judah.

name: Shaphan
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Scribe during the reign of King Josiah
short: Shaphan, the scribe, played a significant role in the religious reforms of King Josiah and the events surrounding the fall of Jerusalem to the Babylonians.

name: Shaphan
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Father of Jaazaniah, an idolatrous worshipper
short: Shaphan was the father of Jaazaniah, one of the seventy elders of Israel who were involved in idolatrous practices in the temple.

name: Shaphat
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Overseer of David's herds in the valleys
short: Shaphat, the son of Adlai, was appointed by King David as the overseer of his herds that grazed in the valleys.

name: Shaphat
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Descendant of David during the postexilic period
short: Shaphat was a descendant of King David who lived during the postexilic period, as recorded in the genealogies of 1 Chronicles.

name: Shaphat
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Gadite leader during the reign of Jotham
short: Shaphat was a leader of the Gadites who lived in Bashan during the reign of Jotham, king of Judah.

name: Shaphat
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Father of Elisha the prophet
short: Shaphat was the father of Elisha, the prophet who succeeded Elijah and performed many miracles during the reigns of the kings of Israel.

name: Shaphat
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Spy from the tribe of Simeon
short: Shaphat, the son of Hori, was the spy representing the tribe of Simeon who was sent to explore the land of Canaan.

name: Sharai
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Israelite who divorced his foreign wife
short: Sharai was one of the Israelites who had married a foreign woman and agreed to divorce her as part of Ezra's religious reforms.

name: Sharar
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Father of Ahiam, one of David's mighty men
short: Sharar (or Sachar) was the father of Ahiam, who was one of David's mighty men known for his bravery and military prowess.

name: Sharezer
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Assyrian prince who assassinated his father Sennacherib
short: Sharezer, along with his brother Adrammelech, assassinated their father, King Sennacherib of Assyria, and fled to the land of Ararat.

name: Sharezer
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Delegate sent to inquire about fasting
short: Sharezer was part of a delegation sent to the house of God to inquire about the necessity of fasting in the fifth month.

name: Shashai
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Israelite who divorced his foreign wife
short: Shashai was one of the Israelites who had married a foreign woman and agreed to divorce her as part of Ezra's religious reforms.

name: Shashak
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Benjamite leader and descendant of Elpaal
short: Shashak, a Benjamite leader, was a descendant of Elpaal and is mentioned in the genealogical records of 1 Chronicles.

name: Shaul
description: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Levite descendant of Kohath
short: Shaul (or Joel) was a Levite descended from Kohath, as listed in the genealogies of 1 Chronicles.

name: Shaul
description: King living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: King of Edom from Rehoboth on the Euphrates
short: Shaul, from Rehoboth on the Euphrates, was a king of Edom who reigned after Samlah and before Baal-hanan.

name: Shaul
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Simeon, grandson of Jacob
short: Shaul, the son of Simeon, was the grandson of Jacob and is listed among the descendants who went to Egypt with Jacob.

name: Sheal
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Israelite who divorced his foreign wife
short: Sheal was one of the Israelites who had married a foreign woman and agreed to divorce her as part of Ezra's religious reforms.

name: Shealtiel
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Grandfather of Zerubbabel, descendant of David
short: Shealtiel, the grandfather of Zerubbabel, was a descendant of David and played a significant role in the rebuilding of the temple after the Babylonian exile.

name: Shealtiel
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Ancestor of Jesus in Luke's genealogy
short: Shealtiel is mentioned in Luke's genealogy of Jesus as an ancestor in the line of David.

name: Sheariah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Benjamite descendant, son of Azel
short: Sheariah was a Benjamite, the son of Azel, and is mentioned in the genealogical records of 1 Chronicles.

name: Shear-jashub
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Isaiah the prophet
short: Shear-jashub, meaning "a remnant shall return," was the son of the prophet Isaiah and accompanied his father to meet King Ahaz.

name: Sheba
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Gadite leader during the reign of Jotham
short: Sheba was one of the Gadite leaders who lived in Bashan during the reign of Jotham, king of Judah.

name: Sheba
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Benjamite rebel against King David
short: Sheba, a Benjamite, led a rebellion against King David but was ultimately defeated, and his head was delivered to Joab.

name: Sheba
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Descendant of Joktan, settling in southern Arabia
short: Sheba, a descendant of Joktan, is associated with the ancient kingdom of Sheba in southern Arabia, known for its wealth and trade.

name: Sheba
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Descendants of Cush, known for wealth and trade
short: The Sabeans, descendants of Cush, were known for their wealth, trade in spices and precious stones, and were mentioned in various contexts throughout the Old Testament.

name: Sheba
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Descendant of Abraham and Keturah
short: Sheba was one of the sons of Jokshan, a descendant of Abraham through his wife Keturah, and is associated with the peoples of southern Arabia.

name: Shebaniah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Priest who blew trumpets before the ark
short: Shebaniah was one of the priests who blew trumpets before the ark of God when David brought it to Jerusalem.

name: Shebaniah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Priest who signed the covenant with Nehemiah
short: Shebaniah was one of the priests who signed the covenant document during the time of Nehemiah, pledging to follow God's law.

name: Shebaniah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Priest during the time of Nehemiah
short: Shebaniah (or Shecaniah) was a priest who served during the time of Nehemiah and is mentioned in the lists of priests and their descendants.

name: Shebaniah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Levite who led the people in prayer
short: Shebaniah, a Levite, was one of the leaders who guided the people in prayer and confession during the time of Ezra and Nehemiah.

name: Sheber
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Caleb and his concubine Maacah
short: Sheber was one of the sons born to Caleb and his concubine Maacah, as mentioned in the genealogy of Judah.

name: Shebna
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Steward of the palace during Hezekiah's reign
short: Shebna was a high-ranking official in King Hezekiah's court, serving as the steward of the palace, but was later demoted and replaced by Eliakim.

name: Shebuel
description: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Levite descendant of Gershom, in charge of treasuries
short: Shebuel (or Shubael), a descendant of Gershom, was a Levite appointed by King David to be in charge of the treasuries of the house of God.

name: Shebuel
description: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Levite musician in David's time
short: Shebuel (or Shubael) was a Levite musician appointed by King David to prophesy with lyres, harps, and cymbals in the temple service.

name: Shecaniah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Levite priest in David's time
short: Shecaniah, a Levite priest during the reign of King David.

name: Shecaniah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Descendant of David through Jeconiah
short: Shecaniah was a descendant of King David through Jeconiah and is mentioned in the genealogy of David's descendants after the Babylonian exile.

name: Shecaniah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Levite in Hezekiah's time
short: Shecaniah, a Levite who assisted in distributing tithes during Hezekiah's reign.

name: Shecaniah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Israelite who confessed marrying a foreign wife
short: Shecaniah, an Israelite who admitted to marrying a foreign wife during Ezra's time.

name: Shecaniah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Descendant of Parosh who returned from exile
short: Shecaniah, a descendant of Parosh, who returned from Babylonian exile.

name: Shecaniah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Descendant of Jahaziel who returned from exile
short: Shecaniah, a descendant of Jahaziel, who returned from Babylonian exile.

name: Shecaniah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Father-in-law of Tobiah the Ammonite
short: Shecaniah, whose daughter married Tobiah the Ammonite, an enemy of Nehemiah.

name: Shechem
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Shemida, a Manassite
short: Shechem, a son of Shemida, from the tribe of Manasseh.

name: Shechem
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Founded the city where Dinah was raped
short: Shechem, founder of a Hivite city where Jacob's daughter Dinah was raped.

name: Shechem
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Gilead and Manassite clan
short: Shechem, a son of Gilead and forefather of a Manassite clan.

name: Shedeur
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Father of Elizur, a leader of Reuben
short: Shedeur, the father of Elizur, who was a leader of the tribe of Reuben.

name: Sheerah
description: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Ephraim's granddaughter who built three towns
short: Sheerah, granddaughter of Ephraim, who built Beth-horon and Uzzen-sheerah.

name: Shehariah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Descendant of Benjamin
short: Shehariah, a descendant of Benjamin in the genealogy of Saul.

name: Shelah
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Arpachshad and ancestor of Abraham
short: Shelah, son of Arpachshad and ancestor of Abraham in Luke's genealogy.

name: Shelah
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Judah's youngest son and his descendants
short: Shelah, Judah's third son, and his descendants, the Shelanites.

name: Shelemiah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Israelite who married a foreign wife
short: Shelemiah, an Israelite who married a foreign wife during the time of Ezra.

name: Shelemiah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Israelite who married a foreign wife
short: Shelemiah, another Israelite who married a foreign wife during Ezra's time.

name: Shelemiah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Grandfather of Jehudi, who read Jeremiah's scroll
short: Shelemiah, the grandfather of Jehudi, who read Jeremiah's scroll to the officials.

name: Shelemiah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Sent with Jerahmeel to arrest Jeremiah
short: Shelemiah was sent with Jerahmeel to arrest Jeremiah and Baruch.

name: Shelemiah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Father of Irijah, who arrested Jeremiah
short: Shelemiah, the father of Irijah, the guard who arrested Jeremiah.

name: Shelemiah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Priest during Zedekiah's reign
short: Shelemiah, a priest during King Zedekiah's reign; father of Jehucal.

name: Shelemiah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Priest appointed as a treasurer
short: Shelemiah, a priest appointed by Nehemiah as a treasurer.

name: Shelemiah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Levite who repaired part of Jerusalem's wall
short: Shelemiah, a Levite who repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall.

name: Sheleph
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Joktan, descendant of Shem
short: Sheleph, a son of Joktan and descendant of Shem.

name: Shelesh
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Hotham, an Asherite
short: Shelesh, a son of Hotham (or 'Helem'), from the tribe of Asher.

name: Shelomi
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Father of Ahihud, a leader from Asher
short: Shelomi, the father of Ahihud, a leader from the tribe of Asher.

name: Shelomith
description: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Levite descendant of Izhar
short: Shelomith (or Shelomoth), a Levite of the family of Izhar.

name: Shelomith
description: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Zerubbabel
short: Shelomith, a son of Zerubbabel, the governor of Judah after the exile.

name: Shelomith
description: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Daughter of Rehoboam with Absolom's daughter
short: Shelomith, of King Rehoboam with Absalom's daughter Maacah.

name: Shelomith
description: Woman living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Descendant of Bani who returned from exile
short: Shelomith, a descendant of Bani who returned from Babylonian exile.

name: Shelomith
description: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Mother of a blasphemer
short: Shelomith, the mother of a man who blasphemed God's name.

name: Shelomoth
description: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Levite descendants of Shimei
short: Shelomoth (or Shelomith), Levites of the family of Shimei, son of Gershon.

name: Shelomoth
