description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Firstborn son of Canaan, ancestor of the Sidonians.
short: Sidon was the firstborn son of Canaan and the ancestor of the Sidonian people.

name: Sihon
description: King living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Amorite king of Heshbon, defeated by the Israelites.
short: Sihon was the Amorite king of Heshbon who refused to let the Israelites pass through his land and was subsequently defeated by them.

name: Silas
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Prominent member of the Jerusalem church, companion of Paul.
short: Silas (or Silvanus) was a prominent member of the Jerusalem church who accompanied Paul on his second missionary journey and co-wrote some of his epistles.

name: Simeon
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Prophet and teacher in the church at Antioch.
short: Simeon, also called Niger, was a prophet and teacher in the church at Antioch who was involved in sending Paul and Barnabas on their first missionary journey.

name: Simeon
description: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Jacob and Leah, one of the twelve tribes.
short: Simeon, the second son of Jacob and Leah, was the founder of the tribe of Simeon and played a role in the story of Joseph.

name: Simeon
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Righteous and devout man who blessed Jesus in the temple.
short: Simeon was a righteous and devout man in Jerusalem who blessed the infant Jesus in the temple and prophesied about his future.

name: Simeon
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: An ancestor of Jesus mentioned in his genealogy.
short: Simeon is mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus as the son of Judah and the father of Levi.

name: Simon
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: A tanner in Joppa who hosted Peter.
short: Simon was a tanner in Joppa who hosted the apostle Peter in his home.

name: Simon
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Sorcerer in Samaria who tried to buy the Holy Spirit's power.
short: Simon was a sorcerer in Samaria who believed and was baptized but later tried to buy the power of the Holy Spirit from the apostles.

name: Simon
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Father of Judas Iscariot, the disciple who betrayed Jesus.
short: Simon was the father of Judas Iscariot, the disciple who betrayed Jesus.

name: Simon
description: Apostle living at the time of the New Testament
brief: One of the twelve apostles, also called the Zealot.
short: Simon, also known as the Zealot, was one of the twelve apostles chosen by Jesus.

name: Simon
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Brother of Jesus, son of Mary and Joseph.
short: Simon was one of the brothers of Jesus, a son of Mary and Joseph.

name: Simon
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: A man in Bethany who hosted Jesus for a meal.
short: Simon the leper was a man in Bethany who hosted a meal for Jesus, during which a woman anointed Jesus with expensive perfume.

name: Simon
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: A man who carried Jesus' cross on the way to crucifixion.
short: Simon of Cyrene was compelled by Roman soldiers to carry Jesus' cross on the way to his crucifixion.

name: Sisera
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Ancestor of a family of temple servants who returned from exile.
short: Sisera was the ancestor of a family of temple servants who returned to Jerusalem from the Babylonian exile.

name: Sisera
description: Deborah's adversary living before Israel's Monarchy
brief: Canaanite commander defeated by Deborah and Barak.
short: Sisera was the commander of the Canaanite army who was defeated by the Israelites under the leadership of Deborah and Barak.

name: Sismai
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Descendant of Judah through Jerahmeel.
short: Sismai was a descendant of Judah through Jerahmeel, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah.

name: Sithri
description: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Uzziel, a Levite of the Kohathite clan.
short: Sithri was a son of Uzziel, a Levite of the Kohathite clan, mentioned in the genealogy of the Levites.

name: So
description: Pharaoh living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Egyptian pharaoh to whom King Hoshea sent messengers.
short: So was an Egyptian pharaoh to whom King Hoshea of Israel sent messengers, likely seeking an alliance against Assyria.

name: Soco
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Heber, from the tribe of Judah.
short: Soco was a son of Heber, from the tribe of Judah, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah.

name: Sodi
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Father of the Zebulunite spy Gaddiel.
short: Sodi was the father of Gaddiel, the man chosen from the tribe of Zebulun to spy out the land of Canaan.

name: Solomon
description: King living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.
short: Solomon, also called Jedidiah, was the son of David and Bathsheba who succeeded his father as king of Israel and was renowned for his wisdom, wealth, and the construction of the First Temple in Jerusalem.

name: Sopater
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Companion of Paul from Berea, greeted the Roman church.
short: Sopater (or Sosipater) was a companion of Paul from Berea who accompanied him on his journey to Jerusalem and later sent greetings to the church in Rome.

name: Sophereth
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Ancestor of a family of Solomon's servants who returned from exile.
short: Sophereth (or Hassophereth) was the ancestor of a family of Solomon's servants who were among the exiles that returned to Jerusalem from Babylon.

name: Sosthenes
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Synagogue ruler in Corinth, co-sender of 1 Corinthians.
short: Sosthenes was a synagogue ruler in Corinth who was beaten by a mob and later became a co-sender of Paul's first letter to the Corinthians.

name: Sotai
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Ancestor of a family of Solomon's servants who returned from exile.
short: Sotai was the ancestor of a family of Solomon's servants who were among the exiles that returned to Jerusalem from Babylon.

name: Stachys
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Believer in Rome, greeted by Paul as a beloved friend.
short: Stachys was a believer in Rome whom Paul greeted as his beloved friend.

name: Stephanas
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Corinthian believer, baptized by Paul, sent to visit him.
short: Stephanas was a believer from Corinth who, along with his household, was baptized by Paul and later visited Paul to provide support and encouragement.

name: Stephen
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: One of seven deacons, full of faith, performed miracles, martyred.
short: Stephen, one of the seven deacons chosen by the early church, was full of faith and the Holy Spirit, performed miracles, and became the first Christian martyr after his powerful testimony before the Sanhedrin.

name: Suah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Zophah, from the tribe of Asher
short: Suah, a descendant of Asher mentioned in a genealogy.

name: Susanna
description: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Woman who helped support Jesus and his disciples
short: Susanna was one of the women who provided for Jesus out of her resources.

name: Susi
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Father of the Manassite spy Gaddi
short: Susi was the father of Gaddi, the spy from the tribe of Manasseh.

name: Syntyche
description: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Woman in the Philippian church whom Paul exhorted
short: Syntyche was a prominent woman in Philippi whom Paul urged to reconcile with Euodia.

name: Tabbaoth
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Family of temple servants who returned from exile
short: The Tabbaoth were a family of temple servants who returned to Judah from Babylonian exile.

name: Tabeal
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Man whom Syria and Ephraim wanted to make king of Judah
short: Tabeal was the man Syria and Ephraim conspired to make king of Judah in place of Ahaz.

name: Tabeel
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Persian official involved in accusing the Jews to Artaxerxes
short: Tabeel was a Persian official who joined in writing an accusation against the Jews to Artaxerxes.

name: Tabitha
description: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Charitable woman in Joppa whom Peter raised from the dead
short: Tabitha, also called Dorcas, was a beloved disciple in Joppa known for her charitable works, whom Peter raised from the dead.

name: Tabrimmon
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Father of Ben-hadad I, king of Syria
short: Tabrimmon was the father of Ben-hadad I, the king of Syria who was an ally of Asa king of Judah.

name: Tahan
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Telah, from the tribe of Ephraim
short: Tahan was a descendant of Ephraim, the son of Telah and father of Ladan.

name: Tahan
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Ephraim, ancestor of the Tahanites clan
short: Tahan was a son of Ephraim and the ancestor of the Tahanites clan.

name: Tahash
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Nahor and Reumah
short: Tahash was a son of Abraham's brother Nahor and his concubine Reumah.

name: Tahath
description: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Levite of the Kohathite clan, son of Assir
short: Tahath was a Levite of the Kohathite clan, the son of Assir and father of Uriel.

name: Tahath
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Descendant of Ephraim
short: Tahath, a descendant of Ephraim mentioned in the genealogy.

name: Tahath
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Another descendant of Ephraim
short: Tahath, another descendant of Ephraim mentioned in the genealogy.

name: Tahpenes
description: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Egyptian queen who raised Hadad the Edomite
short: Tahpenes was the queen of Egypt who gave her sister in marriage to Hadad the Edomite.

name: Talmai
description: King living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: King of Geshur; father of David's wife Maacah
short: Talmai was the king of Geshur and father of Maacah, one of David's wives and mother of Absalom.

name: Talmai
description: King living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Anakim king of Hebron, defeated by Judah
short: Talmai was one of the Anakim kings of Hebron defeated by Caleb and the men of Judah.

name: Talmon
description: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Levite gatekeeper who returned from Babylonian exile
short: Talmon was a Levite gatekeeper who returned from Babylon and served at the temple.

name: Tamar
description: David's daughter living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: David's daughter, raped by her half-brother Amnon
short: Tamar was David's daughter who was raped by her half-brother Amnon, leading to tragic consequences.

name: Tamar
description: Absalom's daughter living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Absalom's beautiful daughter
short: Tamar was the beautiful daughter of Absalom, named after his tragic sister.

name: Tamar
description: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Judah's daughter-in-law who bore Perez and Zerah
short: Tamar was Judah's daughter-in-law who, after being wronged by him, bore twin sons Perez and Zerah.

name: Tanhumeth
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Supporter of Gedaliah after Jerusalem's fall
short: Tanhumeth the Netophathite was one of the leaders who supported Gedaliah's governorship after Jerusalem's fall.

name: Taphath
description: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Daughter of Solomon; wife of Ben-abinadab
short: Taphath was a daughter of Solomon who married Ben-abinadab, one of Solomon's district governors.

name: Tappuah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Hebron from the tribe of Judah
short: Tappuah was a son of Hebron, a descendant of Judah.

name: Tarea
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Son of Micah and grandson of Mephibosheth
short: Tarea, also called Tahrea, was a son of Micah and grandson of Mephibosheth.

name: Tarshish
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Bilhan from the tribe of Benjamin
short: Tarshish was a son of Bilhan, a descendant of Benjamin.

name: Tarshish
description: Persian living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: One of the seven princes of Persia and Media
short: Tarshish was one of the seven princes of Persia and Media who had access to King Ahasuerus's presence and held the highest positions in the kingdom.

name: Tarshish
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Javan, great-grandson of Noah
short: Tarshish was a son of Javan and great-grandson of Noah, associated with the ancient city of Tarshish.

name: Tartan
description: Leader's title
brief: Title of an Assyrian military commander
short: The Tartan was a high-ranking Assyrian military commander who led campaigns against Ashdod and Jerusalem.

name: Tattenai
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Persian governor who questioned the Jews' authority to rebuild
short: Tattenai was the Persian governor of the province Beyond the River who questioned the Jews' authority to rebuild the temple.

name: Tebah
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Nahor and Reumah
short: Tebah was a son of Abraham's brother Nahor and his concubine Reumah.

name: Tebaliah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Levite gatekeeper, son of Hosah
short: Tebaliah was a Levite gatekeeper, the third son of Hosah.

name: Tehinnah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Father of Ir-nahash from the tribe of Judah
short: Tehinnah was the father of Ir-nahash and a descendant of Chelub from the tribe of Judah.

name: Telah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Resheph from the tribe of Ephraim
short: Telah was a descendant of Ephraim, the son of Resheph and father of Tahan.

name: Telem
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Temple servant who married a foreign wife
short: Telem was a temple servant who married a foreign wife during the Exile and later divorced her.

name: Tema
description: Arabian living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Ishmael, associated with an Arabian city
short: Tema was a son of Ishmael and is associated with the ancient Arabian city of Tema.

name: Temah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Ancestor of a family of temple servants
short: Temah was the ancestor of a family of temple servants who returned from the Babylonian exile.

name: Teman
description: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Grandson of Esau, associated with an Edomite clan
short: Teman was a grandson of Esau and is associated with an important Edomite clan known for its wisdom.

name: Temeni
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Ashhur (or 'Ashur') from the tribe of Judah
short: Temeni was a son of Ashhur (or 'Ashur') and a descendant of Judah.

name: Terah
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Abraham's father who settled in Haran
short: Terah was the father of Abraham, Nahor, and Haran, who left Ur to settle in Haran.

name: Teresh
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Persian official who plotted against King Ahasuerus
short: Teresh was one of two Persian officials who plotted to assassinate King Ahasuerus but were discovered by Mordecai.

name: Tertius
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Paul's scribe who wrote the Epistle to the Romans
short: Tertius served as Paul's scribe, writing down the Epistle to the Romans.

name: Tertullus
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Lawyer who accused Paul before Governor Felix
short: Tertullus was a lawyer hired by the Jewish authorities to accuse Paul before the Roman governor Felix.

name: Theophilus
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Recipient of Luke's Gospel and Acts
short: Theophilus was the recipient of Luke's Gospel and the Book of Acts, likely a Christian of high social standing.

name: Theudas
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Jewish rebel leader killed by Roman authorities
short: Theudas was a Jewish rebel leader who was killed, and his followers scattered, by the Roman authorities.

name: Thomas
description: Apostle living at the time of the New Testament
brief: One of Jesus' twelve disciples, known for doubting
short: Thomas, also called Didymus, was one of Jesus' twelve disciples, known for doubting Jesus' resurrection until he saw him in person.

name: Tiberius
description: Emperor living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Roman emperor during Jesus' ministry and death
short: Tiberius was the Roman emperor during Jesus' ministry and crucifixion, mentioned in several Gospel accounts.

name: Tibni
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Rival to Omri for the throne of Israel
short: Tibni was a rival to Omri for the throne of Israel, leading to a divided kingdom until his death.

name: Tidal
description: King living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: King of Goiim, ally of Chedorlaomer
short: Tidal, king of Goiim, was one of the four kings allied with Chedorlaomer in the battle against the five kings of the plain.

name: Tiglath-pileser
description: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Assyrian king who conquered parts of Israel
short: Tiglath-pileser, also known as Pul, was an Assyrian king who conquered parts of Israel and received tribute from King Menahem.

name: Tikvah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Father of Shallum, husband of Huldah the prophetess
short: Tikvah, also known as Tokhath, was the father of Shallum and the father-in-law of Huldah the prophetess.

name: Tikvah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Opposed Ezra's reforms regarding foreign wives
short: Tikvah was one of two men who opposed Ezra's reforms requiring Jewish men to divorce their foreign wives.

name: Tilon
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Shimon from the tribe of Judah
short: Tilon was a son of Shimon, a descendant of Judah.

name: Timaeus
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Father of Bartimaeus, a blind man healed by Jesus
short: Timaeus was the father of Bartimaeus, a blind beggar who was healed by Jesus near Jericho.

name: Timna
description: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Concubine of Eliphaz; mother of Amalek
short: Timna was a concubine of Eliphaz, son of Esau, and the mother of Amalek.

name: Timon
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: One of the seven chosen to serve the church
short: Timon was one of the seven men chosen by the apostles to oversee the daily distribution of food to widows in the early church.

name: Timothy
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Paul's young disciple and co-worker
short: Timothy was a young disciple and co-worker of Paul, who accompanied him on his missionary journeys and later served as a pastor.

name: Tiras
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Japheth, grandson of Noah
short: Tiras was a son of Japheth and grandson of Noah, listed among the nations descended from Noah after the flood.

name: Tirhakah
description: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: King of Cush (Ethiopia) who opposed Sennacherib
short: Tirhakah, the king of Cush (Ethiopia), opposed Sennacherib's invasion of Judah during the reign of King Hezekiah.

name: Tirhanah
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Caleb by his concubine Maacah
short: Tirhanah was a son of Caleb by his concubine Maacah, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah.

name: Tiria
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Jehallelel from the tribe of Judah
short: Tiria was a son of Jehallelel, a descendant of Judah, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah.

name: Tirzah
description: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Daughter of Zelophehad, granted inheritance rights
short: Tirzah was one of the five daughters of Zelophehad who were granted inheritance rights in the absence of male heirs.

name: Titus
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Gentile convert and companion of Paul
short: Titus was a Gentile convert and a trusted companion of Paul, who accompanied him on missionary journeys and served as his delegate to the church in Corinth.

name: Tobadonijah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Levite sent by Jehoshaphat to teach the Law
short: Tobadonijah was a Levite sent by King Jehoshaphat to teach the Book of the Law in the cities of Judah.

name: Tobiah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Ancestor of returned exiles unable to prove lineage
short: Tobiah was an ancestor of some returned exiles who were unable to prove their Israelite lineage and were excluded from the priesthood.

name: Tobiah
description: Nehemiah's adversary living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Ammonite official who opposed Nehemiah's rebuilding efforts
short: Tobiah was an Ammonite official who, along with Sanballat the Horonite, opposed Nehemiah's efforts to rebuild the walls of Jerusalem.

name: Tobijah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Levite sent by Jehoshaphat to teach the Law
short: Tobijah was a Levite sent by King Jehoshaphat to teach the Book of the Law in the cities of Judah.

name: Tobijah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Postexilic Jew who provided silver and gold for crowns
short: Tobijah was a postexilic Jew who, along with others, provided silver and gold to make crowns for Joshua the high priest.

name: Togarmah
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Gomer, grandson of Japheth
short: Togarmah was a son of Gomer and grandson of Japheth, mentioned in the Table of Nations.

name: Tohu
description: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Ancestor of the prophet Samuel
short: Tohu, also known as Nahath or Toah, was an ancestor of the prophet Samuel, mentioned in his genealogy.

name: Toi
description: King living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: King of Hamath who sent his son to David
short: Toi, also known as Tou, was the king of Hamath who sent his son Joram to congratulate David on his victory over Hadadezer.

name: Tola
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Issachar, ancestor of the Tolaites
short: Tola was a son of Issachar and the ancestor of the Tolaite clan.

name: Tola
description: Judge living before Israel's Monarchy
brief: Judge of Israel who succeeded Abimelech
short: Tola, the son of Puah, was a judge of Israel who ruled for 23 years after Abimelech's death.

name: Trophimus
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Gentile Christian from Ephesus, companion of Paul
short: Trophimus was a Gentile Christian from Ephesus who accompanied Paul on his missionary journeys and was falsely accused of defiling the temple in Jerusalem.

name: Tryphaena
description: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Christian woman in Rome greeted by Paul
short: Tryphaena was a Christian woman in Rome to whom Paul sent greetings in his letter to the Romans.

name: Tryphosa
description: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Christian woman in Rome greeted by Paul
short: Tryphosa was a Christian woman in Rome to whom Paul sent greetings in his letter to the Romans.

name: Tubal
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Japheth, grandson of Noah
short: Tubal was a son of Japheth and grandson of Noah, mentioned in the Table of Nations.

name: Tubal-cain
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Descendant of Cain, first metalworker
short: Tubal-cain, a descendant of Cain, was the first metalworker mentioned in the Bible, forging tools out of bronze and iron.

name: Tychicus
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Faithful companion and messenger of Paul
short: Tychicus was a faithful companion of Paul who served as his messenger to the churches in Asia Minor.

name: Tyrannus
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Ephesian teacher who hosted Paul's discussions
short: Tyrannus was a teacher in Ephesus who allowed Paul to use his lecture hall for daily discussions about the gospel.

name: Ucal
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Recipient of Agur's wisdom in Proverbs 30
short: Ucal is mentioned in <ref="Proverbs 30:1">Proverbs 30:1</ref> as one of the recipients of the wise sayings of Agur son of Jakeh.

name: Uel
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Israelite who agreed to put away his foreign wife
short: Uel was one of the Israelites who agreed to put away his foreign wife during the time of Ezra's reforms.

name: Ulam
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Sheresh, great-grandson of Manasseh
short: Ulam was a son of Sheresh and great-grandson of Manasseh, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Manasseh.

name: Ulam
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Descendant of Benjamin, known for his numerous descendants
short: Ulam was a descendant of Benjamin known for his numerous descendants, including many skilled archers.

name: Unni
description: Singer living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Levite musician during David's reign
short: Unni was a Levite musician who played the harp and participated in the procession when the ark was brought to Jerusalem during David's reign.

name: Unni
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Postexilic Levite who assisted in the temple
short: Unni was a postexilic Levite who assisted in the temple during the time of Nehemiah.

name: Ur
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Father of one of David's mighty men
short: Ur was the father of Eliphal, one of David's mighty men.

name: Urbanus
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament
brief: Christian in Rome greeted by Paul
short: Urbanus was a Christian in Rome whom Paul called a fellow worker in Christ and to whom he sent greetings.

name: Uri
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Father of Geber, one of Solomon's officers
short: Uri was the father of Geber, one of the twelve officers appointed by Solomon to provide for the king and his household.

name: Uri
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Father of Bezalel, the skilled craftsman
short: Uri was the father of Bezalel, the skilled craftsman chosen by God to construct the tabernacle and its furnishings.

name: Uri
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Postexilic Israelite who agreed to put away his foreign wife
short: Uri was one of the postexilic Israelites who agreed to put away his foreign wife during the time of Ezra's reforms.

name: Uriah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Priest during the reign of King Ahaz
short: Uriah was a priest during the reign of King Ahaz who followed the king's instructions in building a new altar based on a pagan model from Damascus.

name: Uriah
description: Bathsheba's husband living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Hittite soldier; husband of Bathsheba
short: Uriah was a Hittite soldier in David's army, the husband of Bathsheba, who was killed in battle as part of David's plan to cover up his adultery with Bathsheba.

name: Uriah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Postexilic priest involved in rebuilding the wall
short: Uriah was a postexilic priest who participated in rebuilding the wall of Jerusalem and was entrusted with the temple treasures.

name: Uriah
description: Prophet living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Prophet from Kiriath-jearim who prophesied against Jerusalem
short: Uriah was a prophet from Kiriath-jearim who prophesied against Jerusalem and Judah during the reign of King Jehoiakim, and was killed for his message.

name: Uriah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Priest who assisted Ezra in reading the Law
short: Uriah was one of the priests who assisted Ezra in reading the Law to the people during the religious revival in Jerusalem.

name: Uriel
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy

description: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Eliphaz, grandson of Esau
short: Zepho, a son of Eliphaz and grandson of Esau, was a chief of Edom.

name: Zerah
description: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Levite of the Gershonite clan
short: Zerah, a Levite of the Gershonite clan, was the son of Iddo.

name: Zerah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Ethiopian commander who invaded Judah
short: Zerah the Ethiopian led a vast army against Judah but was defeated by King Asa.

name: Zerah
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Reuel, grandson of Esau
short: Zerah, a son of Reuel and grandson of Esau, was a chief of Edom.

name: Zerah
description: King living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: King of Edom
short: Zerah, from Bozrah, was a king of Edom before Israel had a king.

name: Zerah
description: Judah's son living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Judah, twin of Perez
short: Zerah, son of Judah and Tamar, was the twin brother of Perez and ancestor of Achan.

name: Zerah
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Simeon; ancestor of the Zerahites
short: Zerah (or Zohar), a son of Simeon, was the ancestor of the Zerahite clan.

name: Zerahiah
description: Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Priest, ancestor of Ezra
short: Zerahiah (or Ahitub), a priest, was an ancestor of Ezra the scribe.

name: Zerahiah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Descendant of Pahath-Moab who returned with Ezra
short: Zerahiah, a descendant of Pahath-Moab, led 200 men in the return to Jerusalem with Ezra.

name: Zeresh
description: Woman living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Wife of Haman, enemy of the Jews
short: Zeresh, the wife of Haman, advised him to have Mordecai hanged on a gallows.

name: Zereth
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Ashhur, founder of Tekoa
short: Zereth, a son of Ashhur (or 'Ashur') and Helah, was a Judahite.

name: Zeri
description: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Son of Jeduthun, a temple musician
short: Zeri (or Izri), a son of Jeduthun, was a temple musician during the reign of David.

name: Zeror
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Ancestor of King Saul
short: Zeror, a Benjamite, was an ancestor of King Saul.

name: Zeruah
description: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Mother of Jeroboam, first king of Israel
short: Zeruah was the mother of Jeroboam, who became the first king of the northern kingdom of Israel.

name: Zerubbabel
description: Governor living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Leader of the first Jewish exiles from Babylon
short: Zerubbabel (or Sheshbazzar), a descendant of David, led the first group of Jewish exiles back to Jerusalem from Babylon and oversaw the rebuilding of the temple.

name: Zerubbabel
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Ancestor of Jesus
short: Zerubbabel, a descendant of David, was an ancestor of Jesus Christ.

name: Zeruiah
description: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Sister of David; mother of Joab, Abishai, and Asahel
short: Zeruiah, David's sister, was the mother of Joab, Abishai, and Asahel, who were among David's mighty men and military leaders.

name: Zetham
description: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Laadan, a Gershonite Levite
short: Zetham, a son of Laadan, was a Gershonite Levite during the time of David.

name: Zethan
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Bilhan, a Benjamite
short: Zethan was a son of Bilhan and a descendant of Benjamin.

name: Zethar
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: One of the seven eunuchs of King Ahasuerus
short: Zethar was one of the seven eunuchs who served King Ahasuerus of Persia.

name: Zia
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Gadite clan leader during the reign of Jotham
short: Zia was a Gadite clan leader during the reigns of Jotham, king of Judah, and Jeroboam, king of Israel.

name: Ziba
description: David's compatriot living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Servant of Saul's household, later served David
short: Ziba, a servant of Saul's household, became a servant of David and played a role in the conflict between David and Mephibosheth.

name: Zibeon
description: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Hivite grandfather of Esau's wife Oholibamah
short: Zibeon, the Hivite grandfather of Esau's wife Oholibamah.

name: Zibia
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Shaharaim, a Benjamite
short: Zibia was a son of Shaharaim, a Benjamite, born to his wife Hodesh in the country of Moab.

name: Zibiah
description: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Mother of King Joash (or 'Jehoash') of Judah from Beersheba
short: Zibiah, from Beersheba, was the mother of King Joash (or 'Jehoash') of Judah.

name: Zichri
description: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Levite, descendant of Moses, treasurer
short: Zichri, a Levite descendant of Moses, was a treasurer in the temple during the time of David.

name: Zichri
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Leader of the tribe of Reuben
short: Zichri was the leader of the tribe of Reuben during the reign of King David.

name: Zichri
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Shimei, a Benjamite
short: Zichri was a son of Shimei, a Benjamite, and a descendant of Shaharaim.

name: Zichri
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Jeroham, a Benjamite
short: Zichri was a son of Jeroham, a Benjamite, and a descendant of Shaharaim.

name: Zichri
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Jeroham, a Benjamite
short: Zichri was another son of Jeroham, a Benjamite, and a descendant of Shaharaim.

name: Zichri
description: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Levite, descendant of Asaph, temple singer
short: Zichri (or Zabdi), a Levite descendant of Asaph, was a temple singer during the time of Nehemiah.

name: Zichri
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Commander of 200,000 soldiers under Jehoshaphat
short: Zichri was a commander of 200,000 soldiers who volunteered to serve King Jehoshaphat of Judah.

name: Zichri
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Father of Elishaphat, a supporter of Jehoiada
short: Zichri was the father of Elishaphat, one of the commanders who supported Jehoiada the priest in overthrowing Athaliah.

name: Zichri
description: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Ephraimite warrior who killed Maaseiah, Ahaziah, and Elkanah
short: Zichri, a mighty warrior from Ephraim, killed Maaseiah the king's son, Ahaziah the governor, and Elkanah the second to the king during the reign of Ahaz.

name: Zichri
description: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Izhar, a Levite
short: Zichri was a son of Izhar and grandson of Kohath, of the tribe of Levi.

name: Zichri
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Son of Joab, a leader in Jerusalem
short: Zichri, the son of Joab, was a leader in Jerusalem during the time of Nehemiah.

name: Zichri
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Head of the priestly family of Abijah
short: Zichri was the head of the priestly family of Abijah during the time of Joiakim the high priest.

name: Ziha
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Family of temple servants who returned from exile
short: Ziha was a family of temple servants (Nethinim) who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian captivity.

name: Ziha
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Family of temple servants living on the Ophel
short: The temple servants, including the family of Ziha, lived on Ophel in Jerusalem during the time of Nehemiah.

name: Zillah
description: Woman living at the time before the Flood
brief: Wife of Lamech; mother of Tubal-Cain and Naamah
short: Zillah, one of Lamech's two wives, was the mother of Tubal-Cain, the first metalworker, and Naamah.

name: Zillethai
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Manassite leader who joined David at Ziklag
short: Zillethai, a leader from the tribe of Manasseh, was one of the men who joined David at Ziklag.

name: Zillethai
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Shimei, a Benjamite
short: Zillethai was a son of Shimei and a descendant of Benjamin.

name: Zilpah
description: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Leah's maidservant; mother of Gad and Asher
short: Zilpah, Leah's maidservant, bore Jacob two sons, Gad and Asher.

name: Zimmah
description: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Levite, son of Shimei, descendant of Gershon
short: Zimmah, a Levite and descendant of Gershon, was the son of Shimei.

name: Zimmah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Levite, son of Asaph, during Hezekiah's reign
short: Zimmah, a Levite and son of Asaph, participated in the purification of the temple during King Hezekiah's reign.

name: Zimran
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Son of Abraham and Keturah
short: Zimran was one of the sons born to Abraham and his wife Keturah after the death of Sarah.

name: Zimri
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Jehoadah, a Benjamite
short: Zimri, a Benjamite, was the son of Jehoadah and is mentioned in the genealogies of Benjamin.

name: Zimri
description: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: King of Israel, reigned seven days
short: Zimri, a commander of half of Israel's chariots, became king after assassinating Elah, but his reign lasted only seven days.

name: Zimri
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Simeonite prince, killed in the Baal-Peor incident
short: Zimri, a prince of the Simeonites, was one of the Israelites killed in the incident involving the worship of Baal-Peor.

name: Ziph
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy

brief: Son of Jehallelel, a Judahite

name: Ziphion
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Son of Gad, progenitor of the Zephonites
short: Ziphion (or Zephon), a son of Gad, was the ancestor of the Zephonite clan.

name: Zippor
description: Moabite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Father of Balak, king of Moab
short: Zippor was the father of Balak, the king of Moab who hired Balaam to curse Israel.

name: Zipporah
description: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Wife of Moses, daughter of Jethro
short: Zipporah, the daughter of Jethro, was Moses' wife and the mother of his two sons, Gershom and Eliezer.

name: Ziza
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy

name: Ziza
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of King Rehoboam and Maacah
short: Ziza was one of the sons born to King Rehoboam of Judah and his wife Maacah, the granddaughter of Absalom.

name: Zizah
description: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Gershonite Levite, son of Shimei
short: Zizah (or Zina), a Gershonite Levite, was the second son of Shimei.

name: Zobebah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Koz, a Judahite
short: Zobebah was one of the sons of Koz, a descendant of Judah.

name: Zohar
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Father of Ephron the Hittite
short: Zohar was the father of Ephron the Hittite, from whom Abraham purchased the cave of Machpelah as a burial site.

name: Zoheth
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Ishi, a Judahite
short: Zoheth was a son of Ishi and a descendant of Judah.

name: Zophah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Son of Hotham, an Asherite
short: Zophah was a son of Hotham (or 'Helem') and a descendant of Asher.

name: Zophar
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: One of Job's three friends, the Naamathite
short: Zophar the Naamathite was one of Job's three friends who came to comfort him during his affliction.

name: Zuar
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Father of Nethanel, leader of Issachar
short: Zuar was the father of Nethanel, a leader of the tribe of Issachar during the wilderness wanderings.

name: Zuph
description: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Levite ancestor of Samuel the prophet
short: Zuph, also called Zophai, was an Ephraimite Levite, an ancestor of Samuel the prophet.

name: Zur
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Son of Abiel, a Benjamite
short: Zur was a son of Abiel and a descendant of Benjamin.

name: Zur
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Midianite leader killed by Phinehas
short: Zur was a Midianite leader whose daughter was involved with an Israelite, resulting in a plague on Israel.

name: Zur
description: King living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Midianite king defeated by Israel
short: Zur was one of five Midianite kings defeated by Israel during the conquest of Canaan.

name: Zuriel
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Leader of the Merarite Levites
short: Zuriel was the leader of the Merarite Levites during the wilderness wanderings.

name: Zurishaddai
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Father of Shelumiel, leader of Simeon
short: Zurishaddai was the father of Shelumiel, a leader of the tribe of Simeon during the wilderness wanderings.

brief: Married Hezron, bore Segub
short: The daughter of Machir married Hezron and gave birth to Segub.

name: daughter of Meshullam
description: Woman living at the time of Exile and Return - unnamed daughter of Meshullam
brief: Married Jehohanan, son of Tobiah the Ammonite
short: The daughter of Meshullam was married to Jehohanan, the son of Tobiah the Ammonite.

name: daughter of Pharaoh
description: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy - unnamed daughter of Pharaoh
brief: Daughter of Pharaoh - Wife of King Solomon
short: Solomon married the daughter of Pharaoh, forming a political alliance with Egypt.

name: daughter of Pharaoh
description: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness - unnamed daughter of Pharaoh
brief: Daughter of Pharaoh - Rescued and adopted Moses
short: Pharaoh's daughter rescued the infant Moses from the Nile and adopted him as her son.

name: daughter of Putiel
description: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness - unnamed daughter of Putiel
brief: Daughter of Putiel - Wife of Eleazar the priest
short: The daughter of Putiel was the wife of Eleazar, son of Aaron the priest.

brief: Married to one of Tobiah's sons

name: daughter2 of Lot
description: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs - unnamed younger daughter of Lot
brief: Younger daughter of Lot; mother of Ben-ammi
short: Lot's unnamed younger daughter, who bore Ben-ammi after the destruction of Sodom.

brief: The wife of Zechariah and mother of John the Baptist.
short: Elizabeth was the wife of Zechariah, a priest, and the mother of John the Baptist.

brief: Father of Eunice - Grandfather of Timothy
short: Eunice's father, unnamed in the Bible, was the maternal grandfather of Timothy.

name: father of Hilkiah

brief: Father of Hilkiah, Jeremiah's cousin
short: The father of Hilkiah, who was the cousin of the prophet Jeremiah.

brief: Father of Hodiah and Naham
short: An unnamed man, the father Naham and his sister Hodiah

name: father of Lazarus
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament - unnamed father
brief: The father of Mary, Martha and Lazarus of Bethany.
short: The unnamed father of Mary, Martha and Lazarus, who lived in Bethany.

name: father of Mamre
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs - unnamed father
brief: Father of Mamre - Amorite, ally of Abraham
short: Mamre's father, an Amorite, was an ally of Abraham during the battle against Chedorlaomer.

name: father of Nathan
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy - unnamed father
brief: Father of Nathan, one of David's mighty men
short: The father of Nathan, one of King David's mighty men.

name: father of Tahpenes
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy - unnamed father
brief: Egyptian Pharaoh who gave his daughter to Hadad
short: The father of Tahpenes, an Egyptian Pharaoh who gave his daughter in marriage to Hadad the Edomite.

name: father of Timothy
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament - unnamed father of Timothy
brief: Father of Timothy - Greek man; husband of Eunice
short: Timothy's father was a Greek man, and his mother was a believing Jewish woman named Eunice.

name: husband of Hammolecheth
description: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness - unnamed husband of Hammolecheth
brief: Husband of Hammolecheth - Father of Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah
short: Hammolecheth's husband, unnamed in the Bible, was the father of Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.

name: husband of Mary
description: Levite living at the time of the New Testament  - unnamed husband of Mary
brief: Husband of Mary - John Mark's father
short: Mary's husband, unnamed in the Bible, was the father of John Mark.

name: husband of Matred
description: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs - unnamed husband of Matred
brief: Husband of Matred, of Edomite royalty
short: Matred's mother was Mezahab, the grandmother of Mehetabel, who was the wife of an Edomite king.

name: husband of Shimeath
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy - unnamed husband of Shimeath
brief: Husband of Shimeath - Father of King Joash's assassins
short: Shimeath's husband, unnamed in the Bible, was the father of Jozachar, one of the assassins of King Joash.

name: husband of Zeruiah
description: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Husband of Zeruiah; father of Abishai and Joab
short: The unnamed husband of Zeruiah, who was the father of David's mighty men, Abishai and Joab.

brief: Mother-in-law of Peter, healed by Jesus
short: Peter's unnamed mother-in-law, whom Jesus healed of a fever.

name: sister of Tahpenes
description: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Egyptian queen, given in marriage to Hadad
short: The sister of Tahpenes, an Egyptian queen, was given in marriage to Hadad the Edomite by Pharaoh.

name: son of Jashen
description: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
brief: Son of Jashen - One of David's mighty men
short: The son of Jashen, unnamed in the Bible, was one of David's mighty men.

name: son of Joiada
description: Priest living at the time of Exile and Return
brief: Grandson of Eliashib, married Sanballat's daughter
short: The son of Joiada, a grandson of the high priest Eliashib, married the daughter of Sanballat the Horonite.

name: wife of Heli
description: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
brief: The unnamed grandmother of Jesus.
short: The wife of Heli was sister of Elizather who mothered John the Baptist.

name: a wife of Eliphaz
description: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
brief: Wife of Eliphaz and mother of Teman.
short: Wife or concubine of Eliphaz, was the mother of Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, and Kenaz.

name: a wife of Ezekiel
description: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
brief: Wife of Ezekiel - Died as a sign to Israel
short: Ezekiel's wife died suddenly, and God used her death as a sign to the people of Israel.

name: a wife of Hezron
description: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
brief: Mother of Jerahmeel, Ram, and Caleb
short: An unnamed wife of Hezron who bore him Jerahmeel, Ram, and Caleb.

name: a wife of Jerahmeel

brief: Wife of Jerahmeel; mother of Ram
short: An unnamed wife of Jerahmeel who bore him Bunah, Ram, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.

short: One of King Josiah's wives was the mother of his son Shallum.

short: An unnamed wife of Lot, who was Terah's daughter-in-law.

name: a wife of Peter

brief: Wife of Peter, whose mother Jesus healed
short: Peter's unnamed wife, whose mother Jesus healed of a fever.

name: a wife of Simeon

brief: Wife of Simeon, the son of Jacob.
short: An unnamed wife of Simeon, the son of Jacob, is mentioned in the genealogy of Simeon's descendants.

name: a wife of Solomon

brief: Daughter of Abinadab, one of Solomon's wives.
short: One of Solomon's wives was the daughter of Abinadab, who was placed in charge of the district of Dor.
